**仅强调收益能力的缺点**。现在，普通股价值完全依赖于收益数据，私人企业与投资指导规则之间出现了差距。当商人写下自己的报告并阅读大公司的报告时，他似乎进入了一个全新的价值世界。当然，他不会仅根据最近的经营结果来评估自己的企业，而不考虑其财务资源。作为投资者或投机者，如果商人选择不关注企业资产负债表，他在多个方面都会处于严重劣势：首先，他接受的是与日常商业经验无关的*新*一套理念；其次，他不再依赖收益和资产这两个标准来评估价值，而是依赖一个*单一*且因此更不可靠的标准；第三，他完全依赖的收益报表比资产负债表发生的变化更快、更剧烈。因此，他的股票价值概念引入了过度不稳定的因素。第四，与经验丰富的投资者仔细审查典型资产负债表相比，收益报表更容易出现*误导性的*呈现和错误的推断。

<!--en-->
**Disadvantages of Sole Emphasis on Earning Power.** Now that common-stock values have come to depend exclusively upon the earnings exhibit, a gulf has been created between the concepts of private business and the guiding rules of investment. When the business man lays down his own statement and picks up the report of a large corporation, he apparently enters a new and entirely different world of values. For certainly he does not appraise his own business solely on the basis of its recent operating results without reference to its financial resources. When in his capacity as investor or speculator the business man elects to pay no attention whatever to corporate balance sheets, he is placing himself at a serious disadvantage in several different respects: In the firstplace, he is embracing a *new* set of ideas that are alien to his everyday business experience. In the second place, instead of the twofold test of value afforded by both earnings and assets, he is relying upon a *single* and therefore less dependable criterion. In the third place, these earnings statements on which he relies exclusively are subject to more rapid and radical *changes* than those which occur in balance sheets. Hence an exaggerated degree of instability is introduced into his concept of stock values. In the fourth place, the earnings statements are far more subject to *misleading* presentation and mistaken inferences than is the typical balance sheet when scrutinized by an investor of experience.

**警告：切勿仅依赖收益数据。**因此，在分析损益表时，我们必须强烈提醒：在处理投资价值时，不要只专注于这一因素。尽管必须充分认识到资产状况的重要性有限，但必须指出，公司的资源仍然具有一定意义，需要关注。这一点尤其重要，因为只有结合期初和期末的资产负债表，才能正确理解任何损益表的含义。

<!--en-->
**Warning Against Sole Reliance upon Earnings Exhibit.** In approaching the analysis of earnings statements we must, therefore, utter an emphatic warning against exclusive preoccupation with this factor in dealing with investment values. With due recognition of the greatly restricted importance of the asset picture, it must nevertheless be asserted that a company's resources still have some significance and require some attention. This is particularly true, as will be seen later on, because the meaning of any income statement cannot properly be understood except with reference to the balance sheet at the beginning and the end of the period.

**华尔街评估普通股方法的简化说明。**从另一个角度来看，我们可以说华尔街评估普通股的方法已简化为以下标准公式：

<!--en-->
**Simplified Statement of Wall Street's Method of Appraising Common Stocks.** Viewing the subject from another angle, we may say that the Wall-Street method of appraising common stocks has been simplified to the following standard formula:

1. 查明股票的收益情况。（通常指上次报告中显示的每股收益。）
2. 将这些每股收益乘以合适的“质量系数”，该系数反映：a. 股息率和记录情况。b. 公司的地位——规模、声誉、财务状况和前景。c. 业务类型（例如，香烟制造商的每股收益倍数会高于雪茄公司）。d. 整体市场趋势。（牛市中的倍数比熊市中更高。）以上内容可总结为以下公式：

<!--en-->
1. Find out what the stock is earning. (This usually means the earnings per share as shown in the last report.)
2. Multiply these per-share earnings by some suitable "coefficient of quality" which will reflect:
a. The dividend rate and record.
b. The standing of the company—its size, reputation, financial position, and prospects.
c. The type of business (e.g., a cigarette manufacturer will sell at a higher multiple of earnings than a cigar company).
d. The temper of the general market. (Bull-market multipliers are larger than those used in bear markets.)
The foregoing may be summarized in the following formula:

$$
\text{Price} = \text{current earnings per share} \times \text{quality coefficient.}^1
$$

通过这一过程，在大多数情况下，“每股收益”在决定价值时所占比重，相当于所有其他因素综合起来的比重。如果记住“质量系数”本身很大程度上由“收益趋势”决定，而收益趋势又来自一段时间内的实际收益，就会明白这一点。

<!--en-->
The result of this procedure is that in most cases the “earnings per share” have attained a weight in determining value that is equivalent to the *weight of all the other factors taken together*. The truth of this is evident if it be remembered that the “quality coefficient” is itself largely determined by the *earnings trend*, which in turn is taken from the stated earnings over a period.

**收益不仅波动，还受任意决定影响。**然而，作为整个价值体系基础的每股收益，不仅波动极大，还极易受到任意决定和操纵。此时，总结各种合法或非法的手段，说明每股收益如何根据控制者意愿被设定为更大或更小，将非常有帮助。

<!--en-->
**Earnings Not Only Fluctuate but Are Subject to Arbitrary Determination.** But these earnings per share, on which the entire edifice of value has come to be built, are not only highly fluctuating but are subject also in extraordinary degree to arbitrary determination and manipulation. It will be illuminating if we summarize at this point the various devices, legitimate and otherwise, by which the per-share earnings may *at the choice of those in control* be made to appear either larger or smaller.

1. 将项目分配为盈余而非收入，或相反。
2. 过度或低估摊销和其他储备费用。
3. 通过改变资本结构，比如高级证券与普通股之间的比例变化。（这种调整由管理层决定，并由股东默认执行。）
4. 使用未用于经营的大型资金。**这对分析师的重要性。**这些企业会计和财务政策的复杂性，无疑为证券分析师提供了广阔的工作领域。有无限的机会进行敏锐的调查、批判性比较，发现并指出与公开公布的“每股收益”截然不同的实际情况。不可否认，这项工作具有极高的价值。在许多情况下，它将得出令人信服的结论：市场价格与内在或比较价值严重不符，因此基于这一可靠依据可以采取有利行动。但必须提醒分析师，不要过分相信其发现的实际效用。了解真相总是好的，但未必总是明智地据此行事，尤其是在华尔街。还必须记住，分析师发现的真相首先不是全部真相，其次也不是不可改变的真相。他的研究结果只是“更接近正确的过去版本”。他的信息可能在他获取时已经失去相关性，或者无论如何，在市场最终准备好回应之前就已经如此。尽管存在这些风险，但毋庸置疑，证券分析必须对企业收入报表进行彻底研究。如果我们把这项研究分为三个方面，将有助于我们的阐述：
1. 会计方面。关键问题：所研究期间的真实收益是多少？
2. 业务方面。关键问题：收益记录对公司的*未来*盈利能力有何指示？
3. 投资金融方面。关键问题：在尝试合理*评估*股票时，必须考虑哪些收益要素，遵循哪些标准？

<!--en-->
1. By allocating items to surplus instead of to income, or *vice versa*.
2. By over- or understating amortization and other reserve charges.
3. By varying the capital structure, as between senior securities and common stock. (Such moves are decided upon by managements and ratified by the stockholders as a matter of course.)
4. By the use made of large capital funds not employed in the conduct of the business.
**Significance of the Foregoing to the Analyst.** These intricacies of corporate accounting and financial policiesundoubtedly provide a broad field for the activities of the securities analyst. There are unbounded opportunities for shrewd detective work, for critical comparisons, for discovering and pointing out a state of affairs quite different from that indicated by the publicized “per-share earnings.”
That this work may be of exceeding value cannot be denied. In a number of cases it will lead to a convincing conclusion that the market price is far out of line with intrinsic or comparative worth and hence to profitable action based upon this sound foundation. But it is necessary to caution the analyst against overconfidence in the practical utility of his findings. It is always good to know the truth, but it may not always be wise to act upon it, particularly in Wall Street. And it must always be remembered that the truth that the analyst uncovers is first of all not the *whole* truth and, secondly, not the *immutable* truth. The result of his study is only a *more nearly correct version of the past*. His information may have lost its relevance by the time he acquires it, or in any event by the time the market place is finally ready to respond to it.
With full allowance for these pitfalls, it goes without saying, none the less, that security analysis must devote thoroughgoing study to corporate income accounts. It will aid our exposition if we classify this study under three headings, *viz.*:
1. The accounting aspect. Leading question: What are the true earnings for the period studied?
2. The business aspect. Leading question: What indications does the earnings record carry as to the *future* earning power of the company?
3. The aspect of investment finance. Leading question: What elements in the earnings exhibit must be taken into account, and what standards followed, in endeavoring to arrive at a reasonable *valuation* of the shares?

## 批评与收入报表的说明

<!--en-->
*CRITICISM AND RESTATEMENT OF THE INCOME ACCOUNT*

如果收入报表要真正具有信息价值，至少必须呈现当年经营结果的公平、真实情况。对于上市公司而言，直接错误陈述数据的情况较为罕见。1932年揭露的伊瓦尔·克鲁格欺诈案就属于这种情况，但这种欺诈在坦率程度及规模上都是非常独特的。大多数重要公司的报表都由独立公共会计师进行审计，其报告在有限的会计准确性范围内具有相当的可信度。²但从普通股票分析的角度来看，这些经审计的报表可能需要批判性解读和调整，尤其是涉及以下三个重要要素：

<!--en-->
If an income statement is to be informative in any true sense, it must at least present a fair and undistorted picture of the year's operating results. Direct misstatement of the figures in the case of publicly owned companies is a rare occurrence. The Ivar Kreuger frauds, revealed in 1932, partook of this character, but these were quite unique in the baldness as well as in the extent of the deception. The statements of most important companies are audited by independent public accountants, and their reports are reasonably dependable within the rather limited sphere of accounting accuracy.² But from the standpoint of common-stock analysis these audited statements may require critical interpretation and adjustment, especially with respect to three important elements:

1. 非经常性利润和损失。
2. 子公司或关联企业的运营情况。
3. 储备金。 **关于收入报表的一般说明。** 会计程序允许管理层在处理非经常性项目时拥有相当大的灵活性。通常的规则是，适用于过去年度的交易应排除在当前收入之外，并直接作为费用或贷方计入盈余账户。然而，有许多类型的记录从技术上讲可能被视为当前年度的结果，但本质上仍属于特殊且非经常性的性质。会计规则允许管理层决定是否将这些运营项目作为*收入*的一部分展示，或将其作为*盈余*的调整项目报告。以下是几种此类记录的示例：
1. 固定资产出售的损益。
2. 可交易证券出售的损益。
3. 资本债务偿还的折扣或溢价。
4. 人寿保险合同的收益。
5. 税收退还及其利息。
6. 诉讼产生的损益。
7. 存货的特别减记。
8. 应收账款的特别减记。
9. 维护非经营资产的成本。在企业实务中，关于上述各项，成本差异很大。每个标题下都会给出关于是否将某些项目计入收入账户的例子。在某些情况下，哪种会计处理方式更好可能是一个有争议的问题；但就分析师而言，他的目标要求将所有这些项目与年度的*正常经营成果*分开处理。投资者从年度报告主要想了解的是在给定条件下所显示的*预期盈利能力*，即如果报告期间的企业状况保持不变，公司预计每年能赚得多少。（另一方面，正如我们稍后将指出的，所有这些非常规项目实际上会纳入过去*多年期间*实际显示的盈利能力计算中。）分析师还必须调整报告的利润数据，以尽可能准确反映公司对控制或关联公司的贡献。在大多数情况下，会编制合并报告，因此无需进行此类调整。但有许多情况下，报表不完整或具有误导性，原因可能是：(1)它们未能反映重要子公司任何部分的利润或亏损；(2)它们将子公司分派的股息作为收入，而这些股息实际上比控制企业的当前利润大或小得多。分析师必须重点关注的收入账户的第三个方面是折旧和其他摊销储备，以及未来损失和其他意外情况的储备。这些储备在很大程度上由管理层随意确定，因此很容易被夸大或缩小，从而导致报告的利润最终数值相应失真。关于摊销费用，另一个更微妙的因素有时非常重要，即管理层根据资产账面成本计算的收入扣除项，可能无法准确反映*个人投资者*应将其投入企业中的承诺所进行的摊销。**非经常性项目：固定资产出售利润或亏损。**我们将继续详细讨论报告收入账户的这三种调整类型，首先从非经常性项目开始。固定资产出售利润或亏损显然属于这一类别，应将其排除在年度结果之外，以便了解基于当时业务状况假设持续的情况下的“预期盈利能力”。认可的会计惯例建议，资本资产销售利润仅作为贷方计入盈余账户。然而，在许多情况下，公司会将这种利润作为当前净收入的一部分进行报告，导致该期间利润数据失真。*示例：*曼哈顿电气供应公司1926年的报告就是一个明显的例子。报告显示利润为882,000美元，即每股10.25美元，被视为非常有利的数据。但后来在纽约证券交易所上市额外股份时发现，报告中所述的882,000美元利润中，至少有586,700美元是通过出售公司电池业务获得的。因此，正常经营产生的利润仅为295,300美元，即约每股3.40美元。将这种特殊利润计入收入尤其令人不满，因为同一年，公司还计入了544,000美元的非常规*亏损*到盈余中。 显然，特殊损失与特殊收益属于同一类别，两者应归为一组。将一项计入收入、另一项计入盈余的处理方式具有极大的误导性。更不可取的是，在年度报告中，无论是收入账户中，还是伴随的补充说明中，都没有明确提及电池销售所得收益。⁴ 1931年，美国钢铁公司报告了约19,300,000美元的"特殊收入"，其中大部分来自"固定资产销售利润"——指的是印第安纳州加里市的某些公共事业资产。该项被计入当年的收益，最终导致"净收入"为13,000,000美元。但由于这一收益属于非经常性项目，分析师不得不将其从对1931年经营成果的分析中排除，因此优先股息之前需记为6,300,000美元的*亏损*。1931年美国钢铁公司的会计方法与其以往政策不同，其前三年收到的所得税退税大量款项的处理方式就说明了这一点。这些款项并未作为当期收入报告，而是直接计入盈余。**可交易证券销售利润**。企业从可交易证券销售中获得的利润也具有特殊性，必须与常规经营成果区分开来。*示例：*前标准石油子公司国家运输公司1928年的报告就说明了将此来源的利润计入收入账户所带来的扭曲效果。向股东呈现这一数据的方式也受到严重批评。1927年和1928年的合并收入报告大致如下：

<!--en-->
1. Nonrecurrent profits and losses.
2. Operations of subsidiaries or affiliates.
3. Reserves.
**General Observations on the Income Account.** Accounting procedure allows considerable leeway to the management in the method of treating nonrecurrent items. It is a standard and proper rule that transactions applicable to past years should be excluded from current income and entered as a charge or credit direct to the surplus account. Yet there are many kinds of entries that may technically be considered part of the current year's results but that are none the less of a special and nonrecurrent nature. Accounting rules permit the management to decide whether to show these operations as part of the *income* or to report them as adjustments of *surplus*. Following are a number of examples of entries of this type:
1. Profit or loss on sale of fixed assets.
2. Profit or loss on sale of marketable securities.
3. Discount or premium on retirement of capital obligations.
4. Proceeds of life insurance policies.
5. Tax refunds and interest thereon.
6. Gain or loss as result of litigation.
7. Extraordinary write-downs of inventory.
8. Extraordinary write-downs of receivables.
9. Cost of maintaining nonoperating properties.
Wide variations will be found in corporate practice respecting items such as the foregoing. Under each heading examples may be given of either inclusion in or exclusion from the income account. Which is the better accounting procedure in some of these cases may be a rather controversial question, but, as far as the analyst is concerned, his object requires that all these items be segregated from the *ordinary operating results* of the year. For what the investor chiefly wants to learn from an annual report is the *indicated earning power* under the given set of conditions, *i.e.*, what the company might be expected to earn year after year if the business conditions prevailing during the period were to continue unchanged. (On the other hand, as we shall point out later, all these extraordinary items enter properly into the calculation of earning power as actually shown over a *period of years* in the past.)
The analyst must endeavor also to adjust the reported earnings so as to reflect as accurately as possible the company's interest in results of controlled or affiliated companies. In most cases consolidated reports are made, so that such adjustments are unnecessary. But numerous instances have occurred in which the statements are incomplete or misleading because either: (1) they fail to reflect any part of the profits or losses of important subsidiaries or (2) they include as income dividends from subsidiaries that are substantially less or greater than the current earnings of the controlled enterprises.
The third aspect of the income account to which the analyst must give critical attention is the matter of reserves for depreciation and other amortization, and reserves for future losses and other contingencies. These reserves are subject in good part to arbitrary determination by the management. Hence they may readily be overstated or understated, in which case the final figure of reported earnings will be correspondingly distorted. With respect to amortizationcharges, another and more subtle element enters which may at times be of considerable importance, and that is the fact that the deductions from income, as calculated by the management based on the book cost of the property, may not properly reflect the amortization that the *individual investor* should charge against his own commitment in the enterprise.
**Nonrecurrent Items: Profits or Losses from Sale of Fixed Assets.** We shall proceed to a more detailed discussion of these three types of adjustment of the reported income account, beginning with the subject of nonrecurrent items.³ Profits or losses from the sale of fixed assets belong quite obviously to this category, and they should be excluded from the year's result in order to gain an idea of the "indicated earning power" based on the assumed continuance of the business conditions existing then. Approved accounting practice recommends that profit on sales of capital assets be shown only as a credit to the surplus account. In numerous instances, however, such profits are reported by the company as part of its current net income, creating a distorted picture of the earnings for the period.
*Examples:* A glaring example of this practice is presented by the report of the Manhattan Electrical Supply Company for 1926. This showed earnings of $882,000, or $10.25 per share, which was regarded as a very favorable exhibit. But a subsequent application to list additional shares on the New York Stock Exchange revealed that out of this $882,000 reported as earned, no less than $586,700 had been realized through the sale of the company's battery business. Hence the earnings from ordinary operations were only $295,300, or about $3.40 per share. The inclusion of this special profit in income was particularly objectionable because in the very same year the company had charged to surplus extraordinary *losses* amounting to $544,000. Obviously the special losses belonged to the same category as the special profits, and the two items should have been grouped together. The effect of including the one in income and charging the other to surplus was misleading in the highest degree. Still more discreditable was the failure to make any clear reference to the profit fromthe battery sale either in the income account itself or in the extended remarks that accompanied it in the annual report.⁴
During 1931 the United States Steel Corporation reported “special income” of some $19,300,000, the greater part of which was due to “profit on sale of fixed property”—understood to be certain public-utility holdings in Gary, Indiana. This item was included in the year’s earnings and resulted in a final “net income” of $13,000,000. But since this credit was definitely of a nonrecurring nature, the analyst would be compelled to eliminate it from his consideration of the 1931 operating results, which would accordingly register a *loss* of $6,300,000 before preferred dividends. United States Steel’s accounting method in 1931 is at variance with its previous policy, as shown by its treatment of the large sums received in the form of income-tax refunds in the three preceding years. These receipts were not reported as current income but were credited directly to surplus.
**Profits from Sale of Marketable Securities.** Profits realized by a business corporation from the sale of marketable securities are also of a special character and must be separated from the ordinary operating results.
*Examples:* The report of National Transit Company, a former Standard Oil subsidiary, for the year 1928 illustrates the distorting effect due to the inclusion in the income account of profits from this source. The method of presenting the story to the stockholders is also open to serious criticism. The consolidated income account for 1927 and 1928 was stated in approximately the following terms:

<table><thead><tr><th>项目</th><th>1927</th><th>1928</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>营业收入</td><td>$3,432,000</td><td>$3,419,000</td></tr><tr><td>股息、利息及其他收入</td><td>463,000</td><td>370,000</td></tr><tr><td>总收入</td><td>$3,895,000</td><td>$3,789,000</td></tr><tr><td>“运营费用，包括折旧和损益直接项目”（1928年表述为“包括证券销售利润”）</td><td>3,264,000</td><td>2,599,000</td></tr><tr><td>净利润</td><td>$631,000</td><td>$1,190,000</td></tr><tr><td>（每股收益）</td><td>($1.24)</td><td>($2.34)</td></tr></tbody></table>

<!--en-->
<table><thead><tr><th>Item</th><th>1927</th><th>1928</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Operating revenues</td><td>$3,432,000</td><td>$3,419,000</td></tr><tr><td>Dividends, interest, and miscellaneous income</td><td>463,000</td><td>370,000</td></tr><tr><td>Total revenues</td><td>$3,895,000</td><td>$3,789,000</td></tr><tr><td>“Operating expenses, including depreciation and profit and loss direct items” (in 1928 “including profits from sale of securities”)</td><td>3,264,000</td><td>2,599,000</td></tr><tr><td>Net income</td><td>$631,000</td><td>$1,190,000</td></tr><tr><td>(Earned per share)</td><td>($1.24)</td><td>($2.34)</td></tr></tbody></table>

每股收益的增长相当显著。但仅对母公司详细数据进行的分析，如提交给州际商业委员会的数据所示，1928年的收入中560,000美元来自证券销售利润。这一数值几乎与上一年合并净利润的增长额完全相等。考虑到所得税及其他抵消特殊利润的因素，以及制造子公司可能从证券销售中获得的额外利润，1928年净利润的明显改善很可能全部或几乎全部来自非运营项目。此类收益显然不应纳入任何*盈利能力*的比较或计算中。National Transit采用的声明方式——将此类利润用于*减少运营费用*——至少可以说很奇怪。

<!--en-->
The increase in the earnings per share appeared quite impressive. But a study of the detailed figures of the parent company alone, as submitted to the Interstate Commerce Commission, would have revealed that $560,000 of the 1928 income was due to its profits from the sale of securities. This happens to be almost exactly equal to the increase in consolidated net earnings over the previous year. Allowing on the one hand for income tax and other offsets against these special profits but on the other hand for probable additional profits from the sale of securities by the manufacturing subsidiary, it seems likely that all or nearly all of the apparent improvement in earnings for 1928 was due to nonoperating items. Such gains must clearly be eliminated from any comparison or calculation of *earning power*. The form of statement resorted to by National Transit, in which such profits are applied to *reduce operating expenses*, is bizarre to say the least.

1929年纽约、芝加哥和圣路易斯铁路公司通过其子公司出售Pere Marquette股票的行为，后来导致了一种更为异常的会计操纵行为。我们将在讨论非合并子公司相关项目时描述这些交易。1931年F.W. Woolworth公司在其收入中计入了出售英国子公司部分股权所获得的近10,000,000美元利润。这种计入方式使得每股收益看起来比前一年更大，而实际上前一年经济处于衰退状态。值得注意的是，同年该公司将额外的2,000,000美元税收计入*盈余*，这似乎与计入*收入*中的特殊利润密切相关。

<!--en-->
The sale by the New York, Chicago, and St. Louis Railroad Company, through a subsidiary, of its holdings of Pere Marquette stock in 1929 gave rise later to an even more extraordinary form of bookkeeping manipulation. We shall describe these transactions in connection with our treatment of items involving nonconsolidated subsidiaries. During 1931 F.W. Woolworth Company included in its income a profit of nearly $10,000,000 on the sale of a part interest in its British subsidiary. The effect of this inclusion was to make the per-share earnings appear larger than any previous year, when in fact they had experienced a recession. It is somewhat surprising to note that in the same year the company charged against *surplus* an additional tax accrual of $2,000,000 which seemed to be closely related to the special profit included in *income*.

证券市场价值的下降应被视为非经常性项目，就像出售证券产生的损失一样。外汇价值缩水也是如此。大多数公司在进行此类减值时，会将之计入*盈余*。通用汽车1931年的报告包含了这两种调整，总计20,575,000美元的扣除项，但明确将其称为“非常规和非经常性损失”。

<!--en-->
Reduction in the market value of securities should be considered as a nonrecurring item in the same way as losses from the sale of such securities. The same would be true of shrinkage in the value of foreign exchange. In most cases corporations charge such write-downs, when made, against *surplus*. The General Motors report for 1931 included both such adjustments, totaling $20,575,000 as deductions fromincome, but was careful to designate them as “extraordinary and nonrecurring losses.”

*投资信托报告可销售证券销售的方法*。投资信托的报表在处理证券销售所得利润或损失以及证券价值变化方面引发特殊问题。1930年前，大多数公司将证券销售利润作为常规收入的一部分报告，但在资产负债表附注中显示未售出证券的增值情况。但在1930年及之后出现巨大亏损时，大多数情况下并非在收入项目中反映，而是作为资本、盈余或储备的减项。大多数公司仍通过资产负债表上的说明性注释记录未实现折旧，继续列示原始成本持有的证券。少数投资信托通过资本和盈余减项将投资组合的账面价值降至市场价值。

<!--en-->
*Methods Used by Investment Trusts in Reporting Sale of Marketable Securities.* Investment-trust statements raise special questions with respect to the treatment of profits or losses realized from the sale of securities and changes in security values. Prior to 1930 most of these companies reported profits from the sale of securities as part of their regular income, but they showed the appreciation on *unsold* securities in the form of a memorandum or footnote to the balance sheet. But when large losses were taken in 1930 and subsequently, they were shown in most cases not in the income account but as charges against capital, surplus, or reserves. The *unrealized* depreciation was still recorded by most companies in the form of an explanatory comment on the balance sheet, which continued to carry the securities owned at original cost. A minority of investment trusts reduced the carrying price of their portfolio to the market by means of charges against capital and surplus.

可以合理认为，由于证券交易是投资信托业务的重要组成部分，销售结果甚至投资组合价值变化应被视为年度报告中的常规而非非常规要素。当然，仅限于利息和股息收入减去费用的分析价值微乎其微。如果可以从投资信托报表分析中获得任何有用结果，那么分析必须基于三项内容：投资收入、证券销售利润或损失以及市场价值变化。同样明显的是，任何一年计算出的收益或损失，都无法表明*盈利能力*。除非先将结果与一般市场表现指标进行比较，否则多年平均数据对未来没有意义。假设投资信托的表现明显优于相关“平均值”，这当然是管理能力良好的*表面证据*。但即便如此，也很难明确区分卓越能力与市场运气。

<!--en-->
It may logically be contended that, since dealing in securities is an integral part of the investment-trust business, the results from sales and even the changes in portfolio values should be regarded as ordinary rather than extraordinary elements in the year’s report. Certainly a study confined to the interest and dividend receipts less expenses would prove of negligible value. If *any* useful results can be expected from an analysis of investment-trust exhibits, such analysis must clearly be based on the three items: investment income, profits or losses on the sale of securities and changes in market values. It is equally obvious that the gain or shrinkage, so computed, in any one year is no indication whatever of *earning power* in the recurrent sense. Nor can an average taken over several years have any significance for the future unless the results are first compared with some appropriate measure of general market performance. Assuming that an investment trust has done substantially better than the relevant “average,” this is of course a *prima facie* indication of capable management. But even here it would be difficult to distinguishconfidently between superior ability and luckier guesses on the market.

这种批评的核心有两个方面：(1) 主要价值的整体变化是衡量投资信托绩效的唯一标准，但(2) 这一指标不能被视为“正常盈利能力”的指标，无法与一家根基稳固的工业企业的实际收益相类比。⁵ *银行和保险公司的类似问题*。分析保险公司和银行所呈现的结果时，也存在类似问题。公众对保险证券的兴趣主要集中在火灾保险公司股票上。这些企业同时涉及保险业务和投资信托业务。它们拥有用于投资的资本资金，以及预先支付的保费所得的大量资金。一般来说，这些资金中只有一小部分受到投资方面的法律限制，其余部分则像投资信托的资源一样被管理。承保业务本身很少能带来高利润，通常会出现亏损，不过可以通过利息和股息收入来弥补。证券运营中显示的利润或损失，包括市场价值的变化，对公众对火灾保险公司股票的态度有显著影响。银行股票的情况也是如此，虽然程度较小，但同样重要。20世纪20年代末，这些证券领域的过度投机很大程度上是由银行通过直接或关联机构参与证券市场获得的巨大利润所推动的。

<!--en-->
The gist of this critique is twofold: (1) the over-all change in principal value is the only available measure of investment-trust performance, but (2) this measure cannot be regarded as an index of “normal earning power” in any sense analogous to the recorded earnings of a well-entrenched industrial business.⁵
*Similar Problem in the Case of Banks and Insurance Companies.* A like problem is involved in analyzing the results shown by insurance companies and by banks. Public interest in insurance securities is concentrated largely upon the shares of fire insurance companies. These enterprises represent a combination of the insurance business and the investment-trust business. They have available for investment their capital funds plus substantial amounts received as premiums paid in advance. Generally speaking, only a small portion of these funds is subject to legal restrictions as regards investment, and the balance is handled in much the same way as the resources of the investment trusts. The underwriting business as such has rarely proved highly profitable. Frequently it shows a deficit, which is offset, however, by interest and dividend income. The profits or losses shown on security operations, including changes in their market value, exert a predominant influence upon the public’s attitude toward fire-insurance-company stocks. The same has been true of bank stocks to a smaller, but none the less significant, degree. The tremendous overspeculation in these issues during the late 1920s was stimulated largely by the participation of the banks, directly or through affiliates, in the fabulous profits made in the securities markets.

自1933年起，银行被要求与关联企业分离，其非政府证券业务也受到更严格的监管和限制。但由于他们大量资金投资于债券，债券价格的重大变化仍可能对其报告收益产生显著影响。

<!--en-->
Since 1933 banks have been required to divorce themselves from their affiliates, and their operations in securities other than government issues have been more carefully supervised and restricted. But in view of the large portion of their resources invested in bonds, substantial changes in bond prices are still likely to exert a pronounced effect upon their reported earnings.

金融机构（如投资信托、银行和保险公司）的业务通常必须反映证券价值的变化，这使得它们的股票成为公众广泛交易的危险工具。由于在这些企业中，证券价值上升可能被视为年度利润的一部分，人们不可避免地会将好时期获得的收益视为“盈利能力”的一部分，并据此评估股票价值。这自然会导致荒谬的高估，随后出现崩溃和相应的过度下跌。这种剧烈波动对金融机构尤其有害，因为它们可能影响公众信心。事实上，对银行及保险公司股票的疯狂投机（称为“投资”）会导致不明智地创办新企业、不理智地扩展旧企业，以及普遍放松既定的保守和诚信标准。

<!--en-->
The fact that the operations of financial institutions generally—such as investment trusts, banks and insurance companies—must necessarily reflect changes in security values makes their shares a dangerous medium for widespread public dealings. Since in these enterprises an increase in security values may be held to be part of the year’s profits, there is an inevitable tendency to regard the gains made in good times as part of the “earning power” and to value the shares accordingly. This results of course in an absurd overvaluation, to be followed by collapse and a correspondingly excessive depreciation. Such violent fluctuations are particularly harmful in the case of financial institutions because they may affect public confidence. It is true also that rampant speculation (called “investment”) in bank and insurance-company stocks leads to the ill-advised launching of new enterprises, to the unwise expansion of old ones and to a general relaxation of established standards of conservatism and even of probity.

证券分析师在履行投资顾问职责时，应尽力阻止普通小投资者购买银行及保险机构的股票。在20世纪20年代繁荣之前，这类证券几乎仅由具有丰富金融经验和成熟判断力的人持有。这些品质对于避免因报告收益依赖于证券价格波动而误判价值的风险至关重要。

<!--en-->
The securities analyst, in discharging his function of investment counsellor, should do his best to discourage the purchase of stocks of banking and insurance institutions by the ordinary small investor. Prior to the boom of the 1920s such securities were owned almost exclusively by those having or commanding large financial experience and matured judgment. These qualities are needed to avoid the special danger of misjudging values in this field by reason of the dependence of their reported earnings upon fluctuations in security prices.

这也是投资信托运动的矛盾之处。如果采用适当的管理技术，这些组织确实可以成为小投资者资金投放的合理渠道。但作为小投资者交易的上市证券，投资信托股票本身是一种极其不稳定的工具。显然，只有通过教育或有效提醒公众如何解读投资信托报告，才能控制这一问题。实现这一目标的前景并不乐观。

<!--en-->
Herein lies also a paradoxical difficulty of the investment-trust movement. Given a proper technique of management, these organizations may well prove a logical vehicle for the placing of small investor’s funds. But considered as a marketable security dealt in by small investors, the investment-trust stock itself is a dangerously volatile instrument. Apparently this troublesome factor can be held in check only by educating or by effectively cautioning the general public on the interpretation of investment-trust reports. The prospects of accomplishing this are none too bright.

**通过折价回购高级证券获得利润**。有时，企业通过以低于面值的价格回购自身高级证券获得可观利润。将此类收益计入当前收入确实是一种误导做法：首先，因为这些收益显然是非经常性；其次，这最多是一种可疑的利润来源，因为它是以公司自身证券持有人的利益为代价的。

<!--en-->
**Profits Through Repurchase of Senior Securities at a Discount.** At times a substantial profit is realized by corporations through the repurchase of their own senior securities at less than par value. The inclusion of such gains in current income is certainly a misleading practice, first, because they are obviously nonrecurring and, second, because this is at best a questionable sort of profit, since it is made at the expense of the company's own security holders.

*示例：* 早在1915年，控制着Utah Power and Light Company的控股公司Utah Securities Corporation就提供了一个关于这种会计做法的特殊例子。以下收入账户说明了这一点：

<!--en-->
*Example:* A peculiar example of this accounting practice was furnished as long ago as 1915 by Utah Securities Corporation, a holding company controlling Utah Power and Light Company. The following income account illustrates this point:

## 1915年3月31日结束的年度

<!--en-->

上述收入账户表明，Utah Securities的主要“收益”来自以折扣价回购自身债务。如果没有这一特殊项目，该公司将无法支付利息费用。

<!--en-->
The foregoing income account shows that the chief “earnings” of Utah Securities were derived from the repurchase of its own obligations at a discount. Had it not been for this extraordinary item the company would have failed to cover its interest charges.

在1931-1933年的经济萧条期间，大量以大幅折扣回购高级证券是独特特征之一。这得益于许多企业现金充足但收益不佳之间的巨大差异。由于后者，以低价出售的高级证券得以实现；由于前者，发行公司能够大量回购这些证券。这种做法在投资信托中最为明显。

<!--en-->
The widespread repurchases of senior securities at a substantial discount constituted one of the unique features of the 1931–1933 depression years. It was made possible by the disproportion that existed between the strong cash positions and the poor earnings of many enterprises. Because of the latter influence the senior securities sold at low prices, and because of the former the issuing companies were able to buy them back in large amounts. This practice was most in evidence among the investment trusts.

*示例：* 以美国国际证券公司为例，在1932年11月30日结束的财年中，该公司回购了不少于12,684,000美元的5%债券，占发行总量的近一半。平均支付价格约为55美元，操作显示利润约6,000,000美元，从而抵消了投资组合价值的下降。

<!--en-->
*Examples:* The International Securities Corporation of America, to use an outstanding example, repurchased in the fiscal year ending November 30, 1932, no less than $12,684,000 of its 5% bonds, representing nearly half of the issue. The average price paid was about 55, and the operation showed a profit of about $6,000,000, which served to offset the shrinkage in the value of the investment portfolio.

在工业领域，我们注意到Armour and Company 1932年的报告。报告显示净收益为1,633,000美元，但这只是将以大幅折扣购买的债券带来的5,520,000美元利润计入收入后的结果。同样，Goodrich Rubber、United Drug、Bush Terminal Building Company等公司1933年的净收益也大部分源于这一非经常性来源。United Cigar-Whelan Stores 1938年上半年报告中也披露了类似情况。⁶（不过，有些公司，如1933年的Gulf States Steel Corporation，则遵循更好的做法，将利润直接计入盈余。）

<!--en-->
In the industrial field we note the report of Armour and Company for 1932. This showed net earnings of $1,633,000 but only after including in income a profit of $5,520,000 on bonds bought in at a heavy discount. Similarly, more than all of the 1933 net of Goodrich Rubber, United Drug, Bush Terminal Building Company and others was ascribable to this nonrecurring source. A like condition was disclosed in the report of United Cigar-Whelan Stores for the first half of 1938.⁶ (Observe, on the other hand, that some companies, e.g., Gulf States Steel Corporation in 1933, have followed the better practice of crediting this profit direct to surplus.)

当高级证券以超过面值或声明价值的价格回购时，结果则相反。如果溢价金额较大，通常会从盈余中扣除，而不是从当前收入中扣除。

<!--en-->
A contrary result appears when senior securities are retired at a cost exceeding the face or stated value. When this premium involves a large amount, it is always charged against surplus and not against current income.

*示例：* 作为这种做法的突出例子，我们引用美国钢铁公司1929年对盈余计提的40,600,000美元费用，这与以110的价格回购其自身及附属公司3亿700万美元债券有关；还有Goodyear Tire and Rubber Company在1927年对盈余计提的9,600,000美元费用，这是因各种债券和优先股以溢价回购，并被新证券替代，这些新证券的票面利率和股息率较低所致。从分析师的角度来看，涉及公司自身证券的此类特殊交易中的利润或费用应被视为非经常性项目，在研究单一年度业绩时不应纳入运营结果。

<!--en-->
*Examples:* As prominent illustrations of this practice, we cite the charge of $40,600,000 against surplus made by United States Steel Corporation in 1929, in connection with the retirement at 110 of $307,000,000 of its own and subsidiaries' bonds, also the charge of $9,600,000 made against surplus in 1927 by Goodyear Tire and Rubber Company, growing out of the retirement at a premium of various bond and preferred-stock issues and their replacement by new securities bearing lower coupon and dividend rates. From the analyst's standpoint, either profit or expense in such special transactions involving the company's own securities should be regarded as nonrecurring and excluded from the operating results in studying a single year's performance.

*一个全面示例：* 美国机器与金属公司（本章前面提到的Manhattan Electrical Supply Company的继任者）在1932年的*收入*中包含了通过以折扣价回购自身债券获得的利润。由于1931年和1932年的报告充分展示了许多企业会计的随意性，我们在此完整复制收入账户及附带的资本和盈余调整项。

<!--en-->
*A Comprehensive Example.* American Machine and Metals, Inc. (successor to Manhattan Electrical Supply Company mentioned earlier in this chapter), included in itscurrent *income* for 1932 a profit realized from the repurchase of its own bonds at a discount. Because the reports for 1931 and 1932 illustrate to an unusual degree the arbitrary nature of much corporate accounting, we reproduce herewith in full the income account and the appended capital and surplus adjustments.

# 美国机器与金属公司1931年和1932年的报告

与1926年一样，我们在1932年再次发现一种极不可取的做法：将异常利润计入收入，同时将特殊损失计入盈余。在后续年份中，报告是否披露了特殊利润的性质——即通过以低于面值的价格回购债券获得的收益——并不重要。股东和股票买家大多只关注公司提供的每股盈利最终数值；他们也不太会仔细探究其计算方式。该公司1932年在盈余中计提的一些费用的重要性，将在后续相关标题中讨论。

<!--en-->
We find again in 1932, as in 1926, the highly objectionable practice of including extraordinary profits in income while charging special losses to surplus. It does not make muchdifference that in the later year the nature of the special profit —gain through repurchase of bonds at less than par— is disclosed in the report. Stockholders and stock buyers for the most part pay attention only to the final figure of earnings per share, as presented by the company; nor are they likely to inquire carefully into the manner in which it is determined. The significance of some of the charges made by this company against surplus in 1932 will be taken up later under the appropriate headings.

**其他非经常性项目。** 剩余的非经常性利润项目并不重要，无需详细讨论。大多数情况下，它们作为年度收益的一部分出现，还是作为应计入盈余的项目出现，并没有太大区别。

<!--en-->
**Other Nonrecurrent Items.** The remaining group of nonrecurrent profit items is not important enough to merit detailed discussion. In most cases it is of minor consequence whether they appear as part of the year's earnings or are credited to surplus where they properly belong.

*示例：* Gimbel Brothers在1938年的收入中包含了167,660美元的人寿保险收益，并将其称为“非贸易项目”。另一方面，United Merchants and Manufacturers在1938财年收到了1,579,000美元的类似款项，更合理地将其计入盈余——尽管其经营亏损很大。

<!--en-->
*Examples:* Gimbel Brothers included the sum of $167,660, proceeds of life insurance policies, in income for 1938, designating it as a “non-trading item.” On the other hand, United Merchants and Manufacturers, receiving a similar payment of $1,579,000 in its 1938 fiscal year, more soundly credited it to surplus—although it had sustained a large loss from operations.

Bendix Aviation Corporation在1929年的报告中将通过专利诉讼获得的901,282美元计入收入；1931年又将通过诉讼获得的242,656美元回扣计入当前收益。Gulf Oil Corporation在1932年的收益中包含了5,512,000美元，代表之前处于诉讼中的石油价值。通过这一被指定为非经常性项目的项目，它能够将2,768,000美元的亏损转化为2,743,000美元的利润。虽然税收返还通常仅作为盈余的贷方项目显示，但由此获得的累积利息有时会出现在收入账户中，例如E. I. du Pont de Nemours and Company在1926年报告的2,000,000美元，以及United States Steel在1930年收益中未明确但显然更大的一笔金额。¹ 当没有收益或金额远低于“正常水平”时，华尔街不得不采用本质上更合理的估值方法，即重视*平均*盈利能力、营运资金等。但这属于*例外*程序。

<!--en-->
Bendix Aviation Corporation reported as income for the year 1929 the sum of $901,282 received in settlement of a patent suit, and again in 1931 it included in current earnings an amount $242,656 paid to it as back royalties collected through litigation. The 1932 earnings of Gulf Oil Corporation included the sum of $5,512,000 representing the value of oil previously in litigation. By means of this item, designated as nonrecurrent, it was able to turn a loss of $2,768,000 into a profit of $2,743,000. Although tax refunds are regularly shown as credits to surplus only, the accumulated interest received thereon sometimes appears as part of the income account, e.g., $2,000,000 reported by E. I. du Pont de Nemours and Company in 1926 and an unstated but apparently much larger sum included in the earnings of United States Steel for 1930.
¹ Where there are no earnings or where the amount is recognized as being far below “normal,” Wall Street is reluctantly compelled to apply what is at bottom a more rational method of valuation, *i.e.*, one ascribing greater weight to *average* earning power, working capital, etc. But this is the *exceptional* procedure.

² 近年来，审计报表中出现了几起对收益和流动资产严重虚报的情况——尤其是1938年McKesson and Robbins公司的案例。（Interstate Hosiery Mills和Illinois Zinc Corporation也是1938年发现的例子。）尽管McKesson and Robbins丑闻造成了轰动效应，但必须承认，在很长一段时间内，只有极小比例的上市公司涉及此类欺诈行为。

<!--en-->
² In recent years several instances of gross overstatements of earnings and current assets in audited statements have come to light—notably the case of McKesson and Robbins Company in 1938. (Interstate Hosiery Mills and Illinois Zinc Corporation are other examples also uncovered in 1938.) Despite the sensational impression caused by the McKesson and Robbins scandal, it must be recognized that over a long period of years only an infinitesimal percentage of publicly owned companies have been involved in frauds of this character.

³ 1933年《证券法》和1934年《证券交易法》明确授权委员会规定在向S.E.C.和交易所提交注册公司报告时，如何区分经常性项目和非经常性项目[1933年法案第19(a)条和1934年法案第13(b)条]。初始注册表格（A-1、A-2和10）及年度报告表格（10-K）要求将非经常性损益项目分开置于收入账户中。

<!--en-->
³ The Securities Act of 1933 and the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 specifically empower the Commission to prescribe the methods to be followed in differentiating between recurrent and nonrecurrent items in the reports of registered companies which must be filed with the S.E.C. and with the exchanges [Sec. 19(a) of the 1933 act and Sec. 13(b) of the 1934 act]. The initial registration forms (A-1, A-2 and 10) and the annual report form (10-K) require separation of nonrecurrent profit-and-loss items within the income account.

<!--en-->

CHAPTER 32

# 特别损失与

<!--en-->
*Extraordinary Losses and*

收入账户中的其他特殊项目 非经常性损失问题可能会在收入账户分析中产生特殊困难。库存和应收账款的减记应在多大程度上被视为不应计入年度经营结果的特别扣除项？在灾难性年份1932年，几乎所有企业都进行了此类扣减。所使用的会计方法存在很大差异，但大多数公司尽可能保留其收入账户，将这些损失从盈余中扣除。另一方面，1937–1938年经济衰退期间较温和的库存损失几乎普遍被计入收益表。

<!--en-->
Other Special Items in the
Income Account
THE QUESTION OF NONRECURRENT LOSSES is likely to create peculiar difficulties in the analysis of income accounts. To what extent should write-downs of inventories and receivables be regarded as extraordinary deductions not fairly chargeable against the year's operating results? In the disastrous year 1932 such charge-offs were made by nearly every business. The accounting methods used showed wide divergences, but the majority of companies spared their income accounts as much as possible and subtracted these losses from surplus. On the other hand the milder inventory losses of the 1937–1938 recession were almost universally charged into the earnings statement.

库存损失与业务经营直接相关，因此性质绝非特别。1931–1932年库存价值的下降可能在*程度*上被视为特别的，就像整体经营结果异常一样。由此可推知，如果考虑1931–1932年的结果，例如计算长期平均值时，所有库存和应收账款的损失必须被视为那几年经营亏损的一部分，即使它们被计入盈余。在第37章中，我们将探讨特殊年份对确定平均盈利能力的影响。

<!--en-->
Inventory losses are directly related to the conduct of the business and are, therefore, by no means extraordinary in their general character. The collapse of inventory values in 1931–1932 might be considered extraordinary in its *extent*, in the same way as the business results as a whole were exceptional. It follows from this reasoning that if the 1931–1932 results are taken into account at all, *e.g.*, in computing a long-term average, all losses on inventories and receivables must be considered part of the operating deficit of those years even though charged to surplus. In Chap. 37 we shall consider the role of extraordinary years in determining the average earning power.

**制造收益**。第31章详细介绍了美国机器与金属公司在1932年对盈余进行的批发扣减，这表明该年可能进行了*过度*的亏损准备，目的是为未来的收入账户带来好处。如果1932年12月31日将应收账款和库存减记到过低的数值，这种人为较低的“成本价格”会在后续年份导致利润虚增。通过以下假设数字可以明确这一点：

<!--en-->
**Manufactured Earnings.** An examination of the wholesale charges made against surplus in 1932 by American Machine and Metals, detailed in Chap. 31, suggests the possibility that *excessive* provision for losses may have been made in that year with the intention of benefiting future income accounts. If the receivables and inventories were written down to an unduly low figure on December 31, 1932, this artificially low “cost price” would give rise to a correspondingly inflated profit in the following years. This point may be made clear by the use of hypothetical figures as follows:

上述例子说明了一整套可能属于最恶劣会计操纵行为的做法。简而言之，就是从盈余（甚至资本）中提取金额，然后将这些金额作为收入报告。对盈余的扣减未被注意到；计入收入的款项可能对公司证券的市场价格产生决定性影响。¹我们稍后会指出，“保守”的资产减记正是如此，它允许降低折旧费用，从而增加表面收益。这种会计方法的危险更为严重，因为公众很少意识到它们，即使是专业分析师也难以发现，且无法通过立法或证券交易所纠正。

<!--en-->
The foregoing example illustrates a whole set of practices that constitute perhaps the most vicious type of accounting manipulation. They consist, in brief, of taking sums out of surplus (or even capital) and then reporting these same sums as income. The charge to surplus goes unnoticed; the credit to income may have a determining influence upon the market price of the securities of the company.¹ We shall later point out that the “conservative” writing down of the property account has precisely this result, in that it permits a decreased depreciation charge and hence an increase in the apparent earnings. The dangers inherent in accounting methods of this sort are the more serious because they are so little realized by the public, so difficult to detect even by the expert analyst and so impervious to legislative or stock-exchange correction.

以报告每股收益作为普通股价值的基准，使管理层更容易任意且不健康地控制股票价格水平。虽然应强调绝大多数管理层是诚实的，但同样需要强调的是，宽松或“有目的”的会计是一种高度传染的疾病。

<!--en-->
The basing of common-stock values on reported per-share earnings has made it much easier for managements to exercise an arbitrary and unwholesome control over the price level of their shares. Whereas it should be emphasized that the overwhelming majority of managements are honest, it must beemphasized also that loose or “purposive” accounting is a highly contagious disease.

**库存损失储备。** 库存损失的会计处理往往因在实际损失发生之前就设置储备而变得复杂。这些储备通常是通过从盈余账户中扣除来创建的，其理论依据是盈余账户应作为一种应急储备，以吸收未来不寻常的损失。如果后来确实发生了库存减少，自然会从已创建的储备中扣除以弥补这一损失。结果是，*没有任何一年*收入账户会反映库存损失，尽管这同样属于运营风险，就像销售价格下降一样。当公司通过盈余账户——无论是直接还是通过储备机制——来处理库存损失时，分析师必须仔细考虑这一做法，尤其是在比较公开数据与其他公司的数据时。一个很好的例证是，美国橡胶公司和固特异轮胎橡胶公司在1925-1927年期间的报告对比，那段时间橡胶价格波动很大。

<!--en-->
**Reserves for Inventory Losses.** The accounting for inventory losses is frequently complicated by the use of reserves set up before the loss is actually realized. These reserves are usually created by a charge to surplus, on the theory that it is a function of the surplus account to act as a sort of contingency reserve to absorb unusual future losses. If later the inventory shrinkage actually takes place, it is naturally charged against the reserve already created to meet it. The result is that in *no year* does the income account reflect the inventory loss, although it is just as much a hazard of operations as a decline in selling prices. When a company charges inventory losses to surplus—whether directly or through the intermediary of a reserve device—the analyst must take this practice carefully into account, especially in comparing the published results with those of other companies. A good illustration of this rule is afforded by a comparison of the reports submitted by United States Rubber Company and by Goodyear Tire and Rubber Company for the years 1925–1927, during which time rubber prices were subject to wide fluctuations.

在这三年中，固特异将总计11,500,000美元作为原材料价格下跌的储备计入*收益*。其中一半用于弥补实际发生的损失，另一半结转至1928年（最终在1930年用完）。

<!--en-->
In these three years Goodyear charged against *earnings* a total of $11,500,000 as reserves against decline of raw-material prices. Of this amount one-half was used to absorb actual losses sustained and the other half was carried forward into 1928 (and eventually used up in 1930).

美国橡胶公司在这一时期共计提了20,446,000美元的库存储备和减记，所有这些都被实际损失所抵消。但向股东提交的年度报表形式排除了这些扣款，将其表现为盈余的特殊调整。（此外，在1927年，891万美元的库存损失似乎被来自*过去*生胶子公司收益的800万美元特别贷方抵消了。）

<!--en-->
United States Rubber during this period charged a total of $20,446,000 for inventory reserves and write-downs, all of which was absorbed by actual losses taken. But the form of annual statement, as submitted to the stockholders, excluded these deductions from income and made them appear as special adjustments of surplus. (In 1927, moreover, the inventory loss of $8,910,000 was apparently offset by a special credit of $8,000,000 from the transfer of *past* earnings of the crude-rubber producing subsidiary.)

为了进行正确的比较，报表必须明确基于相同的基础，或尽可能接近。可以通过以下三种方法进行比较：

<!--en-->
For proper comparative purposes the statements must manifestly be considered on an identical basis, or as close thereto as possible. Such a comparison might be made by three possible methods, *viz.*:

1. 如美国橡胶公司报告的那样，即从当前收入账户中排除库存储备和损失。
2. 如固特异报告的那样，即通过将高生胶价格时期的收益减去未来损失储备，并使用该储备来弥补后来的减少。
3. 消除这些储备，作为管理层试图平衡收益的任意行为。基于这种基础，库存损失将从实际发生损失的年份的结果中扣除。（标准统计公司对固特异的分析包括根据这种方法对报告收益进行了修正。）因此，为了比较目的，我们有三个该时期每股收益的报表：

<!--en-->
1. As reported by United States Rubber, *i.e.*, excluding inventory reserves and losses from the current income account.
2. As reported by Goodyear, *i.e.*, reducing the earnings of the period of high prices for crude rubber by a reserve for future losses and using this reserve to absorb the later shrinkage.
3. Eliminating such reserves, as an arbitrary effort of the management to level out the earnings. On this basis the inventory losses would be deducted from the results of the year in which they were actually sustained. (The Standard Statistics Company's analysis of Goodyear includes a revision of the reported earnings in conformity with this approach.)

最近，美国橡胶公司采用了古德耶公司的做法，从盈利丰厚的年份中提取一笔储备金，用于应对未来库存减少的情况。由于这一政策，该公司对1935年和1936年的收益有所低估，但对1937年的收益则高估了。

<!--en-->
More recently United States Rubber has followed the Goodyear practice of taking out of the earnings of prosperous years a reserve for future inventory shrinkage. As a result of this policy, the company somewhat understated its earnings for 1935 and 1936 but overstated them for 1937.

*更近期的对比。*包装行业展示了两家公司处理未来库存损失问题的方法存在更极端的差异。

<!--en-->
*A More Recent Contrast.* The packing industry supplies us with a more extreme divergence in the method used by two companies to handle the matter of probable future inventory losses.

威尔逊公司在其1934财年开始前设立了75万美元的储备金，用于“库存估值波动”。这部分资金部分来自盈余，部分来自收入。1934年，该公司通过此储备金减少了期初库存，从而使当年报告的利润增加了75万美元。然而，SEC要求该公司修改注册报表，将这笔金额计入盈余而非收入。

<!--en-->
Wilson and Company set up a reserve of $750,000 prior to the beginning of its 1934 fiscal year, for “Fluctuation in Inventory Valuation.” This was taken partly from surplus and partly from income. In 1934 it reduced its opening inventory by this reserve, thus increasing the year’s reported profit by $750,000. The S.E.C., however, required it to amend itsregistration statement so as to credit this amount to surplus and not to income.

另一方面，斯威夫特公司在其1933–1935财年报告的收入减少了16,767,000美元，这笔钱是作为未来库存下降的储备金设立的。1938年确实发生了预期中的库存下降；但该公司没有使用这笔储备金来避免影响收入账户，而是将全部损失计入当年运营费用，然后将1100万美元直接转入盈余。在这种特殊情况下，1933–1938六年的净收入被*低估*了，因为实际是从收入中拿出资金转至盈余。² **库存会计的其他要素。**企业报告的研究者必须熟悉处理库存时两种不同于常规会计做法的变式。众所周知，标准程序是在年末按成本或市场价较低者进行库存盘点。“销售成本”则是将采购额加上期初库存，再减去按上述方式评估的期末库存得出。

<!--en-->
On the other hand, Swift and Company reduced its reported earnings in the fiscal years 1933–1935 by $16,767,000, which was set up as a reserve for future inventory decline. In 1938 the expected decline occurred; but instead of drawing on this reserve to spare the income account, the company charged the full loss against the year’s operations and then transferred $11,000,000 of the reserve directly to surplus. In this exceptional case the net income for the six-year period 1933–1938 was *understated*, since amounts were actually taken out of income and turned over to surplus.²
**Other Elements in Inventory Accounting.** The student of corporate reports must familiarize himself with two permissible variations from the usual accounting practice in handling inventories. As is well known, the standard procedure consists of taking inventory at the close of the year at the lower of cost or market. The “cost of goods sold” is then found by adding purchases to the opening inventory and subtracting the closing inventory, valued as described.

*先入先出法。*这种方法的第一个变式是将*最近购买*的商品的实际支付金额作为销售成本。这种方法的理论是，商家的售价主要与当前替换价格或商品最近的成本相关。这一点只有在年度单位价值发生重大变化时才重要；它不会影响长期报告的总利润，只会影响一年与另一年之间的利润分配；它可能有助于通过避免库存波动导致的损益交替来减少所得税。³ *正常库存或基础库存方法。*过去几年中，许多公司采用了一种更激进的方法来最小化库存价值的波动。这种方法基于这样的理论：公司必须定期保持一定数量的实物库存，由于市场变化，没有必要像因价格指数涨跌而调整制造工厂的价值那样，每年改变“正常库存”的价值——也不需要在年度运营中反映这种变化。为了让基础库存保持固定数值，通常将其定价为非常低的单位价格水平——低到永远不需要进一步降低以匹配当前市场水平。

<!--en-->
*Last-In, First-Out.* The first variation from this method consists of taking as the cost of goods sold the actual amount paid for the *most recently acquired* lots. The theory behind this method is that a merchant’s selling price is related mainly to the current replacement price or the recent cost of the article sold. The point is of importance only when there are substantial changes in unit values from year to year; it cannot affect the aggregate reported profits over a long period but only the division of results from one year to another; it may be useful in reducing income tax by avoiding alternations of loss and profit due to inventory fluctuations.³
*The Normal-Stock or Basic-Stock Inventory Method.* A more radical method of minimizing fluctuations due to inventory values has been followed by a considerable number of companies for some years past. This method is based on the theory that the company must regularly carry a certain physical stock of materials and that there is no more reason tovary the value of this “normal stock” from year to year—because of market changes—than there would be to vary the value of the manufacturing plant as the price index rises or falls and to reflect this change in the year’s operations. In order to permit the base inventory to be carried at an unchanging figure, the practice is to mark it down to a very low unit price level—so low that it should never be necessary to reduce it further to get it down to current market.

早在1913年，National Lead Company就将这种方法应用于其库存的三种主要成分：铅、锡和锑。此后，American Smelting and Refining Company及American Metals Company也采用了这一方法。在1930年棉花市场崩溃之前，一些新英格兰棉纺厂也采取类似政策，以非常低的基准价格持有原棉和加工产品。1936年，Plymouth Cordage Company在1933–1935年采用类似政策后，开始使用正常库存方法；为了具体说明，我们在附录注49中提供了该公司在1930–1939年的相关数据。

<!--en-->
As long ago as 1913 National Lead Company applied this method to the three principal constituents of its inventory, *viz.*, lead, tin and antimony. The method was subsequently adopted also by American Smelting and Refining Company and American Metals Company. Some of the New England cotton mills had followed a like policy, prior to the collapse in the cotton market in 1930, by carrying their raw cotton and work in process at very low base prices. In 1936 the Plymouth Cordage Company adopted the normal-stock inventory method, after following a somewhat similar policy in 1933–1935; and for purpose of concrete illustration we supply the relevant data for this company, covering the years 1930–1939, in Appendix Note 49.

**闲置工厂费用。** 持有非运营资产的成本几乎总是从收入中扣除。许多1932年的报表中都有此项下的大量扣除额。

<!--en-->
**Idle-Plant Expense.** The cost of carrying nonoperating properties is almost always charged against income. Many statements for 1932 earmarked substantial deductions under this heading.

*示例：* Youngstown Sheet and Tube Company报告称，因“闲置的工厂、矿山及其他资产的维护费用、保险和税费”而支出2,759,000美元。Stewart Warner Corporation在1932年采取了特殊政策，将“当年未用于生产的工厂设施折旧”费用作为盈余从收入中扣除，金额为309,000美元。Botany Worsted Mills的1938年报告中也将“闲置成本”作为收入项目列示，称为“闲置费用”。

<!--en-->
*Examples:* Youngstown Sheet and Tube Company reported a charge of $2,759,000 for “Maintenance Expense, Insurance and Taxes of Plants, Mines, and Other Properties that were Idle.” Stewart Warner Corporation followed the exceptional policy of charging against *surplus* in 1932, instead of income, the sum of $309,000 for “Depreciation of Plant Facilities not used in current year’s production.” The 1938 report of Botany Worsted Mills contained a charge against income of $166,732, picturesquely termed “cost of idleness.”

分析师可以认为闲置工厂费用属于与常规收入费用不同的类别。至少从理论上讲，这些费用应该是临时性的，因此是非经常性性质的。

<!--en-->
The analyst may properly consider idle-plant expense as belonging to a somewhat different category from ordinary charges against income. In theory, at least, these expenses should be of a temporary and therefore nonrecurring type.

推测管理层可以随时通过处置或放弃这些资产来终止这些损失。如果公司暂时选择花钱维持这些资产，期望未来价值能弥补投入成本，那么将这些资产视为永久负债似乎不合逻辑——即视为对公司盈利能力永久的拖累，使得股票价值远低于这些“资产”不存在时的价值。

<!--en-->
Presumably the management can terminate these losses at any time by disposing of or abandoning the property. If, for the time being, the company elects to spend money to carry these assets along in the expectation that future value will justify the outlay, it does not seem logical to consider these assets as equivalent to a permanent liability, *i.e.*, as a permanent drag upon the company's earning power, which makes the stock worth considerably less than it would be if these "assets" did not exist.

*示例：* 纽约管道运输公司的案例说明了这一点的实际意义。1926年，由于新的竞争环境，它失去了以前主要线路所运输的所有业务，该线路随即成为“闲置工厂”。该资产的折旧、税费和其他费用非常高昂，以至于抵消了公司其他盈利资产（包括较小的管道线路和高等级债券投资）的收益。这导致了明显的净亏损，并导致分红被派发。因此，股票价格下降到了远低于公司仅持有现金和市场证券的价值。在股市的非批判性评估中，闲置资产被视为严重的永久负债。

<!--en-->
*Example:* The practical implications of this point are illustrated by the case of New York Transit Company, a carrier of oil by pipe line. In 1926, owing to new competitive conditions, it lost all the business formerly carried by its principal line, which thereupon became "idle plant." The depreciation, taxes and other expenses of this property were so heavy as to absorb the earnings of the company's other profitable assets (consisting of a smaller pipe line and high-grade-bond investments). This created an apparent net loss and caused the dividend to be passed. The price of the stock accordingly declined to a figure far less than the company's holdings of cash and marketable securities alone. In this uncritical appraisal by the stock market, the idle asset was considered equivalent to a serious and permanent liability.

然而，在1928年，董事会决定结束这些高额的持有费用，并成功以大量资金出售了未使用的管道线路。此后，股东获得了每股72美元的特别现金分配（几乎是1926年和1927年平均市价的两倍），并且仍保留对恢复正常分红的盈利业务的所有权。即使没有从闲置资产中获得任何收益，仅仅放弃它就会使股票价值大幅上升。

<!--en-->
In 1928, however, the directors determined to put an end to these heavy carrying charges and succeeded in selling the unused pipe line for a substantial sum of money. Thereafter, the stockholders received special cash distributions aggregating $72 per share (nearly twice the average market price for 1926 and 1927), and they still retained ownership of a profitable business which resumed regular dividends. Even if no money had been realized from the idle property, its mere abandonment would have led to a considerable increase in the value of the shares.

这是一个令人印象深刻的例子，尽管有些极端，体现了安全分析在发现内在价值与市场价格差异方面的实际作用。人们通常非常尊重地称其为“市场的无血判决”，仿佛它总是无数精明、知情且善于计算的人们的综合判断。然而，这些评估往往基于群众心理、错误的推理和对不足信息的肤浅分析。分析师通常无法有效运用其技术来纠正或利用这些常见错误，因为周围环境变化如此迅速，他的结论可能在他获利之前就变得不再适用。但在特殊情况下，如我们最后一个例子所示，事实和案例逻辑足够明确，足以让人对其分析的实用价值有高度信心。

<!--en-->
This is an impressive, if somewhat extreme, example of the practical utility of security analysis in detecting discrepancies between intrinsic value and market price. It is customary to refer with great respect to the "bloodless verdict of the market place," as though it represented invariably the composite judgment of countless shrewd, informed andcalculating minds. Very frequently, however, these appraisals are based on mob psychology, on faulty reasoning, and on the most superficial examination of inadequate information. The analyst, on his side, is usually unable to apply his technique effectively to correcting or taking advantage of these popular errors, for the reason that surrounding conditions change so rapidly that his own conclusions may become inapplicable before he can profit by them. But in the exceptional case, as illustrated by our last example, the facts and the logic of the case may be sharply enough defined to warrant a high degree of confidence in the practical value of his analysis.

**递延费用。** 企业有时会产生可以认为适用于多个年度而非单次12个月期间的费用。此项下可能包括以下费用：

<!--en-->
**Deferred Charges.** A business sometimes incurs expenses that may fairly be considered as applicable to a number of years following rather than to the single 12-month period in which the outlay was made. Under this heading might be included the following:

组织费用（法律费用等）、搬迁费用、开发费用（用于新产品或流程开发，也用于矿山建设等）。已售债券的折扣。在经批准的会计方法下，这些费用会在适当年限内分摊。相关金额会作为递延费用计入资产负债表，随后通过年度费用从收益中冲销。对于债券折扣，期间由债券发行期限决定；矿山开发费用则按开采吨数比例分摊。对于大多数其他项目，年限需任意确定，五年是常见数值。

<!--en-->
Organization expense (legal fees, etc.).
Moving expenses.
Development expenses (for new products or processes, also for opening up a mine, etc.).
Discount on obligations sold.
Under approved accounting methods such costs are spread over an appropriate period of years. The amount involved is entered upon the balance sheet as a Deferred Charge, which is written off by annual charges against earnings. In the case of bond-discount the period is fixed by the life of the issue; mine development expenses are similarly prorated on the basis of the tonnage mined. For most other items the number of years must be arbitrarily taken, five years being a customary figure.

为了消除这些年度扣除对报告收益的影响，通常将适用于未来几年的费用作为单一费用从盈余中冲销。理论上这种做法不妥，因为它会导致后续年份运营费用被低估，从而夸大净收入。例如，如果总裁的薪酬提前十年支付，且全部支出作为“特殊费用”从盈余中冲销，那么下一期间的利润就会被高估。⁴ 还存在一种风险：经常重复发生的费用，如广告活动或新汽车型号开发成本，可能通过将其指定为递延费用然后从盈余中冲销而从收入账户中消失。⁵ 通常，此类会计交易涉及的金额并不大，不足以让分析师特别关注。证券分析是一项非常实际的工作，不应纠结于不太可能影响最终判断的事情。然而有时，这些项目可能会变得相当重要。*例如：*卡夫奶酪公司在1927年之前的某些年份，将大部分广告支出作为递延费用，在后续年份中摊销。1926年，该公司花费约1,000,000美元进行广告，仅将一半金额作为当前收入冲销。但同年，这笔支出的余额从盈余中扣除，此外还额外冲销了480,000美元，以抵消前几年作为递延费用保留的余额。通过这种方式，公司能够向股东报告1926年的收入为1,071,000美元。但在次年申请上市时，发现需要采用更可靠的报告方式向纽约证券交易所披露收入，因此1926年的利润重新核算为461,296美元，而非1,071,000美元。国际电话电报公司1932年的报告显示，有各种费用*从盈余中冲销*，总计35,817,000美元，包括以下内容：“冲销某些如今没有实际价值的递延费用，尽管最初根据公认的会计原则设定要在多年内摊销。”

<!--en-->
In order to relieve the reported earnings of these annual deductions it has become common practice to write off such expense applicable to future years by a single charge against surplus. In theory this practice is improper, because it results in the understatement of operating expenses for a succeeding period of years and hence in the exaggeration of the net income. If, to take a simple example, the president's salary were paid for ten years in advance and the entire outlay charged against surplus as a "special expense," it is clear thatthe profits of the ensuing period would thereby be overstated.⁴
There is the danger also that expenses of a character frequently repeated, *e.g.*, advertising campaigns, or cost of developing new automobile models, might be omitted from the income account by designating them as deferred charges and then writing them off against surplus.⁵
Ordinarily the amounts involved in such accounting transactions are not large enough to warrant the analyst's making an issue of them. Security analysis is a severely practical activity, and it must not linger over matters that are not likely to affect the ultimate judgment. At times however,
these items may assume appreciable importance.
*Examples:* The Kraft Cheese Company for example,
during some years prior to 1927 carried a substantial part of its advertising outlays as a deferred charge to be absorbed in the operations of subsequent years. In 1926 it spent about
$1,000,000 for advertising and charged only one-half of this amount against current income. But in the same year the balance of this expenditure was deducted from surplus, and furthermore an additional $480,000 was similarly written off against surplus to cancel the balance carried forward from prior years as a deferred charge. By this means the company was able to report to its stockholders the sum of $1,071,000 as earned for 1926. But when in the following year it applied to list additional shares, it found it necessary to adopt a less questionable basis of reporting its income to the New York
Stock Exchange, so that its profit for 1926 was restated to read
$461,296, instead of $1,071,000.
The 1932 report of International Telephone and Telegraph
Company showed various charges *against surplus* aggregating
$35,817,000, which included the following: "Write-off of certain deferred charges that have today no tangible value although originally set up to be amortized over a period of years in accordance with accepted accounting principles,

4,655,696美元。哈德逊汽车公司在1930-1931年期间将以下项目（包括其他项目）从盈余中冲销，而不是计入收入。

<!--en-->
$4,655,696."
Hudson Motor Car Company charged against surplus instead of income the following items (among others) during
1930–1931.

<table><tr><td>1930</td><td>因开发新模型而对工具和材料进行的特别调整</td><td>$2,266,000</td></tr><tr><td>1931</td><td>特殊工具的储备金</td><td>2,000,000</td></tr><tr><td></td><td>工厂设备的重新布局</td><td>633,000</td></tr><tr><td></td><td>特殊广告</td><td>1,400,000</td></tr></table>

<!--en-->
<table><tr><td>1930</td><td>Special adjustment of tools and materials due to development of new models</td><td>$2,266,000</td></tr><tr><td>1931</td><td>Reserve for special tools</td><td>2,000,000</td></tr><tr><td></td><td>Rearrangement of plant equipment</td><td>633,000</td></tr><tr><td></td><td>Special advertising</td><td>1,400,000</td></tr></table>

1933年，赫克产品公司（当时称为金尘公司）从盈余中拨款2,000,000美元，作为“新产品引入和开发净成本”的储备金。其中约四分之三在1933-1936年间使用，剩余部分转入“一般和应急储备”。

<!--en-->
In 1933 Hecker Products (then called Gold Dust Corporation) appropriated out of surplus the sum of $2,000,000 as a reserve for the “net cost of introduction and exploitation of new products.” About three-quarters of this amount was expended in years 1933–1936, and the balance then transferred to “General and Contingency Reserves.”

这些会计做法的效果是，使报告收益不再包含大多数公司目前需要冲销的费用，无论如何这些费用都应在短期内分期计入收益中。

<!--en-->
The effect of these accounting practices is to relieve the reported earnings of expenditures that most companies charge currently thereagainst, and that in any event should be charged against earnings in installments over a short period of years.

**债券折扣的摊销。**债券通常由企业以低于面值的价格发行。所承受的折扣是借款成本的一部分，即利息负担的一部分，应按照债券发行期限，通过每年从收益中冲销的方式摊销，并包含在支付的利息报表中。过去认为，通过单一费用从盈余中冲销债券折扣是“保守的做法”，以免在资产负债表上将如此无形的项目列为资产。最近，出于相反的原因，即消除未来年度对收益的扣除，这些从盈余中冲销的做法变得流行，从而让股票显得更“有价值”。

<!--en-->
**Amortization of Bond Discount.** Bonds are usually floated by corporations at a price to net the treasury less than par. The discount suffered is part of the cost of borrowing the money, *i.e.*, part of the interest burden, and it should be amortized over the life of the bond issue by an annual charge against earnings, included with the statement of interest paid. It was formerly considered “conservative” to write off such bond discounts by a single charge against surplus, in order not to show so intangible an item among the assets on the balance sheet. More recently these write-offs against surplus have become popular for the opposite reason, *viz.*, to eliminate future annual deductions from earnings and in that way to make the shares more “valuable.”

*示例：* 1932年，Associated Gas and Electric Company将5,892,000美元用于“债务折扣和费用”的核销，作为盈余处理。

<!--en-->
*Example:* Associated Gas and Electric Company charged against surplus in 1932 the sum of $5,892,000 for “debt discount and expense” written off.

近年来，这种做法引发了纽约证券交易所和SEC的广泛批评。由于这些反对意见，许多公司重新将之前对盈余的计入改为不计入，并再次将债券折扣摊销每年作为收益处理。⁶ ¹ 美国工业酒精公司1932年及后续年度的报告显示，情况与这里描述的类似。该公司在1932年改变了常规做法，从盈余中设立150万美元的储备金，以将糖蜜库存降至当前市场估计价值。（此前该项目一直按成本计价。）后续报告指出，1933年、1934年和1935年的收益分别因此储备金获得了772,000美元、677,000美元和51,000美元的收益。值得注意的是，1934年的所得税基于比报告利润少677,000美元的金额。（参见第六版第626–627页，了解该公司会计方法对其1929–1938年每股收益影响的详细总结。）

<!--en-->
This practice has aroused considerable criticism in recent years both from the New York Stock Exchange and from the S.E.C. As a result of these objections a number of companies have reversed their previous charge to surplus and are again charging amortization of bond discounts annually against earnings.⁶
¹ The United States Industrial Alcohol Company reports for 1932 and subsequent years reflect a situation somewhat similar to that here suggested. This company departed from its usual practice in 1932 by setting up a reserve for $1,500,000 out of surplus to reduce molasses inventory to estimated current market value. (Previously this item had regularly been carried at cost.) Later reports state that earnings for 1933, 1934 and 1935 had benefited by this reserve to the extent of $772,000, $677,000 and $51,000 respectively. Significantly, income tax for 1934 was based on $677,000 less than the reported profit. (See pp. 626–627 in the sixth edition for a broad summary of the effect of this company’s accounting methods on its reported per-share earnings for the years 1929–1938.)

² Standard Statistics重新编制了Swift的年度报告，将1933–1935年库存下降的扣除项列为*盈余*的支出。

<!--en-->
² Standard Statistics has restated the Swift annual reports by listing the 1933–1935 deductions for inventory declines as charges to *surplus*.

³ 根据1938年和1939年的税收法案，企业首次被允许使用这种所谓的“后进先出”方法，适用于1939年及后续年份。附录注释48给出了一个假设示例，说明两种库存方法的区别。

<!--en-->
³ Corporations were first permitted to use this so-called “last-in, first-out” method by the terms of the Revenue Acts of 1938 and 1939, applying to 1939 and subsequent years. A hypothetical example to illustrate the difference between the two inventory methods is given in Appendix Note 48.

⁴ 关于Interstate Department Stores在1934–1936年采用的会计方法细节，请参见附录注释50，这些方法与上述假设案例有些相似。

<!--en-->
⁴ See Appendix Note 50 for details of accounting methods followed by Interstate Department Stores in 1934–1936, which resembled somewhat the hypothetical case given above.

⁵ 类似的反对意见也针对将关闭连锁店单位产生的损失计入盈余的做法。*示例：*F. G. Shattuck Company在1935年为此目的计入了326,000美元的支出。这似乎是连锁企业常见的开支，因为这些企业经常增加或关闭门店。

<!--en-->
⁵ A similar objection lies against the practice of charging against surplus the loss incurred in closing chain-store units. *Example:* The charge of $326,000 made by F. G. Shattuck Company for this purpose in 1935. This would seem to be a recurrent expense of chain-store enterprises, which frequently add and close down units.

⁶ 参见北方州电力公司（明尼苏达州）在1984年发行债券时因此问题引发争议后改变的会计做法。（涉及的总金额超过8,000,000美元。）还值得注意的是，*即使对于已到期债券*，公司也被要求将未摊销的折扣结转，并在赎回期间每年将其作为收益处理。（参见Columbia Gas and Electric Company 1936年的报告，第17页。）

<!--en-->
⁶ See the changed accounting practice of Northern States Power Company (Minnesota) following a controversy over this point in connection with the registration of a bond issue in 1984. (The total amount involved here was over $8,000,000.) It is noteworthy, also, that *even on called bonds* companies have been required to carry forward the unamortized discount to be written off by an annual charge against earnings during the life of the refunding issue. (See the report of Columbia Gas and Electric Company for 1936, p. 17.)

近年来的一些债券赎回似乎在考虑支付赎回旧债券的溢价后，净节省的利息非常少。或许这些操作的解释在于：(1) 公司能够将支付的溢价和原始折扣余额计入盈余，从而减轻未来收益的实际负担；(2) 这两项都计入利润，需缴纳*所得税*，从而大幅降低所得税，增加*表面*年度利润。章节33

<!--en-->
Some of the bond refundings in recent years seem to have involved a surprisingly small net saving of interest when the premium paid to retire the old issue is taken into account. Perhaps an explanation of some of these operations lies in the fact that (1) the company has been able to charge both the premium paid and the balance of the original discount against surplus, thus relieving future earnings of this very real burden; and (2) both these items have been chargeable to profits subject to *income tax*, thus reducing this tax substantially and increasing the *apparent* profits for the year.
CHAPTER 33

# 误导性的手段在

<!--en-->
*Misleading Artifices in the*

收益账户中。子公司的收益 **明显的收入账户虚增示例。** 在相对罕见的情况下，管理层会通过在收益中包含实际上不存在的项目来虚增收入账户。据我们所知，最明显的此类案例发生在Park and Tilford, Inc.的1929–1930年报告中，该公司股票在纽约证券交易所上市。这些年份中，该公司报告的净利润如下：

<!--en-->
Income Account. Earnings of
Subsidiaries
**Flagrant Example of Padded Income Account.** On comparatively rare occasions, managements resort to padding their income account by including items in earnings that have no real existence. Perhaps the most flagrant instance of this kind that has come to our knowledge occurred in the 1929–1930 reports of Park and Tilford, Inc., an enterprise with shares listed on the New York Stock Exchange. For these years the company reported net income as follows:

$$1929—\$1,001,130 = \$4.72 \text{ per share.}$$

$$1930—\quad 124,563 = \quad 0.57 \text{ per share.}$$

对资产负债表的分析表明，在这两年中，好意和商标项目从100万美元逐步增加到160万美元，再增加到200万美元，这些增加额*从期间费用中扣除*。接下来页面中显示的三个日期的简表资产负债表将显示所采用的记账方式的异常性。

<!--en-->
An examination of the balance sheets discloses that during these two years the item of Good-will and Trade-marks was written up successively from $1,000,000 to $1,600,000 and then to $2,000,000, and these increases *deducted* from the expenses for the period. The extraordinary character of the bookkeeping employed will be apparent from a study of the condensed balance sheets as of three dates, shown on the next page.

这些数据显示，在15个月内，净流动资产减少了1,600,000美元，比支付的现金股息多1,000,000美元。这一减少被Good-will和Trademarks的1,000,000美元增加额所掩盖。在年度报告中或后续上市申请中，未向股东提供与这些显著变动相关的说明。然而，针对一项个人询问，公司表示，Good-will和Trademarks的增加额属于广告和其他销售投入，用于发展子公司Tintex Company, Inc.的业务。¹

<!--en-->
These figures show a reduction of $1,600,000 in net current assets in 15 months, or $1,000,000 more than the cash dividends paid. This shrinkage was concealed by a $1,000,000 write-up of Good-will and Trademarks. No statement relating to these amazing entries was vouchsafed to the stockholders in the annual reports or to the New York Stock Exchange in subsequent listing applications. In answer to an individualinquiry, however, the company stated that these additions to Good-will and Trademarks represented expenditures for advertising and other sales efforts to develop the business of Tintex Company, Inc., a subsidiary.¹

# Park and Tilford, Inc.

将当前广告费用计入商誉账户不符合所有合理会计原则。在不向股东披露的情况下这样做，更加不可取。此外，很难相信 Park and Tilford 在 1929 年 9 月 30 日至 12 月 31 日这 *三个月*内，真的能花费 600,000 美元用于此目的。因此，该记录似乎包含了对 *前期*支出重新计入 *当期*收入的做法，因此 1929 年第四季度的数据可能被明显扭曲了。当然，年度报表并未附带会计师证明。

<!--en-->
The charging of current advertising expense to the goodwill account is inadmissible under all canons of sound accounting. To do so without any disclosure to the stockholders is still more discreditable. It is difficult to believe, moreover, that the sum of $600,000 could have been expended for this purpose by Park and Tilford in the *three months* between September 30 and December 31, 1929. The entry appears therefore to have included a recrediting to *current* income of expenditures made in a *previous period*, and to that extent the results for the fourth quarter of 1929 may have been flagrantly distorted. Needless to say, no accountants' certificate accompanied the annual statements of this enterprise.

**资产负债表与所得税检查对发布的收益报表。** Park and Tilford 案例说明了将收入账户分析与相关资产负债表审查相结合的重要性。鉴于华尔街对报告收入和每股收益的天真接受，这一点尤为重要。我们的例子还建议通过联邦所得税预提金额来进一步检验发布收益报表的可靠性。可轻松从所得税预提额计算出应税利润，再与向股东报告的利润进行比较。这两个数字不一定相同，因为税法复杂性可能导致多种差异。²我们并不建议尝试完全协调这些数值，但应注意到如此大的差异并作为进一步调查的主题。

<!--en-->
**Balance-Sheet and Income-Tax Checks upon the Published Earnings Statements.** The Park and Tilford case illustrates the necessity of relating an analysis of income accounts to an examination of the appurtenant balance sheets. This is a point that cannot be stressed too strongly, in view of Wall Street's naïve acceptance of reported income and reported earnings per share. Our example suggests also a further check upon the reliability of the published earnings statements, *viz.*, by theamount of the federal income tax accrued. The taxable profit can be calculated fairly readily from the income-tax accrual, and this profit compared in turn with the earnings reported to stockholders. The two figures should not necessarily be the same, since the intricacies of the tax laws may give rise to a number of divergences.² We do not suggest that any effort be made to reconcile the amounts absolutely but only that very wide differences be noted and made the subject of further inquiry.

从这一视角分析的 Park and Tilford 数据如下一页表格所示，提供了有启发性的结果。

The Park and Tilford figures analyzed from this viewpoint supply the suggestive results as shown in the table on the following page.

前期所得税预提与报告收入的高度一致，使得后期差异显得更为显著。这些数字强烈质疑 1927–1929 年期间向股东报告信息的真实性，当时股票显然存在大量操纵行为。

<!--en-->
The close correspondence of the tax accrual with the reported income during the earlier period makes the later discrepancy appear the more striking. These figures eloquently cast suspicion upon the truthfulness of the reports made to the stockholders during 1927–1929, at which time considerable manipulation was apparently going on in the shares.

本文讨论的其他例子都强烈表明需要由认证公共会计师对公司报表进行独立审计。也可以建议年度报告应包含向股东报告的净收益与缴纳联邦税所得净收入之间的详细核对。我们认为，注册报表和招股说明书中出现的许多关于小问题的信息可以省略，对整体更有利；但如果 S.E.C. 要求这种核对，安全分析将得到极大促进。

<!--en-->
This and other examples discussed herein point strongly to the need for independent audits of corporate statements by certified public accountants. It may be suggested also that annual reports should include a detailed reconcilement of the net earnings reported to the shareholders with the net income upon which the federal tax is paid. In our opinion a good deal of the information relative to minor matters that appears in registration statements and prospectuses might be dispensed with to general advantage; but if, in lieu thereof, the S.E.C. were to require such a reconcilement, the cause of security analysis would be greatly advanced.

## 另一例会计操纵的特殊案例。

<!--en-->
*Another Extraordinary Case of Manipulated Accounting.*

美国联合雪茄店公司从1924年至1927年期间也进行了与Park and Tilford类似的特殊会计处理，但对报告收益的影响较小。1927年5月，该公司首次在上市申请中解释了这些记录的“理论”，其中包含以下段落：³ 该公司在美国主要城市拥有数百处商业建筑的长期租赁权，直到1924年5月之前这些租赁权并未记录在账上。因此，当时由纽约市注册会计师F. W. Lafrentz公司进行评估，这些租赁权的价值超过20,000,000美元。

<!--en-->
An accounting vagary fully as extraordinary as that of Park and Tilford, though exercising a smaller influence on the reported earnings, was indulged in by United Cigar Stores Company of America, from 1924–1927. The “theory” behind the entries was explained by the company for the first time in May 1927 in a listing application that contained the following paragraphs:³
The Company owns several hundred long-term leaseholds on business buildings in the principal cities of the United States, which up until May, 1924, were not set up on the books. Accordingly, at that time they were appraised by the Company and Messrs. F. W. Lafrentz and Company, certified public accountants of New York City, in excess of $20,000,000.

自那时起，董事会每三个月授权将部分该估值计入公司资产，并以股息形式进行资本化，按普通股面值在季度基础上支付，比例为已发行未偿还普通股的1 1/4%。

<!--en-->
The Board of Directors have, since that time, authorized every three months the setting up among the assets of the Company a portion of this valuation and the capitalization thereof, in the form of dividends, payable in Common Stock at par on the Common Stock on the quarterly basis of 1 1/4% on the Common Stock issued and outstanding.

通过这种方式产生的全部资本盈余，已通过发行等额的普通股来吸收，因此不属于公司现有盈余的一部分。从未从这种资本盈余中发放过现金股息。

<!--en-->
The entire capital surplus created in this manner has been absorbed by the issuance of Common Stock at par for an equal amount and accordingly is not a part of the existing surplus of the Company. No cashdividends have been declared out of such capital surplus so created.

使用与1924年相同的评估标准，目前这些租赁权的估计价值是公司账面上显示价值的两倍多。

<!--en-->
The present estimated value of such leaseholds, using the same basis of appraisal as in 1924, is more than twice the present value shown on the books of the Company.

“租赁权增值”计入收益的影响如下所示：

<!--en-->
