<!--en-->
*FIGURE 1 Valuation of Emerging Markets Relative to the S&P*
Source: Bloomberg Data: relative P/E ratio of S&P 500 (SPX) to MSCI Emerging Markets Index (MXEF), month end 12/1995 to 6/2022.

在继续之前，重要的是要明确发达国际市场与发展中市场之间的区别，因为这两种市场存在不同的风险。规模较大的发达金融市场，尤其是加拿大、英国和澳大利亚，在报告标准、证券监管、市场流动性和企业治理方面与美国市场非常相似。Graham和Dodd提出的用于发现被低估证券的分析原则，可以在这些发达国际市场中应用，但需额外考虑外汇风险——汇率的显著变化可能使公司基本面的重要性变得不那么重要。虽然我们仍需要比美国同类投资更高的潜在回报才能在发达国际市场投资，但我们不会要求更高的溢价。

<!--en-->
Before proceeding further, it is important to highlight the distinction between developed international markets and developing markets, because these two types of markets can present distinct risks. The larger developed financial markets, particularly Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia, closely resemble the U.S. market in terms of reporting standards, securities regulation, market liquidity, and corporate governance. The analytical principles laid out by Graham and Dodd to uncover undervalued securities can be applied in these developed international markets with one additional consideration—that of foreign exchange risk, whereby a significant change in the exchange rate could overwhelm the importance of a company’s fundamentals. While we would still require higher potential returns than comparable U.S. investments to invest in developed international markets, we would not seek a substantially higher premium to do so.

像印度尼西亚、阿根廷和尼日利亚这样的发展中国际市场则情况不同。在这些市场中，投资者在评估证券的内在价值时必须考虑额外的风险，因此必须要求比发达市场更高的预期回报或更大的安全边际。经济或政治不确定性在这些不太成熟且流动性较低的市场中更为常见，对于投资者来说，这种动荡时期是寻找投资机会的好时机。导致投资优惠的经济危机并非仅存在于发展中市场：2012年夏季，希腊威胁要违约，其他欧洲国家也威胁要将其排除欧元体系，导致东京市场剧烈抛售，为价值投资者提供了极具吸引力的投资机会。同样，2011年3月福岛地震及随后的核灾难导致东京市场大幅抛售，日本最大公用事业公司几乎破产。

<!--en-->
Developing international markets such as Indonesia, Argentina, and Nigeria are a different story. In these markets,investors must take substantial additional risks into account when assessing the intrinsic value of a security, and as a result must demand much higher prospective returns, or a much larger margin of safety, than they require in developed markets. Periods of economic or political uncertainty are more common in these less mature and more illiquid markets, which can be rich hunting grounds for investors amid such turmoil. Economic crisis leading to investment bargains is not a preserve of developing markets alone: in the summer of 2012, Greece threatened to default on its debt, and in turn the other Europeans threatened to kick it out of the euro, resulting in chaotic selling and very attractive investment opportunities for value investors. Similarly, the March 2011 Fukushima earthquake and the ensuing nuclear disaster resulted in a significant sell-off of the Tokyo market and near bankruptcy of Japan's largest utility.

#### 建立本地网络

<!--en-->
*DEVELOPING A LOCAL NETWORK*

每个国际市场都有自己独特的规则与法规、挑战与机遇，以及不良分子与英雄。没有充分准备就进入新市场，就像在没有了解谁是鲨鱼谁是猎物的情况下坐在陌生的扑克桌旁。我们研究新市场的第一步是在该国建立关系网络。这个网络不仅包括投资分析师和股票经纪人，还包括当地记者、前政府官员、退休企业高管、前外交官，以及当地中央银行或IMF等机构的经济学家。我们会与我们要分析的公司的客户、竞争对手和监管机构会面。

<!--en-->
Each international market has its own unique set of rules and regulations, challenges and opportunities, and scoundrels and heroes. Jumping into a new market without adequate preparation is akin to sitting down at an unfamiliar poker table without first learning who the sharks and patsies are. Our first step in looking at a new market is to develop a network of relationships in the country. This network is much broader than just investment analysts and stockbrokers. It includes local journalists, former government officials, retired corporate executives, former diplomats, and economists from institutions such as the local central bank or the IMF. We meet with the customers, competitors, and regulators of the companies we are analyzing.

建立这个网络需要时间，并需要多次前往该国。当整个国家处于困境时，建立网络通常最为容易。在这种时期，不仅公司，政府官员也渴望与新的潜在投资者会面，以吸引资金进入他们的国家。2001年7月，当我们去印度考察时，几乎可以见到任何首席执行官，他们都会耐心地向我们解释他们的业务。相反，2006年7月，当印度市场繁荣时，甚至很难与公司的投资者关系经理会面。2011年我们去越南调研时，尽管日程安排满满，我们的经纪人仍会接到企业主动打电话，在我们从一场会议转到另一场会议时寻求资金。

<!--en-->
Constructing this network requires time and involves multiple trips to a country. It is often easiest to build a network when an entire country is distressed. During such times, not only companies but even government officials are keen to meet new potential investors to attract capital into their country. In July 2001, when we went on a scouting trip to India, it was possible to meet with almost any CEO, and theywould take the time to patiently explain their businesses to us. Conversely, in July 2006, when the Indian market was booming, it was hard to even get a meeting with a company's investor relations manager. On our research trips to Vietnam in 2011, even though we had full schedules, our broker would receive unsolicited calls from businesses looking for capital while we were traveling from one meeting to the next.

如果没有建立这样的网络，我们在考虑外国市场投资时会感到不安，因为建立网络需要大量时间和努力。幸运的是，我们发现一旦建立了网络，只要持续维护和更新它，就能反复发挥作用。这样，我们可以更快地抓住后续机会。因此，我们一次又一次地回到相同的市场。

<!--en-->
We are uncomfortable considering investments in a foreign market without building such a network, which takes significant time and effort. Helpfully, we have found that after the network has been built, it can be useful again and again, so long as we work to maintain and update it. In this way, we are able to get up to speed more quickly on subsequent opportunities. For this reason, we find ourselves coming back again and again to the same markets.

这个网络还能帮助我们理解当地文化。当我们评估文化时，指的是一个国家的沟通与语言细节，以及对法治的遵守程度。例如，美国的管理层向投资者和分析师提出财务目标时，意味着他们有实现这些目标的承诺。但并非所有国家都是如此；在某些地方，财务目标是愿望而非承诺。文化还包含一个国家主要政治和商业领袖的共同价值观和动机。这些领袖想要实现什么目标？作为少数投资者，我们是否与他们目标一致？

<!--en-->
This network also helps us understand the local culture. When we assess culture, we are referring to the nuances of communication and language in a country, as well as adherence to the rule of law. When a management in the United States provides financial targets to investors and analysts, for example, these come with a degree of commitment to meeting those targets. This is not the case in every country; in some places, financial targets are aspirations rather than commitments. Culture also encompasses the shared values and motivations of the key political and business leaders of a country. What are these leaders seeking to accomplish, and are we as minority investors aligned with their goals?

我们的网络还使我们能够调查当地商人的声誉。在投资公司之前，我们希望对那些我们还不熟悉的管理层进行至少十几个良好的背景调查。我们经常问当地人的问题是：“如果你必须在未来十年内将家族资金投资于五家公司，且估值不是考虑因素，你会投资哪些公司？”与那些他们认为短期最可行的股票相比，当地人回答这个问题时往往关注管理层的素质与诚信。

<!--en-->
Our network also permits us to investigate the reputations of local businesspeople. Before investing in a company, we want to have at least a dozen good reference checks on a management that we do not already know well. A question we often ask locals is, "If you had to invest your family's money in five companies for the next decade, and valuation was not a consideration, in which companies would you invest?" Instead of pitching stocks they think would work best in the short term, locals' answer to this question tends to be focused on the quality and integrity of the management.

我们在某个国家花费数周、数月甚至更长时间，才会首次投入资本。我们宁愿错过机会，也不愿犯大错。以越南为例，我们在投资前曾访问该国七次。我们在两个月的时间里共前往希腊六次寻找投资机会，同时也在德国与政策制定者和政治家会面，评估希腊债务违约的风险。我们的一个合作伙伴在2000年代初在韩国生活了一个月，在2006年泰国军事政变后又在泰国待了一个月。即使不活跃时，我们仍每年至少访问英国、德国、印度和巴西等国家两次，以保持联系并寻找新机会。

<!--en-->
We spend weeks, months, or longer in a country before we first commit any capital there. We would rather miss an opportunity than make a major mistake. In the case of Vietnam, we visited the country seven times before we invested. We made six trips to Greece over a two-month period to find investments, while also spending time in Germany meeting policy makers and politicians to underwrite the risk of a Greek default. One of our partners lived in Korea for a month in the early 2000s and spent another month in Thailand following its 2006 military coup. We continue to visit countries such as Great Britain, Germany, India, and Brazil at least twice per year, even when we are not active, to maintain our contacts and to search out new opportunities.

### 为什么现在？

<!--en-->
*WHY NOW?*

当我们专注于寻找低估的资产时，总会停下来思考：为何某只证券被低估了？是什么导致合理的股东出售该证券，我们又为什么要购买呢？我们从不假设卖家错了，而是想了解他们的理由。我们还试图将宏观经济发展转化为自下而上的公司分析。例如，在经济危机中，当货币疲软且利率高企时，我们想研究这些力量将如何影响我们正在分析的特定证券和公司，并了解这些公司和其管理层如何抵御这些力量。

<!--en-->
As we focus on finding pockets of undervaluation, we always stop to ask ourselves why a security has become undervalued. What caused a reasonable shareholder to sell the security, and why should we be buying instead? We never start with the assumption that the sellers are wrong; instead, we want to understand their rationale. We also attempt to translate macroeconomic developments into our bottom-up company analysis. In an economic crisis, for example, when a currency is weak and interest rates are high, we want to examine how these forces will impact the specific securities and companies we are analyzing, and we want to understand how resilient these companies and their managements are against these forces.

我们见过许多国家或地区危机为投资者创造机会的例子。2004年，执政的改革党印度人民党在印度选举中遭遇意外失利。由于没有任何政党在议会获得多数席位，不稳定的联合政府前景使得2004年5月17日印度股市指数下跌超过15%。尽管联合政府的前景带来了诸多不确定性，但我们认为它不会妨碍私营银行的持续成功，因此这次抛售提供了以优惠价格获取大型银行控股权的机会。2010年越南银行危机使房地产公司价值受损，在这种情况下，由此产生的问题贷款使得大多数本地银行无法分析，但这是一个购买未受影响的优秀管理消费企业股份的机会。每个危机都带来自己的问题和机会。

<!--en-->
We have seen many examples of country or regional crises creating opportunities for investors. In 2004 the incumbent reformist Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) suffered a surprise electoral defeat in Indian elections. Since no party received a majority of seats in the Parliament, the prospect of an unstable and indecisive coalition government drove the Indian stock index down more than 15% on May 17, 2004. Although the prospect of a coalition government raised myriad uncertainties, we saw little to no risk that it would impair the continued success of the private banks, and so this sell-offprovided an opportunity to acquire great banking franchises at attractive prices. A 2010 banking crisis in Vietnam impaired the values of property companies, and in this case the resulting problem loans made most local banks unanalyzable, but this was an opportunity to purchase shares of excellently managed consumer businesses that were unaffected. Every crisis presents its own set of problems and opportunities.

事实上，危机常常给国家和公司提供解决结构性问题的机会，最终对那些能够熬过不断报道的动荡局势的人产生长期积极影响。1991年印度国际收支危机促成了经济自由化，包括降低进口关税、推动私营银行发展以及让印度股市向外国机构投资者开放。这些举措为印度经济及其资本市场随后30年的增长奠定了基础。

<!--en-->
Indeed, crises often provide countries and companies with an opportunity to fix structural problems and end up having a beneficial longer-term impact for those who can survive the relentless headlines and volatility. The 1991 Indian balance of payments crisis catalyzed the liberalization of the economy, including reduction of import tariffs, promotion of a private banking sector, and opening the Indian stock market to foreign institutional investors. These actions laid the foundation for the subsequent 30 years of growth for the Indian economy and its capital markets.

### 国际指数与单股选择

<!--en-->
*INTERNATIONAL INDICES VERSUS SINGLE STOCK SELECTION*

虽然美国被动指数基金的使用量大幅增长，但国际上我们发现，购买特定股票比持有指数更优。在许多国际市场，股市指数过度关注大型但管理不善的国有或家族控制企业、资本不足的银行以及监管过严的公用事业公司。它们通常包含波动较大的商品生产者和低回报的房地产公司。在国外，创新和增长往往集中在少数私人控制的创业公司中，这些公司通常只是当地指数中的小成分，甚至根本不在指数中。

<!--en-->
While there has been dramatic growth in the use of passive index funds in the United States, internationally we have found that buying specific stocks is superior to owning an index. In many international markets, stock market indices are overweighted to large but poorly managed state-owned or family-controlled enterprises, undercapitalized banks, and overregulated utilities. They often include volatile commodity producers as well as low-return property companies. Abroad, innovation and growth are often concentrated within a subset of privately controlled entrepreneurial companies that are often only small constituents of local indexes, if included at all.

### 商业品质是抵御宏观经济冲击的最佳保护

<!--en-->
*BUSINESS QUALITY IS THE BEST PROTECTION FROM MACROECONOMIC SHOCKS*

除了优惠购买价格外，企业质量还能保护投资者免受资本永久损失。例如，具有定价能力的公司可以抵消通货膨胀和货币贬值的负面影响，而资本回报率高的公司则无需承担在高利率时期可能造成严重损害的债务。2002年，当阿根廷比索贬值75%时，阿根廷领先的啤酒公司Quilmes的国内净销售额从2001日历年的4.26亿美元降至2002年的1.64亿美元，主要由于每升产品的净变现额按美元计算下降了59%。然而，在接下来的五年中，凭借强大的品牌价值、65%的市场份额以及整个行业的较高成本，Quilmes能够大幅提高价格。到2006年，Quilmes已经恢复了大部分按美元计算的净变现损失。尽管遭遇了巨大的宏观经济冲击，Quilmes仍恢复了其业务的美元价值。同样，在20世纪80年代和90年代的巴西恶性通货膨胀期间，定价能力帮助雀巢以瑞士法郎计算扩大巴西收入。越南乳制品公司Vinamilk作为越南领先的乳制品和饮料公司，也能将国内价格提高至足以抵消2006年至2011年越南盾持续贬值的影响。Vinamilk因拥有主导品牌，能够以年均18%的速率以美元计算增加收入，并在越南经济困难时期改善了利润率。

<!--en-->
Along with a bargain purchase price, business quality can also insulate investors from permanent loss of capital. Companies with pricing power, for example, can offset the negative effects of inflation and devaluations, and companies with high returns on capital do not need to incur debt that can be so damaging in periods of high interest rates. In 2002, when the Argentine peso devalued by 75%, Quilmes, the leading beer company in Argentina, saw its net domestic sales decline from $426 million in calendar year 2001 to $164 million in 2002 largely due to a -59% decline in net realization per liter in dollar terms. However, over the five years that followed, Quilmes was able to impose significant price increases due to its strong brand equity, dominant 65% market share, and higher input costs across the entire industry. By 2006, Quilmes had recovered three-quarters of its lost net realization in dollar terms. Despite suffering an extraordinary macroeconomic shock, Quilmes had restored the value of its business in dollar terms. Similarly, during the Brazilian hyperinflation of the 1980s and 1990s, pricing power helped Nestle grow its Brazilian revenues in Swiss franc terms. Vietnam Dairy Products, known as Vinamilk, the leading dairy products and beverages company in Vietnam, was also able to raise domestic price enough to offset a steady depreciation of the Vietnamese dong from 2006 to 2011. Vinamilk was able to raise prices due to its dominant brands and grow its revenues in U.S. dollar terms at an average yearly rate of 18%, while improving its margins during a difficult period for the Vietnamese economy.

### 货币风险

<!--en-->
*CURRENCY RISK*

评估国际投资时，美国投资者需确保所有收益均以美元计算。如果收益仅以当地货币计算，而像阿根廷、委内瑞拉和津巴布韦这样在2020年代初通胀率超过50%的国家，本地债券名义上的年收益可能高达50%，但换算成美元后这些收益会消失。实际上，这些高收益反映了对货币贬值的预期。换句话说，分析师必须调整预期收益，以反映分析师基础货币（即美国投资者的美元）与当地货币之间的通胀率差异。从长期来看，当地货币理论上应因这种差异而贬值。当然，其他变量，如实际利率差异、贸易条件变化（出口与进口的相对价格）以及其他资本流动，会影响汇率变化，但这种简单近似提供了一个良好的基准。

<!--en-->
In assessing international investments, it is important for U.S. investors to make sure all returns are calculated and measured in U.S. dollars. If returns were measured solely in local currency, with inflation running at levels upward of 50% in places like Argentina, Venezuela, and Zimbabwe in the early 2020s, local bonds may appear to offer annual returns as high as 50% in nominal terms, but those returns can disappear when measured in U.S. dollars. Indeed, these high yields reflect an expectation of devaluation. In other words, ananalyst must adjust expected returns to reflect the differential in inflation rates between the analyst's base currency (which means the U.S. dollar for U.S. investors) and the local currency. Over long periods, local currencies should theoretically depreciate at this differential. Of course, other variables, such as differentials in real interest rates, changes in terms of trade (the relative prices of exports to imports), and other capital flows, will influence changes in exchange rates, but this simple approximation provides a good baseline.

外汇风险是所有国际投资者都需要考虑的问题。这些风险可以通过对冲来规避，但就像所有保险形式一样，货币对冲涉及成本或保费。这些成本或保费在风暴前最低，此时最为必要；而在风暴后最不需要时，成本最高。我们并不建议投资者对冲所有货币风险，只是希望所有投资者在投资非本国市场时注意货币风险。

<!--en-->
Foreign exchange risk is something that all international investors need to think about. These risks can be hedged, but as with all forms of insurance, currency hedging involves a cost or premium. These costs or premia are lowest before the storm, when they are most necessary, and most expensive right after the storm, when they are least needed. We are not recommending that investors hedge all their currency exposures, only that all investors be mindful of currency when investing outside their home markets.

了解货币波动的真实风险非常重要。例如，2009年，我们决定不对印度IT服务公司Tata Consultancy Services进行货币对冲，因为其收入和大部分成本都以美元和欧元计算，而当地货币占多数。因此它受益于印度卢比贬值。在无法轻易对冲货币的国家，如越南，从较弱的当地货币中获益的企业尤其有价值。我们在投资越南乳制品时无法对冲越南盾的风险，但Vinamilk的产品与以美元定价的新西兰进口乳制品竞争，这提供了一定程度的保护。随着盾币贬值，这些进口竞争对手的价格也按贬值速度上涨，使Vinamilk有机会提高价格以完全抵消这种贬值。

<!--en-->
It is important to understand the true underlying exposures to currency fluctuations. For example, in 2009 we decided not to hedge our currency exposure in Tata Consultancy Services, an Indian IT services company, because it generated its revenues in U.S. dollars and euros, while most of its costs were in local currency. Thus it benefited from a depreciating Indian rupee. Businesses that benefit from weaker local currencies are particularly valuable in countries that do not have a currency that can be easily hedged, such as Vietnam. We could not hedge our exposure to the Vietnamese dong when we invested in Vietnam Dairy, but we received a measure of protection from the fact that Vinamilk's products competed against imported dairy products from New Zealand, which were priced in U.S. dollars. As the dong depreciated, prices of these imported competitors increased at the rate of depreciation, giving Vinamilk an opportunity to raise prices to fully offset this depreciation.

美国投资者在投资发达市场时也需要考虑货币风险。在2012年希腊债务危机中，尽管像希腊交易所和国家彩票OPAP这样的公司出现显著价格下跌，但如果希腊退出欧元体系，仍存在额外的下行风险。作为分析师，我们评估了这种最坏情况下的下行风险。对于股价低于公司每股基础现金价值的股票，我们可以锁定下行风险，并可能对冲现金相关的货币风险。我们通常避免投资于无法确定可接受下行价值的情况。

<!--en-->
U.S. investors also need to consider currency risk when investing in developed markets. In the case of the Greek debt crisis of 2012, despite the significant price declines of companies such as the stock exchange (Hellenic Exchanges)and the national lottery (OPAP), there was still additional downside risk if Greece were to leave the euro. As analysts, we estimated our downside exposure in this worst-case scenario. In the case of stocks valued below a company's underlying cash per share, we could bookend our downside and potentially hedge any currency risk on the cash. We generally avoid investing in situations where we were unable to determine an acceptable downside value.

### 管理能力、一致性与诚信

<!--en-->
*MANAGEMENT COMPETENCE, ALIGNMENT, AND INTEGRITY*

Graham和Dodd指出，“未来价值因素”会影响证券内在价值的实现。（第1章）关键的未来价值因素包括管理能力和声誉。沃伦·巴菲特敏锐地指出：“有人曾说，在招聘人员时，你要寻找三个品质：诚信、智慧与精力。如果你没有第一点，其他两点会毁掉你。如果你雇佣的人缺乏诚信，那你希望他们既愚蠢又懒惰。”⁷虽然这在任何市场都很重要，但在海外投资时尤为关键。自私或存在冲突的管理层可能会通过不公平对待小股东来侵蚀证券的内在价值。在许多国家，家族或国家控制的公司的董事会往往无法代表小股东的利益。

<!--en-->
Graham and Dodd warn that “future value factors” can affect the realization of the intrinsic value of a security. (Chap. 1) A key future value factor is management competence and reputation. Warren Buffett astutely noted: “Somebody once said that in looking for people to hire, you look for three qualities: integrity, intelligence, and energy. And if you do not have the first, the other two will kill you. If you hire somebody without integrity, you really want them to be dumb and lazy.”⁷ While this is important in any market, it is critical when investing abroad. Self-interested or conflicted managements can erode the intrinsic value of a security through unfair treatment of minority shareholders. In many countries, boards of directors in family- or state-controlled companies often do not represent the interests of minority shareholders.

在美国，当管理层无能或存在冲突时，股东行动主义通常能迫使改变。这意味着糟糕的管理可能为价值投资者提供机会——当激进投资者推动管理层变革时，这种机会很容易获得。在大多数国际市场，无论是发达国家还是发展中国家，这种情况都难以实现。股东试图替换日本、德国和法国管理层的努力都失败了，在发展中国家也是如此。管理质量在国际投资中至关重要。在大多数国际市场，购买证券时遇到的管理层，几乎总是你将来要与之共事的管理层。

<!--en-->
In the United States, when a management is incompetent or conflicted, shareholder activism can often force a change. This means that poor management might present an opportunity for value investors, a low-hanging fruit to be plucked as activists force a change in management. In most international markets, whether developed or developing, this is impossible. Attempts by shareholders to replace managements in Japan, Germany, and France have proven futile, just as they have in developing markets. Quality of management is critical when investing internationally. In most international markets, the management you have when youbuy a security is almost always the management you will have to live with.

许多国际公司由家族控制，控制家族的利益可能与小股东的利益相冲突。例如，如果族长即将去世，家族可能希望股价长期低迷以最小化遗产税。或者，控股股东可能进行不道德但非违法的关联方交易，以增加个人财富。

<!--en-->
Many international companies are family-controlled, and the interests of the controlling family may diverge from those of minority shareholders. For example, a family might want a depressed share price for an extended period to minimize estate taxes if the death of a patriarch seems imminent. Or controlling shareholders may engage in unethical but not illegal related-party transactions in order to enhance their personal wealth.

拥有国际认可的审计师和备受尊敬的当地董事会成员可能不足以提供充分保护。Satyam Computer Services Limited常被称为“印度的Enron”，由普华永道印度分公司进行审计，其董事会包括一位杰出的技术专家、来自美国顶尖商学院的会计教授以及知名前政府官员。Satyam被视为全球领先的信息技术公司。2008年，其收入超过20亿美元，员工超过53,000人，在66个国家运营。2004年，其ADR在纽约证券交易所上市，世界企业治理委员会授予其“金孔雀奖”以表彰卓越的企业治理表现。但2009年1月7日，Satyam创始人兼首席执行官Ramalinga Raju向市场披露，Satyam虚报现金余额超过10亿美元，虚报负债2.52亿美元。他将资金从Satyam转移出来，用于支付其家族拥有的私人公司的房地产投资。

<!--en-->
Having internationally accepted auditors and highly regarded local board members may not provide sufficient protection. Satyam Computer Services Limited, often called “India’s Enron,” was audited by the Indian affiliate of PricewaterhouseCoopers, and its board of directors included a preeminent technologist, an accounting professor from a leading American business school, and highly regarded former government officials. Satyam was regarded as a leading global information technology company. In 2008, it reported revenues of over $2 billion, employed over 53,000 employees, and operated in 66 countries. In 2004, its ADRs were listed on the New York Stock Exchange, and the World Council for Corporate Governance awarded it the “Golden Peacock Award” for excellence in corporate governance. But on January 7, 2009, Satyam’s founder and CEO, Ramalinga Raju, shocked the markets when he confessed that Satyam had overstated its cash balances by over $1 billion and understated its liabilities by $252 million. He had siphoned funds out of Satyam to pay for real estate investments made by private companies owned by his family.

识别有能力且道德的管理层并不困难。Graham和Dodd的财务分析必须与Phil Fisher的传闻分析相结合。⁸就像许多美国小镇一样，当地居民非常了解声誉——这也是建立本地网络至关重要的原因。实际现金流的证明，如股息或以优惠价格回购股票，也非常重要。

<!--en-->
Identifying competent and ethical managements is not necessarily difficult. Graham and Dodd’s financial analysis must be combined with Phil Fisher’s scuttlebutt methods.⁸ As in many U.S. small towns, reputations are well-known among locals—another reason why creating a local network is critical. Proof of actual cash flow generation, such as dividends or share buybacks at attractive prices, is also important.

### 国际信贷投资

<!--en-->
*INTERNATIONAL CREDIT INVESTMENTS*

投资者需要超越与投资相关的法律形式。是的，债券和贷款是债务人与债权人的合法合同，但只有可强制执行才有价值。国际市场的信贷投资者必须彻底了解这些合同的可执行性、相关破产法以及外国判决的可执行性。重叠的司法管辖区和冲突的法律可能导致执行成本高、时间长且不可预测。若债券受纽约法律约束，而判决在美国法院作出，如果基础资产位于墨西哥或阿根廷，执行可能需要数十年时间。

<!--en-->
Investors need to look beyond the legal formalities associated with their investments. Yes, bonds and loans are legal contracts between debtors and creditors, but they are only valuable if enforceable. Credit investors in international markets must thoroughly understand the enforceability of these contracts, the relevant bankruptcy codes, and the enforceability of the foreign judgments before investing in international debt securities. Overlapping jurisdictions and conflicting laws can make enforcement costly, time-consuming, and unpredictable. A judgment regarding bonds subject to New York law that is handed down in a U.S. court may take decades to enforce if the underlying collateral is located in Mexico or Argentina.

### 涉及国家重要资产的注意事项

<!--en-->
*WITH ASSETS OF NATIONAL SIGNIFICANCE, CAVEAT EMPTOR*

有时，投资在某个国家重要行业中的重要企业是划算的——它们可能获得一定保护，因为属于国家级龙头企业。但购买由外国政府直接或间接控制的具有国家重要性的资产时，也可能存在风险，比如法国电力公司（Électricité de France，简称EdF）的情况。2005年11月，法国政府出售了EdF 12.7%的股份，以每股32欧元的价格筹集了63.5亿欧元资金。然而，在2005年11月IPO后两年内，EdF股价最初上涨至每股70欧元，之后逐渐下跌至2022年7月的每股7.85欧元。多年来，EdF一直以低于市场价格的价格销售电力，这一政策受到用电用户的欢迎。EdF还维持着庞大的员工队伍，以让工会满意。EdF的海外少数股东无法参与地方选举投票，因此遭受了政客对EdF管理不善的影响。EdF一直是一个政治工具：2022年，当法国总统试图表明他希望缓解俄罗斯-乌克兰战争导致的能源成本上升时，他提到了重新国有化EdF，价格可能远低于2005年的IPO价格。

<!--en-->
It is sometimes profitable to invest in companies that play an important role in significant industries in a country—they may receive a degree of protection because they are a national champion. There can also be pitfalls in purchasing shares in an asset of national significance controlled directly or indirectly by a foreign government, as in the case of Électricité de France (“EdF”). In November 2005, the French government sold a 12.7% stake in EdF, raising €6.35 billion at €32 per share. However, after an initial run-up to €70 per share within two years of its November 2005 IPO, EdF shares slowly and steadily ground their way down to a July 2022 price of €7.85 per share. Over the years, EdF has continued to sell power below market price, a policy that is popular among ratepayers. EdF also maintained a bloated employee base to keep its unions happy. The offshore minority shareholders of EdF, who do not vote in local elections, have suffered as a result of this mismanagement of EdF by the politicians. EdF has remained a political football: in 2022, as the French president sought a way to show he was seeking to ease rising energy costs causedby the Russia-Ukraine war, he talked about renationalizing EdF, likely at a price far below that of its 2005 IPO.

印度煤炭有限公司的情况与EdF类似。印度煤炭有限公司于2010年10月通过向国内和外国投资者出售10%股权进行上市，而印度政府保留了剩余的90%。印度煤炭有限公司以远低于进口煤炭实际成本的价格出售煤炭，以此降低印度的电力成本。2012年10月，一位英国活动人士以董事会违反诚信义务为由起诉印度煤炭有限公司，并指责印度政府“作为多数股东滥用权力，不当对CIL董事会施加压力”。最终，该活动人士未能让印度煤炭有限公司提高煤炭价格。

<!--en-->
The case of Coal India Limited mirrors the case of EdF. Coal India went public in October 2010 by selling 10% of its equity to domestic and foreign investors while the government of India retained the remaining 90%. Coal India was pricing its coal at a significant discount to the landed cost of imported coal, as a means of lowering the cost of electricity in India. In October 2012, a U.K. activist sued the board of directors of Coal India for breach of its fiduciary duties and accused the government of India of “abusing its powers as a majority shareholder and for improperly exerting pressure on CIL directors.”⁹ In the end, the activist failed to get Coal India to increase its prices of coal.

当然，仅有政府控股并不使企业不可投资；我们对Vinamilk的投资就说明了这一点。政府持有Vinamilk 47.6%的股份，但并未干预Vinamilk管理层在通货膨胀期间提高价格的决定，使公司能够持续实现高资本回报。在这种情况下，政府希望促进国内食品生产，减少进口需求，提高食品安全水平；因此，少数股东与越南政府立场一致。

<!--en-->
Of course, government ownership alone does not make a business uninvestable; our investment in Vinamilk illustrates this. The state owned 47.6% of Vinamilk, yet it did not interfere with Vinamilk management’s decision to raise prices during inflation, allowing the company to continue earning high returns on capital. In this case, the government wanted to promote domestic food production to reduce its need to import food and to increase food security; thus, in this case, minority shareholders were aligned with the Vietnamese government.

即使没有大量股份所有权，政府也可以通过监管和税收手段控制具有国家重要性的关键资产。任何对具有国家重要性的资产或公司的投资都应谨慎分析并实施。了解控股股东尤其是政府的动机至关重要，以确保他们的利益与外国投资者的利益一致。

<!--en-->
Governments can control critical assets of national significance even without significant share ownership, by using regulation and taxation to achieve the same result. Any investment in any asset or company of national significance should be analyzed and undertaken with great caution. It is critical to understand the motives of the controlling shareholders, especially governments, to ensure their interests are aligned with the interests of foreign investors.

#### 投资国际证券的吸引替代方案

<!--en-->
*ATTRACTIVE ALTERNATIVES TO INVESTING IN INTERNATIONAL SECURITIES*

国际市场的诸多风险可能使美国投资者对直接投资国际证券持谨慎态度，尤其是那些在发展中国家上市的证券。

<!--en-->
The myriad risks specific to international markets might make U.S. investors wary of investing directly in international securities, particularly those listed in developing countries.

不过，有一种替代方案可以让投资者获得国际市场的长期增长潜力，同时避免所有相关风险。雀巢、帝亚吉欧、潘诺瑞卡、联合利华、高露洁、安伯威、喜力、万事达卡和维萨等全球企业，其大部分收入来自美国以外的业务。这些公司的股票在美国上市，或拥有纽约或伦敦交易的美国或全球存托凭证，这些公司遵循最高标准的监管、会计和治理标准。通过投资这些全球企业，投资者可以受益于国际市场的增长潜力。更吸引人的是，这些企业有时以远低于发展中市场同类企业的价格交易，使投资者能够享受全球增长的全部收益，同时避免离岸证券特有的风险，并具有更大的安全边际。

<!--en-->
However, there is an alternative that allows investors to capture the superior long-term growth prospects of international markets without taking all the risks involved in doing so. Global businesses such as Nestlé, Diageo, Pernod Ricard, Unilever, Colgate, Ambev, Heineken, Mastercard, and Visa earn a significant share of their revenues from their operations outside the United States. The shares of these companies are listed in the United States or have American or global depository receipts that trade in New York or London, and these companies adhere to the highest regulatory, accounting, and governance standards. By investing in these global businesses, investors benefit from the growth prospects of international markets. Even more enticing, at times these businesses trade at a significant discount to their counterparts in the developing markets, enabling investors to capture all the upside of global growth, without the risks uniquely inherent in offshore securities, and with a larger margin of safety.

## 结论

<!--en-->
*CONCLUSION*

总之，Graham和Dodd提出的投资方法虽然专注于美国证券，但同样适用于国际市场投资。然而，谨慎的投资者在国际市场还需考虑其他因素。

<!--en-->
In summary, the investment approach articulated by Graham and Dodd, although focused on U.S. securities, turns out to be equally useful for investing in international markets. However, there are additional considerations that prudent investors must consider in international markets.

首先，在许多国际市场，确定企业的内在价值比美国企业更困难，因为存在货币风险、不确定的监管环境以及不稳定的当地宏观经济和政治因素等问题。此外，少数股东可能面临额外风险，因为企业治理可能不佳。这些风险加上股东行动空间有限，不仅显著影响企业的未来价值，还可能导致证券价格长期低于其内在价值。因此，投资者在国际市场需要更大的安全边际，即更低的相对内在价值折扣。

<!--en-->
First, determining a business's intrinsic value is more difficult in many international markets than for U.S. businesses because of issues such as currency risks, uncertain regulatory regimes, and volatile local macroeconomic and political forces. In addition, minority investors may face additional risks because of potentially poor corporate governance. These risks, when coupled with limited scope for shareholder activism, not only significantly affect the future value of businesses, but they could also cause a security to trade at a significant discount to its intrinsic value for an indeterminate period. Consequently, investors require a larger margin of safety, via a deeper discount to intrinsic value, in international markets.

在海外投资的投资者还应提高对管理能力和企业质量的要求。除了评估公司市场的前景外，投资者还需要投入时间和精力，彻底调查管理能力、动机和诚信状况。在寻找具有提升内在价值潜力的企业时，企业质量与估值同样重要，因为优质企业在宏观经济波动期间仍能保持并增长价值，而这类波动在这些市场更为常见。这种增长潜力可进一步保护企业免受错误评估内在价值或因管理层无法控制的因素导致内在价值下降的影响。[^3466]：1 Elroy Dimson, Paul Marsh, and Mike Staunton, “Credit Suisse Global Investment Returns Yearbook 2022 Summary Edition,” Credit Suisse Research Institute, February 2022, http://www.cepii.fr/pdf_pub/wp/2016/wp2016-14.pdf.

<!--en-->
Investors investing outside their home markets should also raise the bar in considering management and business quality. In addition to assessing the outlook for the company's markets, investors need to invest the time and effort to thoroughly investigate management competence, motivations, and integrity. In seeking businesses with the potential to grow intrinsic value, the quality of a company may well be as important as its valuation, because quality businesses can preserve and grow their value during periods of macroeconomic volatility, which are more common in these markets. This growth potential provides added protection against an incorrect assessment of intrinsic value or a decrease in intrinsic value due to factors that may be beyond the control of a company's management.
