## 关于贡献者

<!--en-->
*About the Contributors*

**塞斯·A·克兰曼**，位于波士顿的Baupost Group, LLC的首席执行官兼投资组合经理，自1983年以来一直运用价值投资原则管理一系列成功的投资合作项目。在他的序言中，克兰曼讨论了这一理念的永恒应用，以及价值投资者必须应对的商业、市场和竞争环境的诸多深刻变化。他还是投资经典著作《安全边际》的作者。克兰曼曾担任《安全分析》第六版的联合编辑，也是第七版的编辑。

<!--en-->
**Seth A. Klarman**, CEO and portfolio manager of the Boston-based Baupost Group, LLC, has managed a series of successful investment partnerships using value-investing principles since 1983. In his preface, Klarman discusses the timeless applications of this philosophy, as well as the many profound changes in the business, market, and competitive environment with which value investors must contend. He is also the author of *Margin of Safety*, an investment classic. Klarman served as coeditor of the sixth edition of *Security Analysis* and is the editor of this seventh edition.

**詹姆斯·格兰特**，《格兰特利率观察家》的创始人兼编辑，已撰写有关市场及其运营者的文章半个世纪。他的九本书中包括金融家伯纳德·巴鲁克和维多利亚时代的金融记者沃尔特·贝吉霍特的传记。格兰特的介绍为《安全分析》提供了历史背景，带我们回到格雷厄姆与多德生活和工作那个时代。他曾担任《安全分析》第六版的联合编辑。

<!--en-->
**James Grant**, founder and editor of *Grant's Interest Rate Observer*, has been writing about markets and the people who operate in them for a half-century. Among his nine books are biographies of the financier Bernard Baruch and of the Victorian financial journalist Walter Bagehot. Grant's introduction lends historical context to *Security Analysis* by taking us back to the era in which Graham and Dodd lived and worked. He served as coeditor of the sixth edition of *Security Analysis*.

**罗杰·洛温斯坦**是美国顶尖财经记者之一，著有七本经济史与金融书籍。他的报道曾出现在《华尔街日报》、《纽约时报》、《金融时报》、《华盛顿邮报》、Substack等媒体上。他是畅销书《巴菲特：美国资本家的形成》和《天才失败：长期资本的兴衰》的作者。他最新出版的书《方式与手段、林肯及其内阁与内战融资》获得了2022年哈罗德·霍尔泽图书奖。洛温斯坦还是塞库亚基金的外部董事。

<!--en-->
**Roger Lowenstein** is one of America's top financial journalists and the author of seven books on economic history and finance. His journalism has appeared in the *Wall Street Journal*, the *New York Times*, the *Financial Times*, the *Washington Post*, *Substack*, and many more. He is the bestselling author of the books *Buffett: The Making of an American Capitalist* and *When Genius Failed: The Rise and Fall of Long-Term Capital*. His most recent book, *Ways and Means, Lincoln and His Cabinet and the Financing of the Civil War*, was awarded the 2022 Harold Holzer Book Prize. Mr. Lowenstein is also an outside director of the Sequoia Fund.

**霍华德·S·马克斯，CFA**是位于洛杉矶的奥克特里资本管理公司的董事长兼联合创始人。他是高收益债券的早期投资者，也是格雷厄姆和多德理论的忠实信徒。乍看之下，这两种理念似乎对立，但马克斯表示并非如此。他在第二部分中的介绍解释了《证券分析》中的理念如何能有效地应用于当今企业债券市场。

<!--en-->
**Howard S. Marks, CFA** is chairman and cofounder of Oaktree Capital Management based in Los Angeles. He was an early investor in high-yield bonds and a devotee of Graham and Dodd. At first glance, those two ideas appear to be antithetical, but Marks says that's not the case. His introduction to Part II, which covers fixed-income investments, explains how the ideas in *Security Analysis* can be profitably applied to today's corporate bond market.

**多米尼克·米勒**曾是一家主要对冲基金的合伙人及投资组合经理，该基金专注于困境投资。她在复杂的破产事件中发挥了关键作用，在PG&E进行第11章程序期间担任董事会成员，并在2001年9月11日悲剧事件后，领导了波多黎各联邦和美国主要航空公司的债权人委员会。2017年，她被《对冲基金杂志》和E&Y评为“对冲基金50位领先女性”之一。她是《困境中的少女》一书的作者，这是第一本由女性撰写的对冲基金回忆录，同时也是《福布斯》的撰稿人。

<!--en-->
**Dominique Mielle** is a former partner and portfolio manager at a major hedge fund primarily focused on distressed investments. She played key roles in complicated bankruptcies, serving on the board of PG&E during its Chapter 11 proceeding and leading creditors' committees for the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico and major U.S. airlines in the wake of the tragic events of September 11, 2001. In 2017, she was named one of the “50 Leading Women in Hedge Funds” by the *Hedge Fund Journal* and E&Y. She is the author of *Damsel in Distressed*, the first hedge fund memoir written by a woman, and is also a contributor to Forbes.

**托德·A·康布斯**是GEICO的董事长、总裁兼首席执行官，同时是伯克希尔哈撒韦公司的投资官员。伯克希尔哈撒韦是一家控股公司，其子公司从事多种业务活动，包括金融、保险与再保险、公用事业与能源、货运铁路运输、制造、零售与服务。2010年加入伯克希尔之前，康布斯是卡斯尔点资本的首席执行官和管理成员，这是他于2005年创立的投资合伙公司，负责管理捐赠基金、家族基金会和机构的资金。康布斯曾担任伯克希尔哈撒韦多家子公司的董事，自2016年起担任摩根大通公司的董事。

<!--en-->
**Todd A. Combs** is chairman, president, and CEO of GEICO, as well as an investment officer at Berkshire Hathaway Inc., a holding company whose subsidiaries engage in a number of diverse business activities, including finance, insurance and reinsurance, utilities and energy, freight rail transportation, manufacturing, retailing and services. Prior to joining Berkshire in 2010, Mr. Combs was CEO and managing member of Castle Point Capital, an investment partnership he founded in 2005 to manage capital for endowments, family foundations, and institutions. Mr. Combs has served as a director of various Berkshire Hathaway subsidiaries and has served as a director of JPMorgan Chase & Co. since 2016.

**史蒂文·罗米克**是位于洛杉矶的第一太平洋顾问有限公司的管理合伙人，他负责管理采用价值投资策略的基金。根据晨星公司的数据，由罗米克共同管理的FPA Crescent基金，在所有投资股票的公募共同基金中，风险调整回报最高（资产超过10亿美元），且自成立以来一直由同一管理者管理。他获得了晨星年度美国共同基金管理者称号（2013年），并入选晨星十年国内管理者奖（2009年）以及晨星年度美国共同/替代基金管理者奖（2016年）。在第五部分“价值投资者的演变”的介绍中，罗米克讨论了他作为价值投资者的成长历程、持续学习的重要性，以及如何适应现实世界而非我们希望的世界。

<!--en-->
**Steven Romick** is managing partner of Los Angeles-based First Pacific Advisors, LP, a role in which he manages funds employing value-oriented investment strategies. The FPA Crescent Fund, comanaged by Mr. Romick, has provided the best risk-adjusted returns of all allocation mutual funds (with assets over $1 billion) that invest in equities and have been managed by the same manager since its inception, according to Morningstar. He was awarded Morningstar's U.S.Allocation Fund Manager of the Year (2013) and was a nominee for Morningstar's Domestic Manager of the Decade (2009) and Morningstar's U.S. Allocation/Alternatives Fund Manager of the Year (2016). In the introduction to Part V, "The Evolution of a Value Investor," Mr. Romick discusses his evolution as a value investor, the importance of continuous learning, and responding to the world as it is and not as what we want it to be.

**扎卡里·S·斯特恩伯格和本杰明·F·斯坦**是斯普卢斯 house合伙公司的联合创始人。这是一家位于纽约的投资合伙公司，他们于2005年作为宾夕法尼亚大学二年级学生开始创建。斯普卢斯 house（他们大一宿舍的名字）致力于投资并与少数公共和私人业主经营的企业合作，支持跨多个行业的长期建设企业。在他们的“与业主经营者CEO一起投资”章节中，他们讨论了与业主经营者首席执行官一起投资的利弊，并概述了他们的价值投资历程。

<!--en-->
**Zachary S. Sternberg and Benjamin F. Stein** are the cofounders of the Spruce House Partnership, a New York-based investment partnership that they started in 2005 when they were both sophomores at the University of Pennsylvania. Spruce House (which was the name of their freshman dormitory) is committed to investing in and partnering with a small group of both public and private owner-operated businesses to support building companies for the long term across a range of industries. In their section, "Investing with Owner Operators," they discuss the benefits and risks of investing alongside owner operator CEOs as they outline their value-investing journey.

**南希·齐默尔曼**是位于波士顿的对冲基金Bracebridge Capital的联合创始人和管理合伙人，该基金是绝对回报投资领域的先驱。在第七部分“市场仍不高效”的介绍中，齐默尔曼探讨了格雷厄姆和多德的理念在现代金融领域仍然具有多种相关性，并将套利投资者的视角引入对投资者如何从价格与价值之间的差异中获益的讨论中。

<!--en-->
**Nancy Zimmerman** is cofounder and managing partner of Boston-based hedge fund Bracebridge Capital, a pioneer in the field of absolute return investing. In her introduction to Part VII, "The Market Is Still Not Efficient," Zimmerman explores the many ways in which Graham and Dodd's ideas remain relevant in the world of modern finance and brings an arbitrage investor's perspective to the discussion of the ways investors can seek to benefit from discrepancies between price and value.

**威廉·F·杜哈梅尔、杰森·E·莫曼和阿什什·潘特**是Route One Investment Company, L.P.的负责人，该公司由他们于2010年创立。Route One是一家机构投资管理公司，采用价值投资方法在全球进行投资。在加入Route One之前，他们各自曾是Farallon Capital Management的合伙人。在他们的关于国际投资的章节中，他们讨论了如何应用Graham和Dodd的价值投资方法来寻找国际市场的机会。

<!--en-->
**William F. Duhamel, Jason E. Moment, and Ashish Pant** are principals of Route One Investment Company, L.P., which they founded in 2010. Route One is an institutional investment manager that invests globally following a value-investment approach. Prior to Route One, each of them were partners at Farallon Capital Management. In their chapter on international investing, they discuss their application of Graham and Dodd's value-investing methods to finding opportunity in international markets.

**大卫·艾布拉姆斯**自1999年起担任位于波士顿的Abrams Capital Management的CEO，这是一家领先的对冲基金管理公司。在《公共与私人投资的交汇点：案例研究》一书中，该书作为第七版第九部分，艾布拉姆斯探讨了投资者如何将Graham和Dodd的原则应用于公共和私人市场，并可能发现这些领域的协同效应。在《安全分析》第六版第七部分的介绍中，《股票市场的巨大错觉与价值投资的未来》，艾布拉姆斯描述了他在投资行业早期的经历和教训，同时让权证和期权这一枯燥的主题变得生动有趣。

<!--en-->
**David Abrams** has been the CEO of Boston-based Abrams Capital Management, a leading hedge fund manager since 1999. In “At the Intersection of Public and Private Investing: A Case Study,” which appears as Part IX of the Seventh Edition, Abrams discusses how investors can apply Graham and Dodd’s principles to both public and private markets and may find synergies between those disciplines. For the introduction to Part VII of the sixth edition of *Security Analysis*, “The Great Illusion of the Stock Market and the Future of Value Investing,” Mr. Abrams describes his early experiences in and lessons from the investment business while making the dry subject of warrants and options come alive.

**塞思·亚历山大**是麻省理工学院投资管理公司（MITIMCo）的总裁，该公司隶属于麻省理工学院。MITIMCo管理着麻省理工学院的捐赠基金、退休计划、退休人员福利计划及其他金融资产。在他的文章中，亚历山大讨论了Graham和Dodd的原则如何适用于捐赠基金管理。

<!--en-->
**Seth Alexander** is president of the MIT Investment Management Company (MITIMCo), a division of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. MITIMCo manages the endowment, retirement plan, retiree welfare benefit plan, and other financial assets of MIT. In his essay, Alexander discusses how the principles of Graham and Dodd apply to endowment management.

## 关于作者

<!--en-->
*About the Authors*

**本杰明·格雷厄姆**是华尔街的重要人物，被广泛认为是现代安全分析的创始人。作为价值投资学派的创始人，以及Graham-Newman公司投资基金的创始人和前总裁，格雷厄姆从1928年到1957年在哥伦比亚大学商学院任教。他普及了对市盈率、负债权益比、股息记录、账面价值和收益增长的分析，还撰写了受欢迎的投资指南《聪明投资者》。

<!--en-->
**Benjamin Graham** was a seminal figure on Wall Street and is widely acknowledged to be the father of modern security analysis. The founder of the value school of investing and founder and former president of the Graham-Newman corporation investment fund, Graham taught at Columbia University's Graduate School of Business from 1928 through 1957. He popularized the examination of price-to-earnings (P/E) ratios, debt-to-equity ratios, dividend records, book values, and earnings growth, and also wrote the popular investors' guide *The Intelligent Investor*.

**大卫·L·多德**是本杰明·格雷厄姆在哥伦比亚大学的同事，当时他是金融学助理教授。

<!--en-->
**David L. Dodd** was a colleague of Benjamin Graham's at Columbia University, where he was an assistant professor of finance.

## 第9章

<!--en-->
*CHAPTER 9*

# 债券投资具体标准（继续）

<!--en-->
*Specific Standards for Bond Investment (Continued)*

## 发行条款的内容

<!--en-->
*THE PROVISIONS OF THE ISSUE*

在此标题下，还包含债券安全性、利息支付条件以及到期日期等信息。债券契约中规定的转换及类似权益，固然重要，但它们并不影响选择*固定价值*投资的标准确定。

<!--en-->
Under this heading come such features as the security of the bonds, the conditions affecting interest payments, and the date of maturity. Conversion and similar privileges, specified in the indenture, are, of course, important in themselves, but they do not enter into the determination of standards for the selection of *fixed-value* investments.

根据纽约法规，只有以抵押贷款作为担保的债券才符合公用事业类别的资格。¹ 然而，无担保铁路债券也可以被纳入，只要其收益和股息记录满足比抵押贷款债券更严格的要求。该法规还允许以与债券相同的条件购买收入债券（即那些利息支付义务取决于收益的债券）。

<!--en-->
Under the New York statute, only bonds secured by mortgage are eligible in the public-utility group.¹ However, debenture (unsecured) railroad bonds are admitted, provided the earnings and dividend record meet stiffer requirements than are set forth for mortgage issues. The statute also permits the purchase of income bonds (i.e., those on which the obligation to pay interest is dependent upon earnings) on the same basis as debentures.

**过时的且不合逻辑的限制。** 我们认为这组限制已经非常过时且不合逻辑。鉴于我们在第6章中明确反对过分强调特定安全性的影响，显然我们并不支持完全排除任何无担保债券类别，也不支持制定任何*定义明确的*标准或要求来使担保债券优于信用债券。

<!--en-->
**Obsolete and Illogical Restrictions.** In our opinion this set of restrictions is quite out of date and illogical. In view of our emphatic argument in Chap. 6 against attaching predominant weight to specific security, it must be clear that we do not favor the exclusion of any group of unsecured bond issues per se, or even the establishment of any *sharply defined* standards or requirements which favor secured bonds over debentures.

如果一家公司仅发行一次债券，那么这是第一次抵押贷款还是债券，似乎并没有太大区别，只要后者能防止未来再发行债券。当然，在第一次抵押贷款之后发行的债券，并不像第一次抵押贷款债券那样具有吸引力，尽管投资者在这两种情况下的主要依赖点必须相同——即公司能够履行所有义务。但这一区别同样适用于第二次抵押贷款发行，因此与债券本身无关。我们已经讨论了在优先债权和次级债权之间选择的实际问题（第6章），在考虑利息覆盖能力时，我们将再次讨论这一点。

<!--en-->
If a company has only one bond issue, it would seem to make little difference whether this is a first mortgage or a debenture, provided the latter is protected against the placing of future issues ahead of it. Needless to say, a debenture bondpreceded by a first mortgage is not so attractive as the first-mortgage bond itself, even though the investor's chief reliance in both cases must be the same—*i.e.*, the ability of the company to meet all its obligations. But this distinction would be equally applicable to a second-mortgage issue and hence is not concerned with debentures as such. We have already discussed the practicalities of selecting as between senior and junior liens (Chap. 6) and shall refer to this point again when we consider interest coverage.

收入债券的地位比债券更弱。虽然纽约法规在明确排除所有无担保公用事业债券方面过于严格，但将其铁路*收入型*债券与铁路*债券*采用相同标准来接受，同样因相反原因而令人反感。不同类型收入债券的条款差异很大，基本区别在于：有些债券需按收益支付利息，有些则由董事拥有更大或较小的决策权。总体而言，收入债券与优先股的关系更为密切，而非普通固定债务。因此，我们将在优先股章节中讨论它们，其中会说明在*直接投资*中选择此类证券时，需要特别谨慎和严格。

<!--en-->
**Income Bonds in Weaker Position than Debentures.** While the New York statute is too severe in its categorical exclusion of all unsecured public-utility issues, its acceptance of railroad *income* issues on the same basis as railroad *debentures* is fully as objectionable for the opposite reason. The provisions of income bonds vary greatly among the different issues, the basic distinction being between those on which interest must be paid if earned and those over which the directors have a greater or lesser measure of discretion. Generally speaking, income bonds are allied more closely to preferred stocks than to ordinary fixed obligations. We shall consider them, accordingly, in our chapter on preferred stocks, in which we shall set forth the need for especial caution and strictness in the selection of this type of security for *straight investment*.

由于早期到期性，安全标准不应被放宽。投资者倾向于高度重视债券的*到期日*，因为这与该债券是短期还是长期债券有关。短期到期、在购买后不久即可偿还的债券，从安全性的角度来看被视为有利特征。因此，与购买其他债券相比，投资者在购买即将在短期内（例如不超过三年）到期的票据或债券时，往往对安全标准的要求较低。

<!--en-->
**Standards of Safety Should Not Be Relaxed Because of Early Maturity.** Investors are inclined to attach considerable importance to the *maturity date* of an issue, because of its bearing on whether it is a short- or long-term security. A short maturity, carrying with it the right to repayment soon after purchase, is considered an advantageous feature from the standpoint of safety. Consequently, investors are prone to be less exacting in their standards when purchasing notes or bonds due in a short time (say, up to three years) than in their other bond selections.

我们认为这种区分并不合理。接近到期意味着公司面临再融资问题，同时也赋予投资者优先还款的权利。债券持有人不能仅依赖到期这一事实来确保能获得还款。公司要么必须有可用资金（这种情况相对少见），要么要有盈利能力和财务状况，以能够筹集新资金。企业经常发行短期债券，因为当时它们的信用状况太差，无法以合理的利率进行长期发行。这种做法通常会导致公司在到期时出现问题，进而影响投资者。

<!--en-->
In our opinion this distinction is unsound. A near maturity means a problem of refinancing for the company as well as a privilege of repayment for the investor. The bondholder cannot count on the mere fact of maturity to assure this repayment. The company must either have the cash available (which happens relatively seldom) or else an earning powerand financial position which will permit it to raise new funds. Corporations frequently sell short-term issues because their credit is too poor at the time to permit of a long-term flotation at a reasonable rate. Such a practice frequently results in trouble for the company, and therefore for the investor, at maturity.

*示例：* 菲斯克橡胶公司在1926年出售了1000万美元的5年期5.5美元债券。1929年，由于债券即将到期，其售价降至96美元，尽管公司的收益报告并不理想。但到1931年到期时，本金支付被违约；公司进入接管程序；同年，债券价格跌至10³/4美元。

<!--en-->
*Examples:* The Fisk Rubber Company sold $10,000,000 of five-year $51/2$s in 1926. In 1929 they sold at 96 because of their near maturity, although the company's earnings exhibit was unsatisfactory. But payment of principal was defaulted at maturity in 1931; the company went into receivership; and the price of the notes fell to $10^{3/4}$ in that year.

1929年，纽约、芝加哥和圣路易斯铁路公司（镍板铁路）出售了2000万美元的3年期6%债券。这些债券一直被多次延长，但过程极其困难，且如果持有人拒绝续约，还会面临破产的威胁。（1936年，债券的售价低至$26^{3/4}$。）

<!--en-->
In 1929 the New York, Chicago and St. Louis Railway (Nickel Plate) sold $20,000,000 of three-year 6% notes. They have been repeatedly extended but only with great difficulty and upon threat of insolvency if the holders refused to extend. (In 1936 they sold as low as $26^{3/4}$.)

最近的一个例子是宾夕法尼亚-迪克西水泥公司第一6s债券，到期日为1941年9月。在1939年初，该债券售价高于面值。1937年和1938年，该债券仅能覆盖利息费用（按较低的折旧标准计算），并且在之前的六年中出现了亏损。净流动资产低于未偿还债券金额。当然，1941年的情况可能允许偿还此债券；但那些在1939年以全价购买的人，无疑正在承担不必要的风险，即本金价值会大幅缩水。

<!--en-->
A recent example of apparently unwarranted partiality accorded by the bond market to an issue of near maturity is supplied by Pennsylvania-Dixie Cement Company First 6s, due September 1941, which in early 1939 sold above par. This issue had barely covered interest charges (on a reduced depreciation basis) in 1937 and 1938, and had reported deficits in the six preceding years. Net current assets were less than the outstanding bonds. It was possible, of course, that conditions in 1941 might permit the repayment of this security; but those who bought it at a full price in 1939 were undoubtedly taking an unnecessary risk of severe shrinkage of principal value.

*同一债券短期与长期到期日的区别*。有很多案例表明，投资者愿意为短期债券支付比同一公司的长期债券更高的价格。几乎在所有情况下，这都被证明是一个错误——因为要么(1)公司的信用状况改善，此时长期到期日的价格会大幅上涨；要么(2)公司无法在到期时偿还短期债券。

<!--en-->
*Distinctions between Short and Long Maturities of the Same Issue.* There have been quite a number of cases in which investors have been willing to pay much higher prices for a short-term issue than for an equally secured long-term issue of the same company. In nearly every case this has proved a mistake—because either (1) the company's credit improved, in which case the distant maturity had a much greater rise inprice, or else (2) the company was unable to pay off the short term issue at maturity.

基于上述讨论和例子，我们建议不要区分长期和短期债券，因为这样做会放松对选择短期债券时的安全标准。²

<!--en-->
Because of the foregoing discussion and examples we advise against the drawing of distinctions between long- andshort-term issues such as result in any relaxation of standards of safety in the selection of issues of the latter type.²

### 利息和股息支付记录

<!--en-->
*RECORD OF INTEREST AND DIVIDEND PAYMENTS*

以投资为目的购买的债券应拥有发行方长期成功运营和财务稳定的充分记录。新企业和刚从财务困境中脱困的企业无法获得支持固定价值投资所必需的高信用评级。³同样，在之前几年中从未按时履行义务的州或市也应被排除在外。

<!--en-->
Bonds purchased on an investment basis should have behind them a sufficiently long record of successful operation and of financial stability on the part of the issuer. New enterprises and those recently emerged from financial difficulties are not entitled to the high credit rating essential to justify a fixed-value investment.³ A similar disqualification would logically apply to states or municipalities which have failed to meet their obligations punctually at any time over a preceding period of years.

**纽约法的规定。** 纽约法认可这一标准，并具体表述如下：如果纽约州以外的州在过去*十年*内未拖欠利息或本金支付，则这些州的债券符合要求。对于纽约州以外的市，期限为*二十五年*；对于铁路公司，为*六年*；对于燃气、电力和电话公司，为*八年*。

<!--en-->
**Provisions of New York Statute.** The New York statute recognizes this criterion and gives it concrete expression as follows: Bonds of states other than New York are eligible if the state has not defaulted on interest or principal payments during the previous *ten years*. For municipalities outside New York State, the period is *twenty-five years*; for railroads, *six years*; for gas, electric, and telephone companies, *eight years*.

然而，对于企业债券，关于收益覆盖的要求将在下一节中讨论——应充分考虑过去记录问题。收益要求所涵盖的时间仅比上述期限稍短，因此除了收益测试外，再要求过去偿债能力测试似乎是不必要的复杂化。

<!--en-->
With respect to bonds of corporations, however, the requirements as to earnings coverage to be discussed under the next heading—should adequately take care of the question of past record. The time covered by the earnings requirement is only a little shorter than the periods above suggested, and hence it would seem an unnecessary complication to exact a past-solvency test in addition to an earnings test.

另一方面，民事债务并非基于收益记录来销售。因此，投资者必须高度重视按时支付的良好历史。纽约法规定的这一点要求无疑对普通投资者来说很合理。

<!--en-->
Civil obligations, on the other hand, are not sold on the basis of an earnings record. Consequently the investor is compelled to attach primary importance to a satisfactory history of punctual payment. The requirement on this point set forth in the New York statute would no doubt appear reasonable to the average investor.

然而，如果不考虑普遍采用这种规则可能带来的后果，我们就无法推荐这样的投资规则。如果所有市政债券购买都要求有25年的清洁记录，那么任何镇区在存在期第一个世纪内如何发行债券呢？同样，如果一个州或市已经陷入违约状态，它如何在分别需要的10年或25年内恢复其债务到合格名单中呢？对于企业而言，这种融资可以通过出售股票、可转换债券，甚至大幅折扣的债券来投机性实现。但这些方法不适用于市。实际上，通过提高信用较低的州或市债务的票面利率来解决问题。例如，一个从财务困境中脱困的城市可以通过提供5%的票面利率来吸引新资金，而纽约州只支付2%。⁴ 但这种解决方案与之前制定的原则相悖：高票面利率不足以补偿承担重大本金风险。换句话说，如果市政债券被认为等级较低且违约可能性大于名义水平，那么因其高收益而购买该债券是错误的。

<!--en-->
We cannot recommend such a rule of investment, however, without considering the results that would follow from its general adoption. If all purchases of municipal bonds requireda clean record for 25 years, how could any township float a bond issue during the first quarter-century of its existence? And similarly, if a state or city has been driven into default, how will it finance itself during the 10 or 25 years, respectively, needed to restore its obligations to the eligible list? In the case of corporations, such financing might be accomplished on a speculative basis, through the sale of stock, or convertible bonds, or even bonds at a large discount. But such methods are not open to municipalities. The difficulty is met in actual practice by raising the coupon rate on the obligations of states or municipalities with inferior credit. For example, a city emerging from financial embarrassment might be able to attract new funds by offering a 5% coupon rate in contrast with 2% paid by New York State.⁴ But this solution of the problem runs counter to the principle, previously developed, that a high coupon rate is not adequate compensation for the assumption of substantial risk of principal. In other words, it would be a mistake to buy a municipal obligation for its high yield, if it is recognized as inferior in grade and subject to more than a nominal possibility of default.

**一个困境与建议的解决方案。** 因此，我们面临一个困境，因为债券购买者的理论正确态度会使许多市政机构的必要融资变得不可能。现实来看，可以认为总会有足够的无差别投资者购买任何提供看似吸引人的利率的镇村债券。因此，理性谨慎的债券购买者可以避免这类债券，不会给信用第二级的借款人带来致命后果。

<!--en-->
**A Dilemma and a Suggested Solution.** We are faced therefore by a dilemma, since the theoretically correct attitude of the bond buyer would render impossible the necessary financing of many municipalities. Viewing the matter realistically, it may be dismissed with the observation that there will always be enough undiscriminating investors on hand to absorb the bonds of any town or village which offers a seemingly attractive rate. Consequently the logical and careful bond buyer can avoid such issues without fatal results to borrowers having second-rate credit.

这种困境的处理方式过于冷酷，无法完全令人满意。理想的解决方案可能是设立一些特别严格的定量测试，以弥补市政当局未能满足25年准时支付要求的缺陷。如果城市陷入财务困难，必须通过减少开支、提高税率和其他收入来源，或者像企业重组那样强制削减债务来恢复状态。通过这些手段，城市可以将其财务状况建立在全新的、稳健的基础上，从而尽管之前有违约记录，仍能获得令人满意的信用评级。但谨慎的投资者只有在仔细研究财务数据后，包括支出与总债务与人口、房产价值和收入之间的关系等指标，才会给予这样的信用评级。债券购买者应预期能获得高于标准的收益，因为收益并非基于承担特殊风险，而是基于确保发行方稳健性的努力。

<!--en-->
This disposition of the dilemma is too cynical to be entirely satisfactory. The ideal solution would probably lie in setting up some especially stringent quantitative tests to compensate for the failure by a municipality to meet the twenty-five year requirement of punctual payment. If a city has fallen into financial difficulties, it must rehabilitate itself by reducing its expenditures, or by raising its tax rate and other revenue, or possibly by a compulsory scaling down of itsdebt, corresponding to a corporate reorganization. By such means the town may place its finances on an entirely new and sound basis entitling it to a satisfactory credit rating in spite of its previous default. But the prudent investor will accord such a credit rating only after a careful study of the financial exhibit, including such items as the relation of expenditures and total debt, on the one hand, to population, property values and revenues, on the other. The bond buyer should expect to obtain a higher than standard yield on municipal obligations of this character, in repayment *not for the assumption of special risk, but for the effort required to satisfy himself of the soundness of the issue*.

对于新成立的民间组织，也应采取类似态度，因为它们只有短暂的债务偿还记录。⁵ **股息记录**。管理合法投资的法规传统上非常重视发行企业的股息支付记录。在大多数州，债券只有在该公司至少五年内定期支付一定最低金额的股息时才有资格。这一要求显然基于这样的理论：既然公司存在是为了支付股息，只有真正支付股息的公司才能被视为真正成功，因此适合进行债券投资。

<!--en-->
A similar attitude should be taken towards newly organized civil bodies, where only a short record of debt service is available.⁵
**The Dividend Record.** The statutes governing legal investments have traditionally laid great stress upon a satisfactory record of dividend payments by the issuing enterprise. In most states a bond is eligible only if the company has paid regular dividends in certain minimum amounts for at least five years. This requirement is evidently based on the theory that since corporations exist in order to pay dividends, only those which do in fact pay dividends may be said to be really successful and therefore suitable for bond investment.

*股息记录并非财务实力的决定性证据。*不可否认，支付股息的企业整体比不支付股息的企业更繁荣。但这一事实本身并不能作为对所有不支付股息企业的债券进行一概否定的依据。一个非常有力的反对这一规则的理由是：支付股息只是财务实力的一种迹象；它不仅不会给债券持有人带来任何直接好处，反而可能因减少公司资源而损害其利益。实际上，管理合法投资的法规中的股息条款有时会产生与预期相反的效果。财务状况不佳的铁路公司为了维持债券在合格名单上的地位，随意继续支付股息，以至于本应表明实力的情况实际上降低了债券的安全性。⁶ 股息记录在债券投资中的作用。资产负债表和收入账户提供的信息应被视为比股息支付记录更可靠的企业稳健性线索。因此，在确定债券是否适合直接投资时，最好放弃关于股息支付的所有严格规定。但当公司收入看似良好却未支付股息时，意图购买债券的投资者应更加谨慎地审查情况，以了解董事政策是否源于尚未反映在收入账户中的弱点。我们还可以顺便指出，支付股息的公司债券具有某种机械优势：其所有者可以通过股息的后续发放获得明确的、可能的及时预警，从而保持警惕，避免严重损失。不支付股息的公司债券在这方面处于一定劣势，但我们认为，投资者稍加谨慎即可充分弥补这一不足。

<!--en-->
*Dividend Record Not Conclusive Evidence of Financial Strength.* It may not be denied that dividend-paying concerns as a class are more prosperous than non-dividend payers. But this fact would not in itself justify the summary condemnation of all the bonds of non-dividend-paying enterprises. An exceedingly strong argument *against* such a rule lies in the fact that the payment of dividends is only an indication of financial strength; and not only does it fail to afford any direct advantage to the bondholder, but it may often be injurious to his interests by reducing the corporation's resources. In actual practice the dividend provisions of the statutes governing legal investments have at times had consequences directly opposite to those intended. Railroad companies in a weak financial position have improvidently continued dividend payments forthe particular purpose of maintaining their bonds on the eligible list, so that the very practice supposed to indicate strength behind the bond has in reality undermined its safety.⁶
The Role of the Dividend Record in Bond Investment. The evidence given by the balance sheet and income account must be regarded as a more dependable clue to the soundness of an enterprise than is the record of dividend payments. It seems best therefore to dispense with all hard and fast rules on the latter point in determining the suitability of bond issues for straight investment. But the failure of a company to pay dividends when the earnings appear satisfactory should properly cause an intending bond buyer to scrutinize the situation with more than usual care, in order to discover whether the policy of the directors is due to weak elements in the picture not yet reflected in the income account. We might also point out incidentally that the bonds of dividend-paying companies possess a certain mechanical advantage in that their owners may receive a definite and perhaps timely warning of impending trouble by the later passing of the dividend; and being thus placed on their guard, they may be able to protect themselves against serious loss. Bonds of nondividend-paying concerns are at a certain disadvantage in this respect, but in our opinion this may be adequately offset by the exercise of somewhat greater caution on the part of the investor.

纽约州的法规在处理股息问题方面比其他州更为进步。铁路公司被要求在过去六年中至少有五年支付一定金额的股息，否则必须满足更严格의固定费用覆盖要求。公用事业公司则被要求在前五年中至少支付一定金额的股息，或获得相当于该金额的收入。这一规定与其他法规存在错误，可能会促使支付非自愿股息。渐进理念体现在规定的另一面：只要已赚取股息，就不支付股息。

<!--en-->
The New York statute is somewhat more progressive than those of other states in its treatment of the dividend question. Railroads are required alternatively either to have paid dividends of a certain amount in five out of the last six years, or failing this, to meet more stringent requirements as to coverage of fixed charges. Public-utility companies are required either to have paid certain dividends in each of the five preceding years, or else to have earned an amount equal thereto. This provision falls into the error of the other statutes by possibly impelling payment of unearned dividends. The progressive idea appears in the converse side of the provision, which waives payment of dividends so long as they are earned.

### 收益与利息要求的关系

<!--en-->
*RELATION OF EARNINGS TO INTEREST REQUIREMENTS*

现代投资者通常将收益与利息费用的比例视为安全性的最重要具体标准。因此，任何规范债券投资选择的详细法规必然包含关于这一核心因素的最低要求。然而，大多数法规仅以零散且不充分的方式涉及这一点。立法机构在很大程度上依赖公司分红记录来确保良好的盈利能力。⁷正如我们刚才指出的，这一标准存在严重质疑。纽约法规的优越性主要体现在两个方面：首先，它充分认识到充足收益记录的重要性；其次，它将公司的*总*固定费用作为一个不可分割的单位来处理。

<!--en-->
The present-day investor is accustomed to regard the ratio of earnings to interest charges as the most important specific test of safety. It is to be expected therefore that any detailed legislation governing the selection of bond investments would be sure to include minimum requirements in respect to this cardinal factor. Nevertheless the majority of the statutes cover this point in only a fragmentary and inadequate manner. The legislatures have relied to a considerable extent on their requirements as to the company's dividend record to assure a satisfactory earning power.⁷ As we have just pointed out, this criterion is open to serious objection. The superiority of the New York statute is manifest chiefly in two provisions: first, its recognition of the prime importance of an adequate earnings record; and secondly, its consistent treatment of a company's *total* fixed charges as an indivisible unit.

**纽约法的要求。**纽约法关于*收益覆盖*的要求可概括如下：

<!--en-->
**Requirements of the New York Law.** The requirements of the New York law with respect to *earnings coverage* may be summarized as follows:

对于铁路抵押贷款债券（或等效的担保信托债券）和铁路设备债券，公司必须在紧接之前的六年中连续五年，以及最近一年，其固定费用达到收益的1.5倍。如果未按约定支付股息，则期限为前十年中的九年。

<!--en-->
In the case of railroad-mortgage bonds (or collateral-trust bonds equivalent thereto) and railroad-equipment obligations, the company must have earned its fixed charges 1½ times in five out of the six years immediately preceding, and also in the latest year. If dividends have not been paid as stipulated, then the period is set at nine out of the ten preceding years.

对于其他类型的铁路债券，如信用债券、收入债券等，固定费用（加上收入债券的利息，如有）必须在最近一年及之前六年中连续五年达到两倍。在这一类别中，对股息支付的要求似乎是绝对的，不允许替代方案。

<!--en-->
In the case of other kinds of railroad bonds, e.g., debentures, income obligations, etc., the fixed charges (plus interest on income bonds, if any) must be earned twice in both the latest year and in five out of the six preceding years. In this category, the requirement as to dividend payments is apparently absolute, and no substitute therefor is admitted.

对于天然气、电力和电话债券，过去五年的*平均*收益必须相当于*平均*总利息费用的两倍，且最近一年也必须满足同样的覆盖要求。

<!--en-->
In the case of gas, electric, and telephone bonds, the *average* earnings for the past five years must have equalled twice the *average* total-interest charges, and the same coverage must have been shown in the latest year.

**收益覆盖的三个阶段：1.计算方法。**分析这些法规条款时，有三个要素值得考虑。第一是计算收益覆盖*方法*；第二是所需覆盖*金额*；第三是测试所需的*时间周期*。

<!--en-->
**Three Phases of the Earnings Coverage: 1. Method of Computation.** In analyzing these statutory provisions, three elements deserve consideration. The first is the *method* of computing the earnings coverage; the second is the *amount* of coverage required; and the third is the period required for the test.

*优先扣除法*。目前有多种方法用于计算和说明收益与利息费用的关系。其中一种（可称为优先扣除法）完全不可接受。不过，在1933年之前，大多数发行机构在发行初级债券时都采用这种方法，因为它能营造出看似强大的效果。该流程包括首先从收益中扣除之前的费用，然后计算余额中满足初级要求的倍数。以下示例展示了该方法本身及其固有的荒谬性：

<!--en-->
*The Prior-Deductions Method.* Various methods are in common use for computing and stating the relation of earnings to interest charges. One of these (which may be called the Prior-deductions Method) is thoroughly objectionable. Nevertheless, prior to 1933 it was followed by the majority of issuing houses in their circulars offering junior bonds for sale, because it makes for a deceptively strong exhibit. The procedure consists of first deducting the prior charges from the earnings and then calculating the number of times the junior requirements are covered by the balance. The following illustration will show both the method itself and its inherent absurdity:

A公司拥有1000万美元的第一期抵押贷款5%债券，以及500万美元6%信用债券。

<!--en-->
Company A has $10,000,000 of first-mortgage, 5% bonds and $5,000,000 of debenture 6% bonds.

其平均收益为140万美元。扣除前5年的利息后，收益为500,000美元，达到2.8倍。信用债券余额为90万美元。6%信用债券的利息为30万美元，达到3倍。发行6%信用债券的通告中可能写道“如上所示”，利息费用被覆盖3次。但需注意，前5年的利息仅被覆盖2.8次。这些数字意味着初级债券的保护程度高于高级债券，这显然荒谬。事实上，这种优先扣除法得出的初级债券结果完全毫无价值且具有误导性。1933年《证券法》的一个积极成果就是放弃这种无法辩护的债券发行利息覆盖表述方式。这一变化显然并非由于法规或SEC规定中的特定禁止，而是为了避免因欺诈而面临处罚。

<!--en-->
Its average earnings are $1,400,000
Deduct interest on first 5s 500,000 earned 2.8 times
Balance for debenture 6s $ 900,000
Interest on debenture 6s $ 300,000 earned 3 times
A circular offering the 6% debenture issue was likely to state that “as shown above” the interest charges are covered three times. It should be noted, however, that the interest on the first 5s is covered only 2.8 times. The implication of these figures would be that the junior issue is better protected than the senior issue, which is clearly absurd. The fact is that the results shown for junior bonds by this prior-deductions method are completely valueless and misleading. One of the favorable results of the Securities Act of 1933 has been the abandonment of this indefensible method of stating interest coverage in new bond offerings. This change has been due, apparently, not to any specific prohibition by the statute or the S.E.C. regulations but rather to the desire to avoid risking penalties for deceit.

一些加拿大债券发行通告仍使用优先扣除法。*示例：*Famous Players Canadian Corporation, Ltd. 第一和担保信托债券A系列，于1936年6月左右发行。

<!--en-->
Some Canadian bond offering circulars still use the prior-deductions method. *Example:* Famous Players Canadian Corporation, Ltd., First and Collateral Trust Bonds, Series A, offered about June 1936.

*累积扣除法*。第二种方法称为累积扣除法。根据这种方法，次级债券的利息总是与之前的及同等费用一起考虑。在给出的例子中，6s债券的利息计算为 earned $1\frac{3}{4}$ 倍，即通过将 *两笔* 债务的合并费用 *共* $800,000 除以可获得的收益 $1,400,000 得到。然而，首期抵押利息则被认为是 earned 2.8 倍，因为在本方法中，比所分析债券更次级的债券利息未被考虑。大多数投资者认为这种观点完全合理，许多州在其关于债券能否用于储蓄银行投资的法规中专门规定了这种程序。⁸ *总扣除法或“整体”法*。然而，在前一章中，我们强调了公司履行所有固定义务能力的重要性，因为因次级留置权违约导致的破产总是会对先期抵押债券持有人造成不利影响。只有当总利息费用得到充分覆盖时，投资者才能确保自己的立场。因此，计算利息覆盖率的保守且建议采用的方式应始终使用“总扣除法”；即，控制指标应是 *所有* 固定费用被覆盖的次数。这意味着在分析任何公司的所有固定利息债券时，无论它们是高级还是次级留置权，都会使用 *相同的* 收益比率。在上面的例子中，比率将为 $1\frac{3}{4}$，适用于5s或6s债券。在债券通函和年度报告中，这种方法现在通常被称为计算利息覆盖率的“整体基础”。⁹ 重要的是要记住，固定费用不包括收入债券利息，后者是一种 *偶然* 费用。为了方便起见，除非上下文另有说明，否则也会使用“利息费用”和“债券债务”等词，仅指固定利息债券。

<!--en-->
*The Cumulative-Deductions Method.* The second procedure may be called the Cumulative-Deductions Method. Under this method, interest on a junior bond is always considered in conjunction with prior and equivalent charges. In the example given, the interest on the debenture 6s would be computed as earned $1\frac{3}{4}$ times, found by dividing the combined charges of *both* issues, namely $800,000, into the available earnings of $1,400,000. The first-mortgage interest, however, would be said to be earned 2.8 times, since bond interest *junior* to the issue analyzed is left out of consideration in this method. The majority of investors would regard this point of view as entirely sound, and the procedure has been specifically prescribed by a number of states in their enactments governing the eligibility of bonds for savings-bank investment.⁸
*The Total-Deductions or “Over-All” Method.* In a previous chapter, however, we have emphasized the primary importance of a company's ability to meet all its fixed obligations, because insolvency resulting from default on a junior lien invariably reacts to the disadvantage of the prior-mortgage bondholders. An investor can be sure of his position only if the total-interest charges are well covered. Consequently, the conservative and therefore advisable way of calculating interest coverage should always be by the “total-deductions method”; *i.e.*, the controlling figure should be the number of times that *all* fixed charges are covered. This would mean that the *same earnings ratio would be used in analyzing all the fixed interest bonds of any company*, whether they are senior or junior liens. In the example above given, the ratio would be $1\frac{3}{4}$, as applied to either the first 5s or the debenture 6s. In bond circulars and annual reports this method is now commonly referred to as the “over-all basis” for computing interest coverage.⁹
It is important to bear in mind that fixed charges exclude income-bond interest which is a *contingent* charge. The words “interest charges” and “bonded debt” are also used, for convenience, to refer only to fixed interest bonds unless the context indicates otherwise.

当然，没有理由不也用累积扣除法来计算高级债券의覆盖情况，如果这种覆盖非常大，可以合理地将其视为支持该债券的另一个理由。但我们的建议是，在应用任何旨在测试公司实力的 *最低* 要求时，应始终考虑总固定费用。纽约法规一直坚持这一立场，我们认为它值得批准并遵循。

<!--en-->
There is no reason, of course, why the coverage for a senior bond should not be computed by the cumulative-deductions method also, and if this coverage is very large it may properly be regarded as an added argument in favor of the issue. But our recommendation is that in applying any *minimum* requirement designed to test the company’s strength, the total fixed charges should always be taken into account. The New York statute holds consistently to this very stand, and in our opinion it deserves to be approved and followed.

**2. 收益覆盖的最低要求。** 纽约法规对铁路债券给予优先于公用事业债券的做法已不再合理，最近两组债券的表现表明它们的相对顺序应该颠倒。还需要增加工业债券的最低数值，显然应设定得高于公用事业或铁路债券。考虑到这些因素，我们应该建议以下总固定费用覆盖的最低要求：

<!--en-->
**2. Minimum Requirements for Earnings Coverage.** The preference accorded by the New York statute to railroad bonds over public-utility issues is no longer justified, and the more recent record of both groups suggests that their relative positions should be reversed. It is necessary, also, to add a minimum figure for industrial bonds, which should clearly be set higher than for either utilities or rails. Taking these factors into account, we should recommend the following minimum requirements for the coverage of total fixed charges:

<table><tr><td>公共事业企业</td><td>1 3/4倍</td></tr><tr><td>铁路公司</td><td>2倍</td></tr><tr><td>工业类企业</td><td>3倍</td></tr></table>

<!--en-->
<table><tr><td>Public utilities</td><td>1 3/4 times</td></tr><tr><td>Railroads</td><td>2 times</td></tr><tr><td>Industrials</td><td>3 times</td></tr></table>

**3. 收益测试所涵盖的时间段。** 我们对纽约关于收益覆盖规定的总结指出，对于公用事业债券，使用五年平均值。但对于铁路债券，规定的最低保证金必须在最近六年中连续五年内显示。在所有情况下，最低标准必须在投资日期前的那一年达到。

<!--en-->
**3. The Period Comprised by the Earnings Test.** Our summary of the New York provisions regarding earnings coverage pointed out that the five-year average is used in the case of utility issues. For railroad bonds, however, the stipulated minimum margin must be shown in five separate years out of the latest six. In all instances, the minimum must be met in the year immediately preceding the date of investment.

如最后两项要求，很容易制定，但它们不太适合经济世界中债券投资的现实情况，因为经济会经历多年严重萧条。如果商业的一般特征是在八个繁荣或平均年份之后有两年亏损，这些规则的效果将是鼓励在好时期以高价格投资债券，并在萧条时期推动以低价格出售债券。¹⁰ 在我们看来，最低收益标准的唯一实际 *严格* 应用必须是时间段内的 *平均* 结果。如法规对公用事业债券规定的五年平均值，在许多情况下似乎太短，我们应该建议 *七年期间* 作为更合适的正常标准。但可能会稍微缩短，以排除明显异常年份。（例如，1934–1939年的六年期间可能比1933–1939年的七年期间提供更公平的测试期。）

<!--en-->
Requirements such as the last two are easy to promulgate, but they are poorly suited to the realities of bond investment in an economic world subject to recurring years of serious depression. If it should be characteristic of business in generalto experience eight prosperous or average years followed by two unprofitable ones, the effect of these rules would be to encourage investment in bonds (at high prices) during good times, and to impel their sale (at low prices) during depressions.¹⁰
In our view, the only practical *rigid* application of a minimum-earnings standard must be to the *average* results over a period of time. A five-year average, as prescribed by the statute in the case of public-utility bonds, would seem too short under many circumstances, and we should suggest a *seven-year period* as a more suitable normal standard. But this might be shortened somewhat to exclude clearly abnormal years. (For example, the six-year period 1934–1939 would probably provide a fairer test period than the seven-year period 1933–1939.)

如果测试是在1934年或1935年进行的，那么使用十年甚至十二年的周期会更好，以避免过分强调严重抑郁的年份。实际考虑还表明，对1931–1933年间一些工业公司所经历的大额亏损进行平均处理，可能会得出过高的收益覆盖率，无法真实反映当前情况，即使采用了长期平均值。这一难题可以通过任意方式解决：将亏损年份的收益视为零，而不是实际的负数数值。

<!--en-->
If the test had been made, say, in 1934 or 1935, it would have been better to use a ten- or even twelve-year period to avoid giving undue weight to years of severe depression. Practical considerations suggest also that averaging-in the large deficits experienced by some industrial companies during 1931–1933 might produce an earnings-coverage figure too low to be fairly representative of the current situation, even though a long-term average were taken. This difficulty may be solved, arbitrarily, by considering the earnings in deficit years as zero instead of the actual negative figure.

*示例：* 费尔班克斯莫尔斯公司1956年到期的4s债券，在1938年初的收益覆盖率。

<!--en-->
*Example:* Interest coverage of Fairbanks Morse Company Debenture 4s, due 1956, as of early 1938.

<table><tr><td>1937年的利息费用</td><td>$232,000</td></tr><tr><td>1937年扣除利息和税后的收益</td><td>2,148,000</td></tr><tr><td>1937年的利息收益</td><td>10.2倍</td></tr><tr><td>1928–30年和1934–37年扣除利息后的总收益</td><td>11,740,000</td></tr><tr><td>1931–1933年扣除利息后的总亏损</td><td>8,873,000</td></tr><tr><td>1928–1937年扣除利息后的年度收益</td><td>287,000</td></tr><tr><td>表示1937年利息费用的10年覆盖率</td><td>2.2倍</td></tr><tr><td>计算10年覆盖率的另一种方法：</td><td></td></tr><tr><td>将1931–1933年视为零，计算10年扣除利息的平均收益</td><td>$ 1,174,000</td></tr><tr><td>修正后的1937年利息费用的10年覆盖率</td><td>6.1倍</td></tr><tr><td>股票市值比率</td><td>每1美元面额债券对应3.42美元的市场股票价值</td></tr></table>

<!--en-->
<table><tr><td>Interest charges, 1937</td><td>$232,000</td></tr><tr><td>Earned after interest and taxes, 1937</td><td>2,148,000</td></tr><tr><td>1937 interest earned</td><td>10.2 times</td></tr><tr><td>Total earnings after interest, 1928–30 and 1934–37</td><td>11,740,000</td></tr><tr><td>Total deficits after interest, 1931–1933</td><td>8,873,000</td></tr><tr><td>Annual earnings after interest, 1928–1937</td><td>287,000</td></tr><tr><td>Indicated 10-year coverage for 1937 interest charges</td><td>2.2 times</td></tr><tr><td>Alternative basis for calculating the 10-year coverage:</td><td></td></tr><tr><td>10-year average earnings after interest, counting 1931–1933 years as zero</td><td>$ 1,174,000</td></tr><tr><td>Revised 10-year coverage for 1937 interest charges</td><td>6.1 times</td></tr><tr><td>Stock-equity ratio</td><td>$3.42 of stock at market for each $1 of bonds at par</td></tr></table>

第二种或修正后的平均值，比单纯的十年平均值更能真实反映公司的盈利能力，后者无法满足我们的最低要求。不过，我们相信从1940年开始，可以使用七年或更长的平均值，而不必面临类似问题。

<!--en-->
The second, or revised, average must be considered as a more realistic reflection of the company’s earning power than the straight ten-year average, which fails to meet our minimum requirement. We trust, however, that from 1940 on it will be possible to use seven-year averages, or longer, without having to meet a similar problem.

**收益记录的其他方面。**当然，还有许多其他收益方面的因素，投资者应该关注。其中包括*趋势*、*最低水平*和*当前水平*。这些方面的重要性不容否认，但它们并不适合应用严格固定的规则。在这种情况下，就像之前讨论的抵押贷款担保一样，必须区分那些可以成功纳入明确且普遍适用规则的少数因素，以及许多难以精确规定但仍需由投资者通过*判断*考虑的其他因素。

<!--en-->
**Other Phases of the Earnings Record.** There are, of course, a number of other aspects of the earnings picture to which the investor would do well to pay attention. Among these are the *trend*, the *minimum* figure, and the *current* figure. The importance of each of these cannot be gainsaid, but they do not lend themselves effectively to the application of hard and fast rules. In this case, as in the matter of mortgage security previously discussed, a distinction must be drawn between the few factors which can successfully be embraced by definite and universally applicable rules, and the many other factors which resist such exact formulation but must nevertheless be taken into account by the *judgment* of the investor.

**不利因素可以被抵消。**处理后一种类型的因素的实际方法可以在收益数据中体现。投资者必须要求至少等于最低标准的平均值。此外，他还会被以下因素吸引：(a)利润上升趋势；(b)特别良好的当前表现；(c)在研究期间每年利息费用之间的满意差额。如果债券在这三个方面中的任何一个方面存在不足，结果不一定是要否定该债券，而是要求收益覆盖率远高于最低标准，并要求更关注整体或质量方面的因素。如果趋势不利，或者最新数据明显差，除非平均收益显著高于最低要求——且除非他有合理理由相信下降趋势或当前低迷不会持续无限期地继续，否则投资者不应接受该债券。当然，为了抵消不利趋势或当前表现，平均值需要提高多少，是由投资者自行决定的，不能形成任何数学公式。

<!--en-->
**Unfavorable Factors May Be Offset.** The practical method of dealing with elements of the latter type may be illustrated in this matter of the earning exhibit. The investor must *demand* an average at least equal to the minimum standard. In addition, he will be *attracted* by: (a) a rising trend of profits; (b) an especially good current showing; and (c) a satisfactory margin over interest charges in *every* year during the period studied. If a bond is deficient in any one of these three aspects,the result should not necessarily be to condemn the issue but rather to exact an average earnings coverage well in excess of the minimum and to require closer attention to the general or qualitative elements in the situation. If the trend has been unfavorable, or the latest figure alone has been decidedly poor, the investor should certainly not accept the bond unless the average earnings have been substantially above the minimum requirement—*and unless also he has reasonable grounds for believing that the downward trend or the current slump is not likely to continue indefinitely*. Needless to say, the amount by which the average must be advanced in order to offset an unfavorable trend or current exhibit is a matter within the discretion of the investor to determine, and cannot be developed into any set of mathematical formulas.

### 票息率与收益的关系

<!--en-->
*The Relation of the Coupon Rate to the Earnings*

**覆盖性。** 收益覆盖理论因算术事实而复杂化：这种覆盖性与利率呈反向关系。假设收益相同，3%债券发行的利息收益将是6%利率时的两倍。请参考以下比较：

<!--en-->
**Coverage.** The theory of earnings coverage is complicated by the arithmetical fact that this coverage varies inversely with the rate of interest. Given the same earnings, interest on a 3% bond issue would be earned twice as many times as it would be if the rate were 6%. Consider the following comparison:

<table><thead><tr><th></th><th>公用事业公司A</th><th>公用事业公司B</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>利息收益</td><td>$600,000</td><td>$600,000</td></tr><tr><td>利息费用</td><td>（10,000,000美元的3%）</td><td>（10,000,000美元的5½%）</td></tr><tr><td></td><td>300,000</td><td>550,000</td></tr><tr><td>利息收益倍数</td><td>2.00</td><td>1.09</td></tr></tbody></table>

<!--en-->
<table><thead><tr><th></th><th>Utility Company A</th><th>Utility Company B</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Earnings for interest</td><td>$600,000</td><td>$600,000</td></tr><tr><td>Interest charges</td><td>(3% on $10,000,000)</td><td>(5 1/2% on $10,000,000)</td></tr><tr><td></td><td>300,000</td><td>550,000</td></tr><tr><td>Times interest earned</td><td>2.00</td><td>1.09</td></tr></tbody></table>

仅票息率的差异就使公司*A*通过收益覆盖测试，而公司*B*几乎无法获得利息。这一点可能引发几个问题：(1) 仅仅因为票息率低，能否认为债券“安全”？(2) 一般利率上升会对安全性产生什么影响？(3) 公司*A*的债券是否比公司*B*的更值得投资？让我们按顺序简要回答这些问题。

<!--en-->
The difference in coupon rates alone makes Company *A* pass our earnings coverage test, whereas Company *B* barely earns its interest. This point may well raise several questions, *viz.*: (1) Can a bond be considered “safe” merely because it carries a low coupon rate? (2) What would be the effect on this safety of a rise in the general rate of interest? (3) Are the bonds of Company *A* a sounder purchase for investment than those of Company *B*? Let us attempt to answer these questions briefly in their order.

1. *票息率对安全性的影响。* 从技术意义上讲，持续支付利息的安全性可以通过调整票息率来创造或破坏。不能认为5½%的债券在3%利息方面是安全的，在额外的2½%方面则不安全。利息安全性是一个不可分割的概念，必须适用于全部利息费用，因为无法支付部分合同利息——甚至次级利息——会导致财务困难。这反过来意味着投资状态至少会暂时被破坏。如果低利率被视为永久性的——即持续到到期或未来许多年——那么维持本金价值的安全性也可以“创造”。如果3%利率是永久的，600,000美元的收益应能使公司*A*在到期时赎回债券，并且债券的市场价格也应接近面值。必须考虑到利率往往与公司支付能力呈反向关系。强大的公司以低利率借款，尽管它可以支付比弱公司更多的利息。这意味着“良好信用”本身会通过节省利息费用产生“更好信用”，反之亦然。虽然这看似矛盾且不公平，但在安全分析中必须接受这一事实。
2. *利率上升对安全性的影响。* 一般利率上升不会影响公司在低利率债券期限内支付利息的能力。但如果债券在短期内到期，公司将面临以更高利率赎回的问题，其收益必须显示高于该更高利率的足够差额。另一方面，如果到期时间遥远，当一般利率大幅上升时，这些债券及其他债券的市场价格将显著下降。（注意：1917年至1920年间，债券价格道琼斯指数下跌约30%，反映了利率上升。）因此，从市场价值维护的角度来说，长期债券的本金安全性必然会受到利率急剧上升的负面影响。¹¹ 短期债务的本金安全性*可能*会因利率上升而受到不利影响，如果收益覆盖度低于我们的最低标准且有足够差额。实际结论是：如果投资者认为利率上升的可能性存在，无论公司多么强大，都不应购买长期低票息债券；只有当收益能覆盖更高票息率且有余量时，才应购买短期债券。然而，如果他确信低利率会持续下去，他可以像过去接受高利率一样接受低利率。如果他对利率的未来走向不确定，最佳策略可能是只购买期限较短（比如不超过十年）的债券，并提高收益覆盖要求以抵消低票息率。
3. *两种债券的相对吸引力。* 我们的第三个问题涉及A公司3%债券与B公司$5\frac{1}{2}\%$债券的相对吸引力。从严格逻辑来看，$5\frac{1}{2}\%$债券肯定比3%债券更受青睐，因为$5\frac{1}{2}\%$债券持有人可以始终以或有方式要求额外的$2\frac{1}{2}\%$收益，从而使公司的边际利润达到与A公司相同水平。但实际上，这种固定利息的降低通常只有在发行方陷入财务困境后才会发生，这反过来会导致发行市价大幅下跌。因此，实际上，3%债券持有人可能比$5\frac{1}{2}\%$债券持有人情况更好。然而，我们示例中看到的异常现象应提醒投资者：除非完全相信利率将长期保持极低，否则不要以接近面值的价格购买A公司的3%债券。（这也表明，如果B公司类型的债券因高利息成本下的低边际利润而以极低价出售，则存在某些投机机会——尤其是当预计利率将维持低位时。）¹ 此处引用了法律的具体规定，不考虑银行委员会是否有权免除其中任何条款的酌情权（*参见*第8章）。

<!--en-->
1. *Effect of Coupon Rate on Safety.* Safety, in the technical sense of assurance of continued payment of interest, can certainly be created or destroyed by varying the coupon rate. Itis not feasible to think of a 5½% bond as being safe as to 3% interest and unsafe as to the additional 2½%. Safety of interest is an indivisible concept and must apply to the entire interest charge, the reason being that inability to pay part of the contractual interest—or even junior interest—will result in financial difficulties. These in turn mean the destruction, at least temporarily, of the investment status.
Safety in the sense of maintenance of principal value can also be “created” by a low rate of interest, provided this rate is considered to be permanent—i.e., lasting either through maturity or for a great many years in the future. If the 3% rate is permanent, the earnings of $600,000 should enable Company *A* to refund its bonds at maturity, and they should also maintain the market price of the bonds not far from par.
Allowance must be made for the fact that the rate of interest tends to vary inversely with the ability of the company to pay it. A strong company borrows at a low rate, although it could afford to pay more than could a weak company. This means that “good credit” itself produces “better credit” through its own saving in interest charges, whereas the opposite is equally true. Although this may seem paradoxical and unfair, it must be accepted as a fact in security analysis.
2. *Effect of a Rise in Interest Rates on Safety.* A general rise in interest rates would not affect the ability of a company to meet its interest charges during the life of its low-rate bond issue. But if they mature in a short time, it will be faced with the problem of refunding at a higher rate, to effect which its earnings must show an adequate margin above this higher rate. On the other hand, if the maturity is distant the market price of this and other bonds will decline substantially should the general rate of interest experience a considerable rise. (Note that the Dow-Jones Index of bond prices declined about 30% between 1917 and 1920, reflecting a rise in interest rates.)
It follows, therefore, that safety of principal, in the sense of maintenance of market value, is certain to be affected adversely in the case of long-term bonds by a sharp rise in the rate of interest.¹¹ Safety of principal of short-term debt *may* be affected adversely by such a rise in interest rates if theearnings coverage does not exceed our minimum by a comfortable margin.
The practical conclusion must be that if the investor considers a rise in interest rates probable, he should not buy long-term low-coupon bonds, no matter how strong the company; and he should buy short-term issues only if earnings would cover a higher coupon rate with an adequate margin. If, however, he is convinced that the low interest rates are here to stay, he may accept them in the same way as the higher rates were formerly accepted. If he is undecided as to the future of interest rates, the best policy might seem to be to confine purchases to bonds of fairly short maturity (say not longer than ten years) and also to increase his earnings coverage requirement to offset the low coupon rate.
3. *Relative Attractiveness of the Two Bonds.* Our third question relates to the comparative attractiveness of the 3% bonds of Company A and the $5\frac{1}{2}\%$ bonds of Company B. In strict logic the $5\frac{1}{2}\%$ bond must certainly be more desirable than the 3% bond, since the $5\frac{1}{2}\%$ bondholder could always place his claim to the extra $2\frac{1}{2}\%$ on a contingent basis and thus make his company's margin above fixed charges the same as Company A's. But in practice such a reduction of fixed interest is likely to be made only after the issuer has fallen into financial difficulties, which in turn would cause a substantial decline in the market price of the issue. Hence, as a practical matter, it is possible that the holder of the 3% bond may fare better than the owner of the $5\frac{1}{2}\%$ bond.
However, the anomaly evident in our example should carry a warning to the investor not to pay about par for a 3% bond on the showing of Company A unless he is absolutely convinced of the permanence of very low interest rates. (It will also indicate that there are certain speculative opportunities inherent in a bond of the Company B type if it is selling at a very low price because of the small margin above its high interest charges—especially if continuance of low interest rates is expected.)
¹ The specific provisions of the statute are now referred to, without regard to the discretionary powers of the Banking Board to waive any or all of them (*supra* Chap. 8).

### 债券投资具体标准（结束）

<!--en-->
*Specific Standards for Bond Investment (Concluded)*

### 股票资本化与债券债务的关系

<!--en-->
*RELATION OF STOCK CAPITALIZATION TO BONDED DEBT*

债券发行后或低于债券发行的股票和盈余数量，表示资源超过债务的情况。可以从以下简化的典型资产负债表中立即看出：

<!--en-->
The amount of stock and surplus following or junior to a bond issue expresses the same fact as the excess of resources over indebtedness. This can be seen at once from the following condensed typical balance sheet:

<table><tr><td>资产减去流动负债</td><td>债券债务</td><td>$ 600,000</td></tr><tr><td>（净资产）</td><td>股票和盈余（股票权益）</td><td>400,000</td></tr><tr><td></td><td></td><td>$1,000,000</td></tr></table>

<!--en-->
<table><tr><td>Assets, less current liabilities</td><td>Bonded debt</td><td>$ 600,000</td></tr><tr><td>(net assets)</td><td>Stock and surplus (stock equity)</td><td>400,000</td></tr><tr><td></td><td></td><td>$1,000,000</td></tr></table>

由此得出的简单公式如下：

<!--en-->
The resultant simple formula is as follows:

$$
\frac{\text{Stock equity}}{\text{Bonded debt}} = \frac{\text{Net assets}}{\text{Bonded debt}} - 1
$$

**纽约法律规定的标准。**因此，当我们研究资产负债表数据时，可以查看净资产或股票权益，以确定债务本金金额以上的指定覆盖率或安全边际。管理储蓄银行投资的纽约法律在其关于公共事业债券的规定中同时采用这两种方法。它规定：(1)所涉及的抵押贷款债务，加上所有底层抵押贷款债务，不得超过抵押财产价值的60%；(2)股本至少应为抵押贷款债务的三分之二。从刚才给出的典型资产负债表中可以明显看出，这两个要求大致相当。然而，如果一家公司拥有大量*无担保*债务，它可能满足要求1而不满足要求2，因此在这种情况下，第二个规定提供了额外保护。以下例子可以说明这一点：

<!--en-->
**Standards Prescribed by the New York Law.** If we are studying balance-sheet figures, therefore, we can look either at the net assets or at the stock equity to determine the indicated coverage or margin above the principal amount of the debt. The New York statute governing investments of savings banks employs both approaches in its regulations respecting public utility bonds. It stipulates: (1) that the mortgage debt in question, plus all underlying mortgage debt, shall not exceed 60% of the value of the mortgaged property; and (2) that the capital stock shall be equal to at least two-thirds of the mortgage debt. It will readily be observed from the typical balance sheet just given that these two requirements are broadly equivalent. Where a company has a substantial *unsecured* indebtedness, however, it might meet requirement 1and not requirement 2, so that in such cases the second stipulation supplies an added protection. This point may be illustrated by the following example:

<table><tr><td>抵押财产</td><td>$10,000,000</td><td>抵押贷款债务</td><td>$6,000,000</td></tr><tr><td>营运资金</td><td>1,000,000</td><td>债券</td><td>3,000,000</td></tr><tr><td></td><td></td><td>股票和盈余</td><td>2,000,000</td></tr><tr><td></td><td>$11,000,000</td><td></td><td>$1,000,000</td></tr></table>

<!--en-->
<table><tr><td>Mortgaged property</td><td>$10,000,000</td><td>Mortgage debt</td><td>$6,000,000</td></tr><tr><td>Working capital</td><td>1,000,000</td><td>Debentures</td><td>3,000,000</td></tr><tr><td></td><td></td><td>Stock and surplus</td><td>2,000,000</td></tr><tr><td></td><td>$11,000,000</td><td></td><td>$1,000,000</td></tr></table>

在这种情况下，抵押贷款债务仅占抵押财产的60%，而股票权益远少于抵押贷款债务的三分之二。因此，后者债券将不符合条件。

<!--en-->
In this case the mortgage debt is only 60% of the pledged property but the stock equity is much less than two-thirds of the mortgage debt. Hence the latter bonds would not be eligible.

需要注意的是，纽约法律仅考虑股票发行的面值或标值（当然包括优先股和普通股），并不计入账簿盈余，后者是股东权益的一部分。这种限制背后的理论可能是，盈余在法律上可分配给股东，因此不能作为债券持有人的永久保护。实际上，公用事业公司的盈余几乎总是大量投资于固定资产，无法以现金形式分配。因此，如果需要进行此类测试，仅看股票和盈余数据可能比仅看股票发行数据更合理。

<!--en-->
It should be noted that the New York statute considers only the par or stated value of the stock issues (including, of course, both preferred and common), and it does not give credit for the book surplus, which is part of the stockholders' equity. The theory behind this restriction may be that the surplus is legally distributable to the stockholders, and cannot therefore be counted on as a permanent protection for the bondholders. In actuality, however, a utility company's surplus is almost invariably invested to a large extent in fixed assets and is not distributable in cash. Hence, if tests of this kind are to be required, the stock-and-surplus figure would appear more logical than the stock issue alone.

**公用事业债券中可疑权益的检验标准。** 我们倾向于质疑：在常规情况下，是否通过应用资产或股票发行检验标准，就能从公用事业债券中获得任何实质性优势。该标准不太可能表明安全性或缺乏安全性，因为收益记录本身已显示出这一点。在某些情况下，收入数据可能令人满意，但资产覆盖比例却过小；后者可能表明，由于公司投资回报率异常高，其面临不利利率调整的风险。然而，主要问题在于，资产价值（因此包括股票权益）的资产负债表数据作为实际现金投资或可称为利率基数的再现价值的指标，缺乏可靠性。不过，近年来国家委员会和S.E.C.的活动使公众获得比以往更准确的资产负债表信息。即使考虑到这一改进，似乎也没有充分理由对公用事业债券实施资产价值或股票权益检验，而对铁路债券则无需如此。

<!--en-->
**Equity Test of Doubtful Merit in the Case of Utilities.** We are inclined to question whether any substantial advantage is gained in the ordinary case by applying the property or stock-issue test to public-utility bonds. It is unlikely to give any indication of safety or lack of safety not already shown by the earnings record. In some few instances, perhaps, the income exhibit may be satisfactory but the asset coverage unduly small, and the latter point may suggest that since the company is earning an exceptionally high rate on its investment, it is vulnerable to unfavorable rate regulation. The primary difficulty, however, has lain in the lack of dependability of the balance-sheet figures of property values (and hence of stock equity) as an indication either of the actual cash investment or of the reproduction value which may be designated as the rate base. But in recent years the activities of the statecommissions and the S.E.C. have given the public far more accurate balance sheets than formerly. Even allowing for this improvement, there does not seem to be sufficient reason to exact a property value or stock-equity test for public utility bonds and none for railroad bonds.

当然，将这种基于账面数据的股票权益检验标准用于铁路和公用事业债券，作为额外预防措施，无论是常规情况还是当存在对收益记录作为未来偿还利息能力衡量标准的可靠性产生疑问时，都没有异议。如果采用此检验标准，需要指出的是，债务占股票和盈余最高比例为60%，而最低收益比例为$1\frac{3}{4}$倍于利息费用。因此，允许债券债务达到资产价值的75%，即股票和盈余金额的三倍，更为合理。

<!--en-->
There is, of course, no objection to the application of this stock-equity test (based on book figures) to both railroad and public-utility obligations, as an added precaution, either regularly or in special cases where there is reason to doubt the reliability of the earnings record as a measure of the future ability to meet bond interest. If this test is applied, it should be pointed out that a maximum ratio of 60% of debt to 40% of stock and surplus is proportionately more severe than a minimum earnings ratio of $1\frac{3}{4}$ times interest charges. It would be more consistent, therefore, to admit a bonded debt as high as 75% of the property value, or three times the amount of the stock and surplus.

### **债券发行背后的实际价值覆盖的重要性。**

<!--en-->
**Importance of a Real-Value Coverage Behind a Bond Issue.**

我们对资产价值标准的主要反对意见源于一个明确事实：*固定资产的账面估值*作为债券安全性的指标，极不可靠。但另一方面，我们坚信，*持续经营价值*超过负债的较大差额不仅重要，甚至对确保固定价值投资的稳健性至关重要。在支付任何企业的债券标准价格之前——无论是铁路、电话公司还是百货商店——投资者必须确信，该企业的价值远高于其负债。在这方面，债券购买者必须采取与贷款银行相同的态度，即像对待房屋或钻石戒指的贷款人一样，重要区别在于，投资者通常需要考虑的是*企业作为一个整体的价值*，而不是单独资产的价值。

<!--en-->
Our principal objection to the property-value criterion arises from the undoubted fact that the *book valuations of fixed assets* are highly unreliable as indications of the safety of a bond. But on the other hand we are convinced that a substantial margin of *going-concern value* over funded debt is not only important but even vitally necessary to assure the soundness of a fixed-value investment. Before paying standard prices for bonds of any enterprise, whether it be a railroad, a telephone company, or a department store, the investor must be convinced that the business is worth a great deal more than it owes. In this respect the bond buyer must take the same attitude as the lender of money on a house or a diamond ring, with the important difference that it is *the value of the business as an entity* which the investor must usually consider, and not that of the separate assets.

**持续经营价值与盈利能力。** “企业作为一个整体的价值”通常完全由盈利能力决定。这解释了为何收入数据变得如此重要：后者不仅显示公司偿还利息的能力，还表明企业的持续价值在多大程度上超过了债券发行的*本金*。正因如此，大多数投资者认为收益记录是选择债券发行时唯一必要的统计或量化检验标准。其他常用的标准要么是定性要么是主观的（即涉及对管理、前景等个人观点的判断）。

<!--en-->
**Going-Concern Value and Earning Power.** "The value of the business as an entity" is most often entirely determined by its earning power. This explains the overshadowing significance that has come to be attached to the income exhibit, for the latter reveals not only the ability of thecompany to meet its interest charges, but also the extent to which the going value of the business may be said to exceed the *principal* of the bond issue. It is for this reason that most investors have come to regard the earnings record as the only statistical or quantitative test necessary in the selection of bond issues. All other criteria commonly employed are either qualitative or subjective (i.e., involving personal views as to the management, prospects, etc.).

虽然希望将安全债券检验标准尽可能简单化，但将其简化为仅以收益超过利息费用的差额为标准，似乎是对问题的危险过度简化。所考察期间的收益可能不具有代表性，原因可能是它们来自特定临时条件（有利或相反），或者呈现方式无法反映真实收入。这种情况在工业公司中尤为常见，这些公司面临的个人变化更多，会计监管程度也低于铁路和公用事业公司。

<!--en-->
While it is desirable to make the tests of safe bonds as simple and as few as possible, their reduction to the single criterion of the margin of earnings over interest charges would seem to be a dangerous oversimplification of the problem. The earnings during the period examined may be nonrepresentative, either because they resulted from definitely temporary conditions, favorable or the reverse, or because they were presented in such a way as not to reflect the true income. These conditions are particularly likely to occur in the case of industrial companies, which are subject both to greater individual vicissitudes and to a smaller degree of accounting supervision than is true of railroads and utilities.

**通过发行股票的市场价值衡量股东权益——补充测试。**因此，我们认为，至少对于工业债券而言，有必要通过其他定量指标来补充收益测试，以评估企业持续经营价值与债务总额之间的差额。我们能为此提供的最佳指标是：股本市场价值与总债务总额的比率。当然，由于股票报价极易出现极端且无意义的波动，有人可能会反对将发行股票的市场价格作为任何结论的依据。尽管如此，尽管存在所有缺陷，发行股票的市场价值通常被认为比资产负债表数据或普通评估更能反映企业的真实价值。¹请注意，我们建议仅将股票价格用于限制性目的，即确定债券发行背后是否存在大量股权。这绝不意味着价格总是公平或内在价值的准确衡量标准。市场价格测试被作为现有价值的粗略指标或线索，应仅作为对收益记录所提供数据进行更仔细分析的补充——但是一个重要的补充。²在极端情况下，市场价格测试的实用性无可争议。如果股票权益的市场价值是总债务的许多倍，则强烈表明债券发行是安全的；相反，市场价格下极小的股票权益则必须对债券的稳健性提出严重质疑。确定股票权益的市场价值及其与总债务额的比较，是债券分析中确立的特征，过去也包含在债券发行说明书中（当数据展示令人满意时）。我们建议将这一计算作为选择债券程序的标准要素，尤其适用于工业债券；并建议设立此方面的最低要求，作为安全性的次要定量测试。

<!--en-->
**Shareholders' Equity Measured by Market Value of Stock Issues—a Supplemental Test.** We feel, therefore, that it is essential, in the case of industrial bonds at least, to supplement the earnings test by some other quantitative index of the margin of going-concern value above the funded debt. The best criterion that we are able to offer for this purpose is the ratio of the market value of the capital stock to the total funded debt. Strenuous objections may, of course, be leveled against using the market price of stock issues as a proof of anything, in view of the extreme and senseless variations to which stock quotations are notoriously subject. Nevertheless, with all its imperfections, the market value of the stock issues is generally recognized as a better index of the fair going value of a business than is afforded by the balance-sheet figures or even the ordinary appraisal.¹
Note carefully that we are proposing the use of stock prices for the restricted purpose only of ascertaining whether or not a substantial equity exists behind the bond issue. This is by no means tantamount to stating that the price is always anexact measure of the fair or intrinsic value. The market-price test is suggested as a rough index or clue to the existing values, and it is to be employed only as a supplement—but an important supplement—to the more carefully scrutinized figures supplied by the earnings record.²
The utility of the market-price test in extreme cases is unquestionable. The presence of a stock equity with market value many times as large as the total debt carries a strong assurance of the safety of the bond issue,³ and conversely, an exceedingly small stock equity at market prices must call the soundness of the bond into serious question. The determination of the market value of the stock equity, and its comparison with the total amount of funded debt, is a well-established feature of bond analysis, and it was formerly included in bond-offering circulars (when the showing made was satisfactory). We recommend that this calculation be made a standard element in the procedure of bond selection, especially for industrial issues; and that minimum requirements under this heading be set up which will serve as a secondary quantitative test of safety.

**股票权益测试的最低标准。**股票价值和债务总额之间正常的最低关系应是多少？由于股票价格变化很大，各公司数据差异也很大，很难从实际经验中满意地回答这个问题。可以通过某种任意假设建立理论规则：铁路和公用事业股票的收益率应约为其债券利率的$1^{1/2}$倍；而工业股票的收益应是其债券利率的两倍。这些假设将产生以下算术关系⁴：一方面最低利息覆盖率与股票与债券比率之间的关系。

<!--en-->
**Minima for the Stock-Equity Test.** What should be the normal minimum relationship between stock values and funded debt? It is difficult to answer this question satisfactorily from actual experience because of the wide changes in stock prices and the variations in the exhibits of individual companies. A theoretical rule can be established by assuming, somewhat arbitrarily, that railroad and utility stocks should earn about $1^{1/2}$ times as large a percentage on their price as the interest rate on their bonds; whereas industrial stocks should earn twice as much as the interest rate on their bonds. These assumptions would produce the following arithmetical relationship⁴ between the minimum interest coverage on the one hand and the stock-to-bond ratio on the other.

下一页我们将呈现一家公共事业公司、铁路公司和工业公司截至1938年12月31日的汇总数据，大致支持上述关系。

<!--en-->
On the next page we present a summarized exhibit of a public utility, a railroad, and an industrial company, as of December 31, 1938, which will support in a general way the relationships suggested above.

**与股票权益相当的收益债券。**在第9章中我们指出，由于收益债券的利息并非固定费用，因此无需将其纳入计算覆盖成本的总费用中。同样，此类债券的本金也不应计入与股票权益相比的总债务金额中。不仅如此，长期到期的中级收益债券在性质上也与优先股非常接近，其市场价值可以合理地被视为股票权益的一部分（或更准确地说，“收益债券与股票权益”），它们位于固定利率债券之下并对其进行保护。*示例：*

<!--en-->
**Income Bonds Equivalent to Stock Equity.** In Chap. 9 we pointed out that since interest on income bonds is not a fixed charge, it need not be included in the total charges on which coverage is to be calculated. Similarly, the principal amount of such bonds is not to be included in the total funded debt that is to be compared with the stock equity. Not only is this so, but it is true also that junior income bonds (of long maturity) are so close in their character to preferred stock that their market value may properly be considered as part of the stock equity (or rather “income bond and stock equity”) junior to, and protecting, the fixed-interest bonds.
*Example:*

<table><tr><td colspan="3">科罗拉多燃料与钢铁通用公司（第一系列）5年期债券，到期日为1943年，1939年6月30日价格为103<sup>1</sup>&frasl;<sub>2</sub> 利率为3.90%</td></tr><tr><td>未偿还金额</td><td></td><td>$ 4,483,000</td></tr><tr><td colspan="3">1939年6月30日的收益债券与股票权益：</td></tr><tr><td>11,035,000美元 1970年到期的收益5年期债券</td><td>@ 45</td><td>4,966,000</td></tr><tr><td>564,000股普通股</td><td>@ 12<sup>1</sup>&frasl;<sub>2</sub></td><td>7,050,000</td></tr><tr><td>315,000份股票购买权</td><td>@ 4<sup>1</sup>&frasl;<sub>4</sub></td><td>1,339,000</td></tr><tr><td>总权益</td><td></td><td>$13,355,000</td></tr></table>

在这种情况下，第一抵押5年期债券的技术状况完全不同，因为次级留置权是收益债券，如果它是固定利率债券，情况会不同。这一点通过对比1936年重组之前的情况可以明显看出。在之前的安排中，第一5年期债券之后发行了大量固定利率债券，这些债券的要求（包括到期日）导致1933年出现了接管局面，之后第一5年期债券以低至30的价格出售。

<!--en-->
In this case the technical position of the 1st mortgage 5s is entirely different by virtue of the fact that the junior lien is an income bond than it would be if the latter carried fixed interest. That this is true is shown in striking fashion by reference to the situation prior to the reorganization of 1936. In the former setup the First 5s were followed by a large fixed-interest bond issue, the requirements of which (including their maturity) precipitated a receivership in 1933, following which the First 5s sold as low as 30.

**异常高股票价值比率的重要性。**正如我们之前提到的，如果股票价值比率始终与利息覆盖能力成比例，如前面表格所示，就没有必要应用两种测试，因为通过一种测试就能确保通过另一种测试。然而实际情况并非如此，因此我们必须考虑当股票价值比率给出与利息覆盖能力截然不同的指示时，这意味着什么。首先假设盈利情况并不完全令人信服，但股票价值比率远高于我们的最低要求。

<!--en-->
**Significance of Unusually Large Stock-Value Ratio.** As we have previously intimated, if the stock-value ratio were always proportionate to the interest coverage, in the manner suggested in the foregoing table, there would be no reason to apply both tests, since the passing of one would assure passing of the other. Such is not the case, however, and we must accordingly consider what is implied when the stock-value ratio gives a substantially different indication from that given by the interest coverage. Let us assume first that the earnings picture is not completely convincing but that the stock-value ratio is considerably higher than our minimum requirement.

*示例：*参考第9章中的费尔班克斯-莫尔斯案例，投资者会被以下事实所打动：1938年最低市场价格时，股票权益比超过2比1（股票市场价值约12,000,000美元，债券价值5,600,000美元）。这种强劲的证据可以消除对十年平均数据不足的疑问。

<!--en-->
*Example:* Referring to the Fairbanks-Morse example in Chap. 9, the investor would be impressed by the fact that at the lowest market price in 1938 the stock-equity ratio was more than 2 to 1 (about $12,000,000 market value of stock behind $5,600,000 of bonds). This evidence of strength might well dispel any doubt arising from the inadequacy of the straight ten-year average.

**低于正常水平的股票价值比率的重要性。**相反的情况是，利息覆盖能力可能被认为足够，但股票价值比率远低于最低要求。

<!--en-->
**Significance of a Subnormal Stock-Value Ratio.** The opposite case is that in which the interest coverage may becalled satisfactory but the stock-value ratio is substantially below the minimum required.

*示例：*这里的问题可以通过两个对比鲜明的例子更好地理解，一个发生在经济萧条期间，另一个发生在复苏高峰期。

<!--en-->
*Examples:* The problem here may be better understood by the use of two contrasting examples, one taken in the midst of depression and the other at the peak of recovery.

第一个例子是内陆钢铁公司4\frac{1}{2}$s债券，到期日为1978年，1932年9月以82的价格出售，利率为5.6%。相关数据见下一页表格，还有1940年到期的克鲁比塞尔钢铁5年期债券的对应数据，用于比较。

<!--en-->
The first example is that of Inland Steel $4\frac{1}{2}$s, due 1978, which sold in September 1932 at 82, to yield 5.6%. The relevant data appear in the table on the following page, together with corresponding figures for Crucible Steel 5s, due 1940, which are supplied for comparison.

可以看出，内陆钢铁公司的发行符合我们的盈利测试（基于$6\frac{1}{2}$年平均值），但不符合股票比率测试。大多数投资者会认为，当时该债券是一项非常稳健且有吸引力的投资，因为：(1)内陆钢铁公司是最好的钢铁公司之一，有良好的经济萧条前记录；(2)1932年的盈利和股价数据异常，无法判断债券的安全性。公司后来盈利恢复，且1936年以溢价赎回债券，这可证明这一观点的正确性。

<!--en-->
It will be seen that the Inland Steel issue met our earnings test (based on a $6\frac{1}{2}$-year average) but failed to meet our stock-ratio test. Most investors would reason that the bond was a very sound and attractive investment at the time, because (1) Inland Steel was one of the best steel companies, with a fine predepression record; and (2) the 1932 figures, both for earnings and for stock prices, were so abnormal as to afford no guide to the safety of the bond issue. The fact that the company's earnings recovered later on and that the bonds were called at a premium in 1936 would be pointed to as confirming the soundness of this view.

但这种推理的弱点在于，它需要对未来做出某些假设，而这些假设并不适用于证明购买投资债券的正当性。（注意，在1932年的情况下，Inland Steel 82日期的股价为4.5美元，这明确表明该债券属于投资类债券。）如果我们比较Inland和Crucible发行的债券，这一点就会很清楚。可以看出，Crucible发行的债券在收益覆盖率和股票价值比率方面都更好，但后者的收益率是Inland债券的两倍。购买Inland Steel 4.5日期债券的人不仅必须假设1932年的状况是暂时的——这是进行证券购买时必要的假设——而且还必须假设：(1) Inland Steel股票的价格过低；(2) Crucible Steel股票的价格过高。因为除非Inland股票的售价过低，否则无法认为Inland债券是安全的；除非Crucible股票的售价过高，否则他最好购买价格较低的Crucible债券。这似乎是一个过于复杂且不可靠的直接债券投资依据。

<!--en-->
But the weakness of the reasoning lies in the fact that it required certain assumptions as to the future which should not be needed to justify the purchase of an investment bond. (Note that under the conditions of 1932, the price of 82 for Inland Steel $4\frac{1}{2}$s put them distinctly in the investment class.) This should be clear if we compare the exhibits of the Inland and Crucible issues. It will be seen that both the earnings coverage and the stock-value ratio were better for the Crucible issue, yet the yield on the latter was twice as high as for the Inland bond. The purchaser of the Inland Steel $4\frac{1}{2}$s would have to assume not only that the 1932 conditions were transitory—a necessary assumption if there was to be any buying of securities—but also (1) that the price of Inland Steel stock was much too low and (2) that the price of Crucible Steel stock issues was much too high. For unless the Inland stock was selling too low, the Inland bonds could not be considered safe; and unless theCrucible shares were selling too high, he would have been much better advised to buy the lower priced Crucible bonds. This would seem to be entirely too complicated and doubtful a basis for a straight bond investment.
