可以看出，1930年的收益实际上并未成为M-K-T未来正常收益水平的参考标准。然而，这种错误对于在1931年购买固定利率债券的个人投资者来说，未必会造成巨大损失。尽管收益和投资质量下降，他在接下来的六年里仍有几次机会以有利价格出售资产。正如我们后文（第21章）所指出的，适当的投资策略本应促使他进行此类出售，因为情况已经发生变化。

<!--en-->
It will be seen that the 1930 earnings did not in fact prove a guide to the future normal earning power of M-K-T. Yet this mistake need not have proved very costly to an individual investor who bought the fixed-interest bonds in 1931. Despite the decline in earnings and investment quality, he had several opportunities to sell out advantageously during the next six years. As we point out later (Chap. 21), proper investment technique would have compelled such a sale, in view of the changed exhibit.

1934年之后，调整债券的利息仅在1937年支付。该债券的发行价格范围很值得关注，主要反映了债券购买者的漠视态度。注意，在1937年的高点时期，他们为调整5秒债券支付的价格与4\frac{1}{2}美元债券相同，尽管收益覆盖能力完全不足，且1932年、1934年和1935年优先债券的价格远高于调整债券。

<!--en-->
After 1934, interest on the adjustment bonds was paid only in 1937. The price range of that issue is interesting chiefly as a reflection of the heedlessness of bond buyers. Note that at the 1937 highs they paid the same price for the adjustment 5s as for the $4\frac{1}{2}$s, despite the totally inadequate earnings coverage, and despite the fact that in 1932, 1934 and 1935 the senior issue had sold more than twice as high as the adjustments.

**优先收益债券。** 有一些收益债券在相对于其他固定利率债券的顺序上处于优先地位。Atchison调整4秒债券是最著名的例子，之后还有4%固定利率债券，这些债券通常以较低价格出售，仅1938年短暂例外。St. Louis Southwestern Railway Company第二收益4秒债券也符合这一情况。⁵虽然这类债券的理论地位相当复杂，但实际操作要求，在处理整个体系时，必须将相关利息视为公司的*固定费用*。

<!--en-->
**Senior Income Bonds.** There are a few instances of income bonds which are senior in their lien to other bonds bearing fixed interest. The Atchison Adjustment 4s are the best known example, being followed by 4% fixed-interest debenture issues which have regularly sold at a lower price except briefly in 1938. The situation holds true also with respect to St. Louis Southwestern Railway Company Second Income 4s.⁵ While the theoretical status of such bonds is rather confusing, the practical procedure called for is, obviously, to treat the interest thereon as part of the company's *fixed charges*, when dealing with the system as a whole.

## II. 担保债券

<!--en-->
*II. GUARANTEED ISSUES*

担保债券本身并不具有特殊的投资价值。缺乏经验的投资者可能认为“担保”一词意味着安全保证；但显然，任何担保的价值完全取决于担保人的财务状况。如果担保人没有资产，担保就毫无价值。与金融新手的态度不同，华尔街倾向于*低估*担保的价值，表现为担保债券的价格通常低于担保人发行的债券甚至优先股。这种对担保的复杂不信任可以追溯到1915年的Kanawha和Hocking煤炭公司案，当时担保人铁路公司试图通过声称1901年签订的担保超出其公司权力而无效来逃避责任。这种逃避尝试，受到俄亥俄州和联邦法院反垄断诉讼结果的支持，最终完全失败；但它给所有担保的价值蒙上了阴影，即使25年后，这种影响仍未能完全消除。⁶我们不知道有重要的案例表明，有能力的公司通过法律技术手段逃避了担保后果。⁷ **担保债券的地位。** 如果一家公司担保利息、股息或本金支付，未能履行这一义务就会使其面临破产风险。对担保人的索赔与公司的无担保债务同等重要，因此担保债券应获得与担保人债券相同的评级，且比其优先股评级更高。担保债券也可能因其自身地位和收益能力而获得投资评级，独立于担保关系。在这种情况下，担保可能会增加安全性，但即使担保人公司本身状况不佳，担保也不会减少安全性。

<!--en-->
No special investment quality attaches to guaranteed issues as such. Inexperienced investors may imagine that the word “guaranteed” carries a positive assurance of safety; but, needless to say, the value of any guaranty depends strictly upon the financial condition of the guarantor. If the guarantor has nothing, the guaranty is worthless. In contrast with the attitude of the financial novice, Wall Street displays a tendency to *underestimate* the value of a guaranty, as shown by the lower prices often current for guaranteed issues in comparison with the debentures or even the preferred stock of the guarantor. This sophisticated distrust of guarantees dates back to the Kanawha and Hocking Coal and Coke Company case in 1915, when the guarantor railroad endeavored to escape its liability by claiming that the guaranty, made in 1901, was beyond its corporate powers and hence void. This attempt at evasion, encouraged by the outcome of antitrust suits in the Ohio and federal courts, in the end proved completely unsuccessful; but it cast a shadow over the value of all guarantees, from which they have not completely emerged even after 25 years.⁶ We know of no important case in which a solvent company has escaped the consequences of its guaranty through legal technicalities.⁷
**Status of Guaranteed Issues.** If a company guarantees interest, dividend, or principal payments, its failure to meet this obligation will expose it to insolvency. The claim against the guarantor ranks equally with an unsecured debt of the company, so that guaranteed issues deserve the same rating as a debenture bond of the guarantor and a better rating than its preferred stock. A guaranteed issue may also be entitled to an investment rating because of its own position and earning power independent of the guaranty. In such cases the guaranty may add to its security, but it cannot detract therefrom even if the guarantor company itself is in bad straits.

*示例：* Brooklyn Union Elevated Railroad 5秒债券（见第2章）由Brooklyn Heights Railroad Company担保，该公司于1919年进入接管程序；但由于在布鲁克林快速交通系统中处于优先地位，债券在重组过程中未受损害。同样，U.S. Industrial Alcohol Company优先股股息由Distilling Company of America担保；后者破产了，但酒精公司能够轻松用自身收益继续支付股息，后来以125的价格赎回优先股。

<!--en-->
*Examples:* The Brooklyn Union Elevated Railroad 5s (see Chap. 2) were guaranteed by the Brooklyn Heights Railroad Company, which went into receivership in 1919; but the bond came through the reorganization unscathed because of its ownpreferred position in the Brooklyn Rapid Transit System. Similarly U. S. Industrial Alcohol Company Preferred dividends were guaranteed by Distilling Company of America; the latter enterprise became bankrupt, but the Alcohol Company was easily able to continue the dividend out of its own earnings and later to retire the preferred issue at 125.

由另一家公司完全担保的普通或优先股，从担保人的角度来看，具有债券发行的地位。如果担保证明毫无价值，它自然会回到股票的地位——通常是弱质债券，但可能像刚才提到的U.S. Industrial Alcohol Company优先股那样是强质债券。另一家公司担保的收益债券也是如此（例如Chicago, Terre Haute and Southeastern Railway Company收益5秒债券，⁸由Chicago, Milwaukee, St. Paul and Pacific Railroad Company担保）。

<!--en-->
A common or preferred stock fully guaranteed by another company has the status of a bond issue as far as the guarantor is concerned. If the guaranty proves worthless, it would naturally return to the position of a stock—usually a weak issue, but possibly a strong one, as in the case of U. S. Industrial Alcohol Company Preferred just mentioned. A similar situation obtains with respect to income bonds of one company guaranteed by another (e.g., Chicago, Terre Haute, and Southeastern Railway Company Income 5s,⁸ *guaranteed* by the Chicago, Milwaukee, St. Paul and Pacific Railroad Company).

当部分债券提供担保而部分不提供时，担保的价值有时非常明显。

<!--en-->
The value of a guarantee is sometimes very evident when part of an issue is guaranteed and part is not.

## *示例：*

<!--en-->
*Example:*

## Anacostia and Potomac River Railroad First 5s，到期日期为1949年

<!--en-->
*Anacostia and Potomac River Railroad First 5s, Due 1949*

<table><tr><td>由Washington Ry. & Elec. Co.担保，保值为500,000美元</td><td>1939年价格为110</td></tr><tr><td>2,100,000美元，无担保</td><td>1939年价格为80</td></tr></table>

<!--en-->
<table><tr><td>$500,000 guaranteed by Washington Ry. & Elec. Co.</td><td>price 110 in 1939</td></tr><tr><td>$2,100,000 unguaranteed</td><td>price 80 in 1939</td></tr></table>

在这种情况下，Anacostia公司的收益保障不足（1938年为1.36倍），但担保人公司的保障水平很高（1938年合并基准下超过4倍，当年仅以母公司为基准时超过11倍，包括其有条件承担的利息）。

<!--en-->
In this case the Anacostia company's earnings coverage was inadequate (1.36 times in 1938), but that of the guarantor company was high (over 4 times in 1938 on a consolidated basis and over 11 times in that year on a parent-only basis inclusive of interest for which it was contingently liable).

**担保的具体条款非常重要。** 担保的具体条款显然对其价值有至关重要的影响。仅担保利息的担保可能远不如同时担保本金重要。

<!--en-->
**Exact Terms of Guaranty Are Important.** The exact terms of a guaranty have obviously a vital influence upon its value. A guaranty of interest only is likely to be much less significant than a guaranty of principal as well.

*示例：* 菲律宾铁路公司First 4s，到期日期为1937年，仅由菲律宾政府担保利息。该铁路本身的收益很差。利息在到期前及时支付，但本金未偿还。

<!--en-->
*Examples:* Philippine Railway Company First 4s, due 1937, were guaranteed as to interest only by the Philippine government. The earnings of the road itself were poor. Interest was paid promptly up to maturity, but principal was defaulted.

债券价格反映了这种状况，自1929年以来最高未超过39。明尼阿波利斯、圣保罗和Saulte Saint Marie铁路公司First Consolidated 4s和5s，到期日期为1938年：所有4%债券和约一半5%债券仅由加拿大太平洋铁路公司担保利息。本金在到期时未偿还，加拿大太平洋停止支付利息，债券价格降至6。另一方面，该公司的First and Refunding 5½s, Series B，到期日期为1978年——属于次级留置权——同样由加拿大太平洋担保利息，并根据担保继续在高级留置权违约后获得利息。这些债券在1939年以64的价格出售，而高级发行以6出售。注意，1931年它们曾以35的价格出售，而1938年第一合并担保5s以45出售，加拿大太平洋（无担保）债券以56⅞出售。显然，1931年加拿大太平洋的*长期*担保价值并未被充分评估。

<!--en-->
The price of the bond reflected this situation, having sold no higher than 39 since 1929.⁹
Minneapolis, St. Paul and Saulte Saint Marie Railroad First Consolidated 4s and 5s due 1938: All the 4% bonds and about half the 5% bonds were guaranteed as to interest only by Canadian Pacific Railway. Principal was defaulted on maturity, and the Canadian Pacific ceased to pay interest, the price of the bonds declining to 6.¹⁰
On the other hand, this company's First and Refunding 5½s, Series B, due 1978,—a junior lien—are also guaranteed as to interest by Canadian Pacific and in accordance with the guaranty continued to receive interest after the senior lien was in default. These bonds sold at 64 in 1939, whereas the senior issues sold at 6. Note that in 1931 they sold as low as 35, whereas the 1st Consolidated Guaranteed 5s, due 1938, sold at 45 and the Canadian Pacific (unsecured) Debenture stock sold at 56⅞. It is clear that the value of the *long-term* Canadian Pacific guaranty was not fully appreciated in 1931.

类似的不利情况也存在于有限期限的分红担保中。

<!--en-->
A similar disadvantage attaches to a guaranty of dividends running for a limited period.

*示例：* 美国电报和电缆公司普通股的情况就体现了这种情况。从1882年开始，西部联合电报公司根据1932年终止的租赁协议，担保其5%分红（仅此一项）持续50年。由于长期支付分红，投资者最终将分红视为固定收益，直到1922年股票才以70的价格出售。但与此同时，租赁电缆资产的战略或贸易价值迅速下降，因此租赁期结束时股票的价值可能非常低。1930年与西部联合达成和解，美国电报和电缆股东获得了相当于股票本金约20美元的补偿。¹¹ Pratt and Whitney Preferred（1928年退休）提供了一个关于担保具体条款重要性的非常不寻常的例子。根据安全手册，该债券的分红由母公司Niles-Bement-Pond“担保”。但实际上，Niles公司仅同意在支付自身优先股息后，按Niles可使用的收益金额弥补Pratt and Whitney Preferred未支付的分红。因此，从1924年11月到1926年6月，Pratt and Whitney Preferred股东未收到任何对Niles-Bement-Pond的可执行索赔。鉴于存在此类特殊规定，在购买任何基于担保的证券之前，必须仔细了解担保条款的完整信息。

<!--en-->
*Examples:* The actual working out of such a situation was shown in the case of American Telegraph and Cable Company common stock, which was guaranteed as to 5% dividends (only) for 50 years from 1882 by the Western Union Telegraph Company under a lease terminating in 1932. Because of the long record of dividend payments, investors came finally to consider the dividend as a fixture, and as late as 1922 the stock sold at 70. But in the meantime the strategic or trade value of the leased cable properties was rapidly diminishing, so that the value of the stock at the expiration of the lease was likely to be very small. A settlement was made in 1930 with Western Union under which the American Telegraph and Cable stockholders received the equivalent of about $20 for the principal of their stock.¹¹
A rather unusual example of the importance of the exact terms of a guaranty was supplied by Pratt and Whitney Preferred (retired in 1928). According to the security manuals,the dividend on this issue was “guaranteed” by its parent company, Niles-Bement-Pond. But in fact the Niles company agreed to make up unpaid dividends on Pratt and Whitney Preferred only to the extent that Niles had earnings available therefor after payment of its own preferred dividends. Hence no dividends were received by Pratt and Whitney Preferred stockholders from November 1924 to June 1926 without any claim being enforceable against Niles-Bement-Pond. In view of the possibility of such special provisions, particular care must be exercised to obtain complete information regarding the terms of a guaranty before purchasing any security on the strength thereof.

**共同和全部担保。** 这种担保由不止一家公司提供，用于覆盖同一发行项目，每家公司不仅承担自己应分担的部分，还承担其他可能违约担保人的部分责任。换句话说，每个担保人都有可能负责整个发行金额。由于两个或更多担保人比一个更好，具有共同和全部担保的债券可能具有特殊优势。

<!--en-->
**Joint and Several Guarantees.** Such guarantees are given by more than one company to cover the same issue, and each company accepts responsibility not only for its pro rata share but also for the share of any other guarantor who may default. In other words, each guarantor concern is potentially liable for the entire amount of the issue. Since two or more sponsors are better than one, bonds bearing a joint and several guarantee are likely to have special advantages.

*示例：* 由此类担保支持的最熟悉的债券类别是联合铁路站债券。一个典型的例子是堪萨斯城终点站铁路公司First 4s，到期日期为1960年，由不少于12家铁路公司共同和全部担保，所有这些铁路都使用该公司的设施。12个担保人如下：Atchison, Alton, Burlington, St. Paul, Great Western, Rock Island, Kansas City Southern, M-K-T, Missouri Pacific, ’Frisco, Union Pacific和Wabash。

<!--en-->
*Example:* The most familiar class of issues backed by such a guaranty are the bonds of union railroad stations. An outstanding example is supplied by Kansas City Terminal Railway Company First 4s, due 1960, which are guaranteed jointly and severally by no less than 12 railroads, all of which use the company’s facilities. The 12 guarantors are as follows: Atchison, Alton, Burlington, St. Paul, Great Western, Rock Island, Kansas City Southern, M-K-T, Missouri Pacific, ’Frisco, Union Pacific and Wabash.

这些单独担保的价值在不同线路和不同时间差异很大，但至少有三家公司始终保持足够的财务实力，确保终端债券持有人能够轻松履行其义务。投资者尚未充分认识到，与单家公司的责任相比，12家运营商共同承担的责任所提供的保护更为优越。价格记录显示，堪萨斯城终端铁路公司4s的发行价格通常不会高于后来被证明信誉存疑的个别担保公司的发行价格，而终端债券的安全性从未受到过质疑。¹²因此，对投资者来说，选择这种由*多数量*重要企业提供担保的债券，而非单家公司的债券，似乎是一个良好的策略。

<!--en-->
The value of each of these individual guarantees has varied greatly from road to road and from time to time, but at least three of the companies have consistently maintained sufficient financial strength to assure a Terminal bondholder that his obligation would be met without difficulty. Investors have not fully appreciated the superior protection accorded by the combined responsibility of the 12 carriers as compared with the liability of any one of them singly. The price record shows that the Kansas City Terminal Railway Company 4s frequently sold at no higher prices than representative issuesof individual guarantor companies which later turned out to be of questionable soundness, whereas at no time was the safety of the Terminal bond ever a matter of doubt.¹²
It would seem good policy for investors, therefore, to favor bonds of this type, which carry the guaranty of a *number* of substantial enterprises, in preference to the obligations of a single company.

**联邦土地银行债券**。联合及连带担保的另一个不同方面体现在联邦土地银行债券案例中，这些债券以农业抵押贷款作为担保。12家独立银行的义务由其他11家银行担保，因此每枚联邦土地银行债券实际上是整个系统的责任。当这些银行成立时，同时成立了一组股份式土地银行，它们也发行债券，但其中一家股份式银行的责任并不由其他银行担保。¹³这两组土地银行都受美国政府监管，且两款债券的税收均被免除。实际上，联邦土地银行的大部分股份最初由美国政府认购（不过政府并未对其债券承担责任）；股份式土地银行股票为私人所有。

<!--en-->
**Federal Land Bank Bonds.** A somewhat different aspect of the joint and several guarantee appears in the important case of the Federal Land Bank bonds, which are secured by deposit of farm mortgages. The obligations of each of the 12 separate banks are guaranteed by the 11 others, so that each Federal Land Bank bond is in reality a liability of the entire system. When these banks were organized, there was created concurrently a group of Joint Stock Land Banks which also issued bonds, but the obligations of one Joint Stock Bank were not guaranteed by the others.¹³ Both sets of land banks were under United States government supervision and the bonds of both were made exempt from federal taxation. Practically all of the stock of the Federal Land Banks was subscribed for originally by the United States government (which, however, did not assume liability for their bonds); the Joint Stock Land Bank shares were privately owned.

在这一双重体系建立之初，投资者倾向于将联邦监管和税收免除视为*股份式*土地银行债券安全的虚拟保障，因此他们愿意以仅比*联邦*土地银行债券高½%的收益率购买它们。在比较无担保的股份式债券与相互担保的联邦债券时，可能会有以下观察：

<!--en-->
At the inception of this dual system, investors were disposed to consider the federal supervision and tax exemption as a virtual guarantee of the safety of the *Joint Stock* Land Bank bonds, and they were therefore willing to buy them at a yield only ¹/₂% higher than that returned by the *Federal* Land Bank bonds. In comparing the nonguaranteed Joint Stock bonds with the mutually guaranteed federal bonds, the following observations might well have been made:

1. 假设农业贷款体系完全成功，担保就变得多余了，因为每枚单独发行的债券本已享有充分保护。
2. 假设体系完全失败，担保将毫无价值，因为所有银行都将同样陷入破产状态。
3. 在这两种极端之间的任何中间阶段，联合及连带担保可能非常有价值。对于处于*地方*性极其不利条件的农业贷款地区的债券来说尤其如此。由于农业贷款体系是一项新的、未经试炼的项目，参与其中的投资者应获得最大程度的保护。那些因追求额外½%收益而放弃联合担保的人，犯了一个明显的判断错误。¹⁴ [^4114]：¹这是1881年发行的密尔沃基湖岸西部收入6s债券，1891年由芝加哥西北铁路公司承接，于1911年到期偿还。圣路易斯-旧金山铁路公司收入6s和调整6s都在1928年要求按面值偿还，分别比到期时间早32年和27年。这对债券持有人来说很幸运，因为该铁路于1932年进入接管程序。'Frisco'从1916年进入接管程序到1932年再次进入接管程序的历史，是投资者和投机者缺乏谨慎性的典型例子——他们因几年间整体繁荣带来的轻微改善，便对一家历史记录不佳、资本结构过于庞大的铁路证券给予高评级。

<!--en-->
1. Assuming the complete success of the farm-loan system, the guarantee would be superfluous, since each bond issue separately would have enjoyed ample protection.
2. Assuming complete failure of the system, the guarantee would prove worthless, since all the banks would be equally insolvent.
3. For any intermediate stage between these two extremes, the joint and several guarantee might prove extremely valuable. This would be particularly true as to bonds of a farm-loan district subjected to extremely adverse conditions of a *local* character.
In view of the fact that the farm-loan system was a new and untried undertaking, investors therein should have assured themselves of the largest possible measure of protection. Those who in their eagerness for the extra 1/2% of income return dispensed with the joint guarantee committed a patent mistake of judgment.¹⁴
[^4114]: ¹ This was a $500,000 issue of Milwaukee Lake Shore and Western Income 6s, issued in 1881, assumed by the Chicago and Northwestern in 1891, and paid off at maturity in 1911. St. Louis-San Francisco Railway Company Income 6s and Adjustment 6s were both *called* for repayment at par in 1928, which was 32 and 27 years, respectively, prior to their maturity. This proved fortunate for the bondholders since the road went into receivership in 1932. The history of the 'Frisco between its emergence from receivership in 1916 and its subsequent relapse into receivership in 1932 is an extraordinary example of the heedlessness of both investors and speculators, who were induced by a moderate improvement, shown in a few years of general prosperity, to place a high rating on the securities of a railroad with a poor previous record and a top-heavy capital structure.

²经过四十多年不间断的利息支付后，该债券于1938年暂时脱离信用。5月1日，债券所享有的半年度利息被推迟支付，六个月后才偿还。价格从103 1/4降至75 1/8，但在1938年恢复至96 1/4——全部发生在1938年。这种恢复现象清楚地表明投资者对所谓"优质债券"的渴望。

<!--en-->
² After more than forty years of uninterrupted interest payments, this issue lapsed temporarily from grace in 1938. May 1 interest (on bonds entitled to semiannual interest) was deferred but paid six months later. The price dropped from 103 1/4 to 75 1/8 but recovered to 96 1/4—all in the year 1938. This recovery is a striking commentary on the eagerness of investors for so-called “prime bonds.”

一些有租赁铁路担保的保证收益债券保持了与保证铁路股票相似的高投资价值。

<!--en-->
Some guaranteed income bonds of leased railroads have maintained a high investment standing, similar to that of guaranteed railroad stocks.

*示例：* Elmira and Williamsport Railroad Income 5s，到期日期为2862年，由宾夕法尼亚铁路公司及其重要子公司担保。（注意其1000年的到期期限。）同时请注意Chicago, Terre Haute和Southeastern Income 5s在该系统重组中的优势地位，由Chicago, Milwaukee, St. Paul and Pacific Railroad担保（*详见第209页*）。

<!--en-->
*Example:* Elmira and Williamsport Railroad Income 5s, due 2862, guaranteed by Pennsylvania Railroad and by an important subsidiary. (Note the 1,000-year maturity.) Also observe the superior position of Chicago, Terre Haute, and Southeastern Income 5s, guaranteed by the Chicago, Milwaukee, St. Paul and Pacific Railroad, in the reorganization of that system (*infra* p. 209).

在新一批收益债券中，有一只几乎从一开始就被认定为投资发行债券：Allied Owners Corporation 4s-5s，几乎由Loews, Inc.担保。作者认为，在1936年的重组过程中，没有理由将其作为收益债券。

<!--en-->
Among the newer crop of income bonds, one has qualified as an investment issue almost from the start: Allied Owners Corporation 4s-5s, virtually guaranteed by Loews, Inc. In the authors' view, there was no excuse for making this an income bond in the reorganization of 1936.

³ 实际上，在1937–1939年的*工业*融资中情况就是如此。几乎所有债券都是债券式证券，并以异常低的利率出售。可以说，我们认为，现在*工业*债券式证券意味着比工业抵押贷款债券更高的安全性。

<!--en-->
³ This actually proved to be the case in the *industrial* financing of 1937–1939. Practically all the bond issues were debentures and were sold at unusually low interest rates. It may be said, we believe, that *industrial* debentures now connote a higher type of security than industrial mortgage bonds.

4 Associated Gas and Electric Company使用了“可转换为优先股”的债券形式，*由公司自行选择*，从而获得了这种税收节省，而无需承担固定债券义务。与这种特殊发明相比，收益债券形式对普通投资者来说会少误导很多。

<!--en-->
4 The Associated Gas and Electric Company used the device of “bonds” convertible into preferred stock *at the option of the company*, and obtained this tax saving without the burden of a fixed-bond obligation. The income-bond form would have been far less misleading to the ordinary investor than this extraordinary invention.

在铁路重组中，收益债券比优先股更受青睐，因为对保险公司有法律限制，禁止它们持有优先股以替代旧债券。这种考虑，加上税收节省，可能促使企业通过收益债券进行*新的*融资，而不是使用优先股。

<!--en-->
Income bonds have been favored over preferred stocks in railroad reorganizations because of legal restrictions on insurance companies which would prohibit them from holding preferred shares in place of their old bonds. Conceivably this consideration, as well as the tax saving, could induce corporations to do *new* financing through income bonds in lieu of preferred stocks.

5 该铁路的各种重组计划（1936–1939年）都给予Second Income 4s比次级固定利率债券更好的待遇。Wabash Railway Noncumulative Income Debenture 6s是一个特殊案例，到期日为1939年，利息由“净收入”支付。虽然称为债券，但它们由直接留置权担保，并优先于Wabash *Railroad* Refunding and General Mortgage。尽管根据条款，它们仅获得取决于收益的非累积利息，但自1916年至1938年，尽管公司在1931年进入接管状态，并在1932年违约支付次级抵押贷款（固定）利息，这种利息仍定期支付。截至1939年底，Wabash的各种重组计划中，此债券也获得了优先待遇。

<!--en-->
5 The various reorganization plans for this road (1936–1939) all give the Second Income 4s much better treatment than is offered the junior fixed-interest issues. An unusual case is afforded by Wabash Railway Noncumulative Income Debenture 6s, due 1939, interest on which was payable “from net income.” Although called debentures, they are secured by a direct lien and have priority over the Wabash *Railroad* Refunding and General Mortgage. Although entitled by their terms only to noncumulative interest dependent on earnings, this interest was paid regularly from 1916 through 1938, despite the fact that the company entered receivership in 1931 and defaulted upon the junior-mortgage (fixed) interest in 1932. This issue was also given superior treatment in the various reorganization plans for the Wabash filed to the end of 1939.

与1932年10月Savoy Plaza Corporation Debenture $5\frac{1}{2}$s未购买部分得到全额支付的情况形成对比，该债券同样由United States Realty and Improvement担保。当时，Savoy Plaza的非担保*第一抵押贷款*债券售价低至5。另外请注意，1939年Utica, Clinton and Binghamton Railroad First 5s也通过担保方Delaware and Hudson Railroad提供的资金得到了全额支付，尽管Delaware and Hudson已经多年没有运营这条线路了。

At that time unguaranteed *First Mortgage* bonds of Savoy Plaza had been selling as low as 5. Note also the full payment in 1939 of Utica, Clinton and Binghamton Railroad First 5s through funds supplied by Delaware and Hudson Railroad, the guarantor, although Delaware and Hudson had not been operating the line for a great many years.

Note that in this case a *divisional second-mortgage income bond* fared substantially better than the first mortgage on the main line of the system. *Not the terms but the facts determine investment performance.*

14 1930–1932年间，许多联合股票债券出现违约情况，很大比例以接管价格出售，且所有债券价格都下跌至投机性水平。另一方面，联邦土地银行债券不仅没有违约现象，其价格也出现了相对温和的下降，始终保持在投资水平。投资者对联邦土地银行债券如此令人满意的经历，很大程度上得益于美国政府向这些银行提供的额外资本，以及它们受到的更严格监管，但共同和多项担保无疑带来了显著好处。

14 A number of the Joint Stock bond issues defaulted during 1930–1932, a large proportion sold at receivership prices, and all of them declined to a speculative price level. This much more satisfactory experience of the investor in the Federal Land Bank bonds was due in good part to the additional capital subscribed by the United States government to these Banks, and to the closer supervision to which they were subjected, but the joint and several guarantee undoubtedly proved of considerable benefit.

还需注意，联合股票土地银行债券在许多州被定为信托基金的法律投资品种，即使在其安全性显然不足的情况下，仍保持这种地位。自1933年5月起，联合股票土地银行被禁止开展新业务，正在进行有序清算。第20章

Note also that Joint Stock Land Bank bonds were made legal investments for trust funds in many states, and remained so after 1932 despite their undoubtedly inadequate security. Since May 1933 the Joint Stock Land Banks have been prohibited from taking on new business, and orderly liquidation has been in process.
CHAPTER 20

## 优先股保护条款。初级资本的维护

<!--en-->
*Preferred-Stock Protective Provisions. Maintenance of Junior Capital*

优先股几乎总是享有一定的保护措施，防止在它们之前发行新的债券。标准条款禁止在未经优先股三分之二或四分之三的投票批准的情况下发行优先股或抵押债券。这一禁止并非绝对，因为总有可能满足条件，使优先股股东认为授权发行高级债券对自己有利。这可能是因为通过债券发行进行新融资是避免接管所必需的。1932年的Eitingon-Schild公司就是一个例子。根据6 1/2%第一优先股的规定，该公司不得对其任何财产进行抵押、留置或质押，除非是购买款义务、现有抵押的延长，以及用流动资产作为担保以偿还正常业务中的贷款。由于该公司1932年的财务状况不稳定，优先股股东授权进行了某些财务调整，包括发行5,500,000美元的面额5%债券，其中包含某些条款，使得固定财产产生特殊负担。

<!--en-->
PREFERRED STOCKS ARE almost always accorded certain safeguards against the placing of new issues ahead of them. The standard provision prohibits either a prior stock or a mortgage-bond issue except upon approval by vote of two-thirds or three-fourths of the preferred stock. The prohibition is not made absolute because conditions are always within contemplation under which the preferred stockholders may find it to their advantage to authorize the creation of a senior issue. This may be done because new financing through a bond issue is necessary to avoid receivership. An example is afforded by Eitingon-Schild Company in 1932. According to the provisions of the 6 1/2% First Preferred stock the company could not create a mortgage, lien, or charge on any of its property, except purchase-money obligations, extensions of existing mortgages, and pledge of liquid assets to secure loans made in the ordinary course of business. Because of the precarious financial condition of the company in 1932 the preferred stockholders authorized certain financial rearrangements, including the creation of a $5,500,000-issue of 5% debentures containing certain provisions the effect of which was to create a special charge against fixed properties.

## 防止创建无担保债务是理想的。

<!--en-->
*Protection Against Creation of Unsecured Debt Desirable.*

通常的做法是不让优先股股东控制*无担保债务*的创建。美国金属公司就是一个例子，1930年在没有优先股股东投票的情况下发行了20,000,000美元的债券，但1933年被迫请求优先股股东批准可能质押担保物以在到期时偿还债券。我们认为这种区分不合理，因为无担保债务对优先股来说与抵押义务一样具有威胁。像通常那样规定优先股股东可以禁止发行比他们优先级更高或等效的新优先股，以及任何有担保债务，但这他们对创建债券发行毫无意见，无论规模多大，似乎都是不合逻辑的。

<!--en-->
It is a common practice to give preferred stockholders no control over the creation of *unsecured debt*. This point is exemplified by the American Metal Company, which in 1930 issued $20,000,000 of debenture notes without vote of thepreferred stockholders but in 1933 was compelled to ask for their approval of the possible pledging of collateral to refund the notes at maturity. This distinction appears to us to be unsound, since unsecured debt is just as much a threat to a preferred stock as is a mortgage obligation. It does seem illogical to provide, as is usually done, that preferred stockholders may forbid the issuance of new preferred shares ranking ahead of or equivalent to theirs and also of any secured indebtedness, but that they have nothing to say about the creation of a debenture bond issue, however large.

这种排除可能是出于允许银行为普通商业目的借款的意愿，但这一点可以通过具体规定来解决——就像现在使用的标准条款允许质押资产以担保“正常业务中的贷款”，而不需要优先股股东的同意。¹优先股股东的投票经常被用来允许发行同等优先级甚至更高的担保物，在重组计划下这些担保物将换取优先股本身，后者通常旨在处理累积股息。通过使新发行与旧发行平等或优先，原本可能拒绝这种安排的股东几乎被迫接受它。

<!--en-->
Presumably this exclusion arose from the desire to permit bank borrowing for ordinary business purposes, but this point may be taken care of by a specific stipulation to that effect—just as the standard provision now used permits the pledge of assets to secure “loans made in the ordinary course of business” without requiring preferred stockholders’ consent.¹
The preferred stockholders’ vote is rather frequently availed of to permit the issuance of an equal-ranking or even a prior security which is to be exchanged for the preferred stock itself under a recapitalization plan, the latter usually being designed to dispose of accumulated dividends. By giving the new issue equality with or priority over the old, stockholders who might otherwise be inclined to reject the composition are almost compelled to accept it.

*示例：* 1930年，Austin Nichols and Company有7%的优先股尚未偿还，累计股息为每股21美元。公司提出将每股优先股兑换为1股5美元的Cumulative Prior A股票，外加1.2股普通股。经接受该计划的优先股股东投票，新的Prior A股票的地位高于旧优先股。结果，约99%的旧优先股被交回进行兑换。国际纸业和Fisk Rubber分别在1917年和1925年对优先股的回溯股息进行了类似调整。在这些案例中，额外发行的优先股与旧股份具有同等地位。² **优先股偿债基金。** 很少有公用事业或铁路优先股发行包含偿债基金条款。

<!--en-->
*Examples:* In 1930 Austin Nichols and Company had 7% preferred stock outstanding on which dividends of $21 per share had accumulated. The company offered to exchange each share for one share of $5 Cumulative Prior A stock plus 1.2 shares of common. By vote of the preferred stockholders accepting the plan, the new Prior A stock was made senior to the old preferred. As a result, about 99% of the latter was turned in for exchange. International Paper and Fisk Rubber made similar adjustments of back dividends on the preferred in 1917 and 1925, respectively. In these cases, additional preferred stock was issued ranking equally with the old shares.²
**Preferred-Stock Sinking Funds.** Very few public-utility or railroad preferred-stock issues have a sinking-fund provision.

但对于工业优先股发行而言，偿债基金已成为普遍做法。债券因偿债基金而获得的优势同样适用于优先股。此外，鉴于我们多次强调优先股在合同地位上的弱势，买家更有理由要求此类特殊保护安排。尽管偿债基金是优先股发行中非常理想的特性，但其存在并不能保证安全，其缺失也不代表缺乏足够的安全性。1932–1933年期间保持投资状态的21种优先股（见第14章）中，只有一种发行包含偿债基金条款。如前所述，这种矛盾源于几乎所有重要的工业优先股都是老牌发行，而偿债基金是相对较新的发展。

<!--en-->
But in the case of industrial preferred-stock offerings sinking funds have become the general rule. The advantages that bonds derive from a sinking fund are equally applicable to preferred stocks. Furthermore, in view of the weak contractual position of preferred stocks, which we have frequently emphasized, there is the more reason for the buyer to insist on special protective arrangements of this kind. But although a sinking fund is thus a highly desirable feature of a preferred issue, its presence is no assurance, nor is its absence a negation of adequate safety. The list of 21 preferred stocks (given in Chap. 14) that maintained an investment status throughout 1932–1933 contains only one issue with a sinking-fund provision. As previously explained, this paradox is due to the fact that nearly all the strong industrial preferreds are old established issues, and the sinking fund is a relatively recent development.

偿债基金金额通常固定为任何时间未偿还优先股最高金额的一定百分比，3%可能是最常见的比例。较少情况下，金额基于利润百分比确定。存在一些描述性差异和技术细节，我们不会详细说明。在大多数情况下，只要满足以下条件，就必须支付偿债基金：(1) 优先股股息已全额支付或“预留”完毕；(2) 仍有相当于偿债基金要求的剩余利润。

<!--en-->
The amount of the sinking fund is usually fixed at a certain percentage of the maximum amount of preferred stock at any time outstanding, 3% being perhaps the most frequent figure. Less often the amount is based on a percentage of profits. There are a number of variations and technicalities of a descriptive nature, which we shall not detail. In most cases the payment of the sinking fund is obligatory, provided: (1) preferred dividends have been paid in full or “provided for,” and (2) there remain surplus profits equal to the sinking-fund requirement.

少数优先股通过协议保护，要求维持净流动资产，通常达到优先股发行规模的100%或优先股加上债券发行规模的100%。在某些情况下，不遵守协议的处罚仅禁止普通股分红（例如Sidney Blumenthal and Company），而在其他情况下，投票权会转移给优先股（例如A. G. Spalding and Brothers 7% First Preferred，要求营运资金等于优先股发行规模的125%）。³ **未支付股息时的投票权。**

<!--en-->
A small number of preferred stocks are protected by an agreement to maintain net current assets, usually at 100% of the preferred issue or 100% of the preferred stock plus bond issues. In some cases the penalty for nonobservance is merely a prohibition of common dividends (e.g., Sidney Blumenthal and Company), whereas in other cases voting control passes to the preferred stock (e.g., A. G. Spalding and Brothers 7% First Preferred, where working capital was required to equal 125% of the preferred issue).³
**Voting Power in the Event of Nonpayment of Dividends.**

优先股的第二类通用保护条款与未支付股息时获得的投票权相关。据我们所知，这些条款仅适用于累积优先股。关于投票权何时生效以及控制程度，安排有所不同。在少数情况下（例如Kaufmann Department Stores 7% Preferred和Royal Baking Powder Company 6% Preferred），投票权在遗漏一次季度股息后生效。在另一个极端情况下，只有在八次季度股息未支付后，投票权才生效（例如Brunswick-Balke-Collender Company）。常规允许期限为一年。授予优先股的权利可能包括：(1) 独家投票选举董事；(2) 单独选举董事会多数成员；(3) 单独选举董事会少数成员；或(4) 与普通股一起逐股投票。

<!--en-->
The second general type of protective provision for preferred stocks relates to voting power accruing in the event of nonpayment of dividends. As far as we know, thesestipulations apply only to cumulative issues. The arrangement varies with respect to when the voting power becomes effective and to the degree of control bestowed. In a few cases (e.g., Kaufmann Department Stores 7% Preferred and Royal Baking Powder Company 6% Preferred) the voting right accrues after one dividend is omitted. At the other extreme, the right becomes effective only after eight quarterly payments are in default (e.g., Brunswick-Balke-Collender Company). The customary period allowed is one year. The right conferred upon the preferred stock may be: (1) to vote exclusively for the directors, (2) to elect separately a majority of the board, (3) to elect separately a minority of the board, or (4) to vote share for share with the common stock.

*示例(1)：* McKesson and Robbins, Inc.优先股在1932年12月遗漏第四次季度股息后，获得唯一选举董事的权利。

<!--en-->
*Example of (1):* McKesson and Robbins, Inc., Preferred Stock received the sole right to elect the directors upon omission of the fourth quarterly dividend in December 1932.

*示例(2)：* 1933年，Hahn Department Stores Preferred优先股因遗漏四次季度股息，获得选举董事会多数成员的权利。

<!--en-->
*Example of (2):* In 1933 Hahn Department Stores Preferred obtained the right to elect a majority of the board, because of the omission of four quarterly dividends.

*示例(3)：* Universal Pictures First Preferred优先股在六次季度股息未支付时，有权选举两名董事。Brooklyn and Queens Transit Corporation Preferred优先股若在任何季度股息遗漏后一年内未付清所有欠款，可选举三分之一的董事会成员。

<!--en-->
*Example of (3):* Universal Pictures First Preferred has the right to elect two directors in the event of default of six quarterly dividends. Brooklyn and Queens Transit Corporation Preferred may elect one-third of the board if all arrears are not paid up within a year after any quarterly dividend is omitted.

*(4)的示例：*如果未支付四期季度股息，城市冰与燃料优先股与普通股的投票权为比例投票。⁴最后一种安排的价值很大程度上取决于优先股是否比普通股更大或更小。如果优先股更大，比例投票权可能使发行方获得实际控制权；但在大多数情况下，优先股规模较小，因此这种投票权可能无效。

<!--en-->
*Example of (4):* City Ice and Fuel Preferred votes share for share with the common in the event of nonpayment of four quarterly dividends.⁴
The value of the last arrangement would seem to depend a good deal on whether the preferred stock is larger or smaller than the common issue. If larger, the share-for-share voting right could give the issue effective control; but in most cases the preferred issue is smaller, and hence this voting right is likely to prove ineffective.

*复合权利。* 1939年发行的西宾恩电力4.5%优先股和威斯康星燃气电力4.5%优先股具有以下投票权：(1)与普通股比例投票，除非：(2)若一年期股息未支付，则优先股股东有权选举两名额外董事；(3)若三年期股息未支付，他们有权选举董事会过半数成员。北美公司6%优先股始终可以选举四分之一的董事会成员。若三年期股息未支付，它可以选举大部分董事。

<!--en-->
*Composite Rights.* West Penn Power 4½% Preferred and Wisconsin Gas and Electric 4½% Preferred, both issued in 1939, have the following voting rights: (1) a vote share for share with the common, unless: (2) a year's dividend is indefault, in which case the preferred stockholders have the right to elect two additional directors; (3) if three years' dividends are in default, they have the right to elect a majority of the board. North American Company 6% Preferred Stock can always elect one-quarter of the board. If three years' dividends are in arrears, it can elect a majority of the directors.

**非累积发行需要更多保护。**上述做法还值得其他一般性批评。首先，虽然人们认为这些特殊投票条款仅适用于累积优先股，但排除非累积发行似乎非常不合逻辑。其持有者确实有更充分的理由要求在股息未支付时获得代表权，因为他们无权在未来收回已损失的股息。我们认为，应确立一项财务原则：任何当前未支付全额股息的优先股，都应在董事会中拥有独立代表权。

<!--en-->
**Noncumulative Issues Need Greater Protection.** The practices outlined above merit certain other criticisms of a more general nature. In the first place, although it is taken for granted that these special voting provisions should apply to cumulative preferred stocks only, the exclusion of noncumulative issues seem to us to be most illogical. Their holders have certainly a greater reason to demand representation in the event of nonpayment, because they have no right to recover the lost dividends in the future. In our view it should be established as a financial principle that *any* preferred stock that is not paying its full dividend currently should have some separate representation on the board of directors.

另一方面，我们认为在优先股股息未支付时剥夺普通股的所有代表权是不合适的。优先股股东对董事会的完全控制可能导致一些对普通股明显不公平的行为，例如，通过不必要地拒绝全额支付回款股息来持续保持优先股的控制权。即使在实际投票中无权力，董事会中一个警觉的少数派也可能能够防止不公平或不合理的行为。

<!--en-->
On the other hand we do not consider it proper to deprive the common stock of all representation when preferred dividends are unpaid. Complete domination of the board by the preferred stockholders may lead to some practices distinctly unfair to the common stock, *e.g.*, perpetuation of preferred-stock control by unnecessarily refraining from paying up back dividends in full. An alert minority on the board of directors, even though powerless in the actual voting, may be able to accomplish a great deal in preventing unfair or unsound practices.

**关于投票权的通用准则。**从以上讨论来看，可以很容易地制定一个关于投票权的一般准则。标准安排应让所有优先股和普通股都拥有*在任何情况下选举某些董事*的独立权利。⁵只要优先股股息定期支付且金额相等，普通股选举董事会过半数成员是合理的；同样合理的是，每当未支付全额股息——无论是累积还是非累积优先股发行——选择董事会过半数成员的权利应属于优先股股东。⁶对优先股提供足够的保护应要求，在不仅股息未支付，而且未支付偿债基金或未能维持规定营运资金的情况下，投票控制权应转移给持有者。一些公司章程，如贝尤克雪茄公司和A.G.斯帕尔丁公司，为优先股股东提供了这种三重救济权利。我们认为，这种做法应成为标准而非例外。

<!--en-->
**A General Canon Regarding Voting Power.** From the foregoing discussion, a general canon with respect to voting power may readily be formulated. The standard arrangement should give every preferred and every common issue the separate right to *elect some directors under all circumstances*.⁵ It would be logical for the common stock to elect the majority of the board as long as preferred dividends were regularly paid and equally logical that whenever the full dividend was not paid, on either a cumulative ornoncumulative preferred issue, the right to choose the majority of the board should pass to the preferred stockholders.⁶
Adequate protection for preferred issues should require that voting control pass to the holders in the event not only of default in dividends but also of nonpayment of the sinking fund or the failure to maintain working capital as stipulated. A few charters, e.g., those of Bayuk Cigars and A. G. Spalding, afford this threefold remedial right to the preferred stockholders. In our view, this practice should be standard instead of exceptional.

**优先股投票控制的价值可能受到质疑。**现实看待这个问题时，必须承认将投票控制权赋予优先股持有者并不必然对其有利。在某些情况下，可能无法有效利用这一特权；在其他情况下，尽管有权力保护自身利益，持有者却过于消极或缺乏建议。这些实际限制可以通过一个典型案例来说明，即梅塔格公司。

<!--en-->
**Value of Voting Control by Preferred Stock May Be Questioned.** Viewing the matter realistically, it must be admitted that the vesting of voting control in holders of a preferred issue does not necessarily prove of benefit to them. In some cases, perhaps, no effective use can be made of this privilege; in other cases the holders are too inert—or too poorly advised—to protect their interests even though they have power to do so. These practical limitations may be illustrated by a case in point, *viz.*, the Maytag Company.

1928年，这家制造洗衣机的企业进行了重组，发行了以下证券：

<!--en-->
In 1928 this enterprise (manufacturing washing machines) was recapitalized and issued the following securities:

100,000股6美元累积第一优先股。320,000股3美元累积优先股（第二优先股）。1,600,000股普通股。大约80%的股份由梅塔格家族获得。通过投资银行家，他们向公众出售了第一和第二优先股的持有量。这使他们个人（而非公司）获得了约20,000,000美元的收入。他们通过持有普通股继续控制企业。公司章程规定，除非未支付四期季度股息，否则任何优先股发行都不应有投票权。在这种情况下，两种股票作为单一类别一起投票，将拥有选举董事会过半数成员的权利。

<!--en-->
100,000 shares of $6 Cumulative First Preferred.
320,000 shares of $3 Cumulative Preference (Second Preferred).
1,600,000 shares of common.
Approximately 80% of all these shares were received by the Maytag family. Through investment bankers they sold to the public their holdings of first and second preferred. This netted them individually (i.e., not the company) the sum of about $20,000,000. They retained control of the business through their ownership of common stock. The charter provided that neither preferred issue should have voting rights unless four quarterly dividends were defaulted on either. In that case both issues, voting together as a single class, would have the right to elect a majority of the directors.

1932年，两种优先股都未派息。因此，在1933年初，投票权转移给了这些股票的持有者。特别值得注意的是，1932-1933年期间，董事会唯一的变动就是那位作为发行机构之一合伙人的成员辞职——他原本可能代表优先股股东。剩下的五名董事都是运营官员，与普通股持有者关系密切。与此同时，两种优先股的价格分别下降到了15和3 1/8，而最初的发行价格分别为101和50。

<!--en-->
In 1932 dividends were omitted on both classes of preferred. Voting control consequently passed to the holders of these issues early in 1933. Peculiarly enough, the only change made during the 1932–1933 period in the board of directors was the *resignation* of the single member who—as partner of one of the issuing houses—had presumably represented the preferred stockholders. All of the five directors remaining were operating officials and closely identified with the common-stock ownership. In the meantime the price of the two preferred issues declined to 15 and 3 1/8, respectively, as compared with original offering prices of 101 and 50.

回顾这一情况，我们看到私人企业所有者出售对其利润的优先权益，并收取巨额款项，这些款项由他们个人保留。为了保护公众对企业权益的参与权，优先股在持续不支付股息时获得了投票权。这种情况确实发生了，导致股票价值大幅下跌。但新的投票权并未被行使，董事会仍然由普通股持有者完全控制，比之前更为彻底。

<!--en-->
Reviewing the situation, we see private owners of a business selling a preferred claim against its profits for a very large sum, which they retained individually. To protect the public’s stake in the enterprise, the preferred issues were given voting control in the event of continued nonpayment of dividends. This event occurred and with it a catastrophic decline in the value of the shares. But the new voting control was not exercised, and the board of directors remained dominated, even more completely than before, by those owning the common stock.

华尔街对这一事件的态度是：由于公司管理层诚实且有能力，更换董事会并无必要，甚至不明智。我们认为这种推理忽略了关键问题。毫无疑问，运营管理应保持不变；可能——尽管不能肯定——代表优先股的董事会在涉及高级股的事务上会遵循与普通股董事会相同的财务政策。但问题的核心在于，这些决策应由由优先股股东根据权利选出多数成员的董事会来做出。无论董事会更换是否会导致政策变化，董事的选择都应按照公司章程进行。否则，就会说服优先股买家相信他们有实际上不存在的保护措施。⁷ *此类情况下的推荐程序。* 作者认为，像梅塔格事件这样的情况，正确程序非常明确。优先股股东个人没有令人满意的方式来提名和选举代表他们的董事。这项职责应由发行机构承担，并且他们应认真执行。他们应： (1) 获取已登记优先股股东名单， (2) 告知他们新的投票权， (3) 推荐董事名单，并请代理投票支持这些候选人。建议的董事当然应尽可能具备胜任能力。他们必须没有任何与普通股的重大利益或密切关联，且最好 themselves是优先股的重要持有者。（对于根据重组发行的优先股，可能没有发行机构主动行动，但可以由在重组过程中曾为证券持有人服务的相同机构来完成。）

<!--en-->
Wall Street’s attitude toward this incident would be that, since the management of the company was honest and capable, a change in the directorate would be unnecessary and even unwise. In our opinion this reasoning misses the basic point. No doubt the *operating management* should remain unchanged; possibly—though by no means certainly—directors representing the preferred stock would follow the same financial policies in matters affecting the senior issues as would be followed by a board identified with the common stock. But the crux of the matter is that these decisions should actually be made by a board of directors of which the majority has been selected by the preferred stockholders in accordance with their rights. Regardless of whether or not a change in the board would result in any change in policy, the directors should be chosen as provided in the articles of incorporation. For otherwise the persuade the preferred-stock buyer into believing he has safeguards that are in fact nonexistent.⁷
*Recommended Procedure in Such Cases.* In the authors' view the proper procedure in cases such as the Maytag situation is perfectly clear. The preferred stockholders individually have no satisfactory means of going about the nomination and election of directors to represent them. This duty should devolve upon the issuing houses, and they should discharge it conscientiously. They should: (1) obtain a list of the preferred stockholders of record, (2) advise them of their new voting rights, and (3) recommend to them a slate of directors and request their proxies to vote for these nominees. The directors suggested should, of course, be as well qualified as possible for their posts. They must be free from any large interest in or close affiliation with the common stock, and it would be desirable if they were themselves substantial owners of preferred shares. (In the case of preferred stock issued pursuant to reorganization, there may be no issuing house to take the initiative, but this may be done by the same agencies formerly active in behalf of the security holders in the reorganization itself.)

不过，优先股股东选出的董事仍有可能无能或因其他原因无法妥善代表他们的利益。但这并非反对优先股股东拥有和行使投票权的有效理由。同样的反对意见也适用于普通股股东——以及公民——的投票权。解决办法不是剥夺权利，而是教育。正如我们之前指出的，为优先股提供充分的投票权条款，并迅速有效使用这些条款，可以很大程度上克服缺乏无条件法律权利获得股息的固有劣势。但在这两个条件都得到满足之前，我们必须继续强调债券形式相对于优先股形式的实际优势。

<!--en-->
It is quite possible, none the less, that the directors chosen by the preferred stockholders will be incompetent or for other reasons fail to represent their interests properly. But this is not a valid argument against the possession and the exercise of voting power by preferred stockholders. The same objection applies to voting rights of common stockholders—and of citizens. The remedy is not disenfranchisement but education. As we have previously pointed out, a combination of adequate voting-control provisions for preferred shares with their prompt and effective use could largely overcome the disadvantages inherent in the absence of an unqualified legal right to receive dividends. But until *both* these conditions are fulfilled, we must continue to stress the practical superiority for investors of the bond *form* over the preferred-stock form.

**维持足够的中级资本。** 我们最后想强调一个对债券持有人和优先股持有人都重要的保护要求，这在技术层面非常重要，但通常在债券协议或章程条款中并未得到重视。即维持足够数量的中级资本。我们之前已经强调过，这种中级资本是任何稳健固定价值投资不可或缺的条件。除非企业价值远高于所借金额，否则无法以3%或4%的利率向企业提供贷款。这是基本且容易理解的。但人们通常没有意识到，公司法允许在贷款发放后收回大部分资本和盈余。可以通过法律程序将资本减至名义金额，并将减少的金额分配给股东来实现这一点。除非债权人在其贷款合同中明确防止了这种情况，否则他们无法阻止这种操作。

<!--en-->
**Maintenance of Adequate Junior Capital.** We wish to call attention finally to a protective requirement for both bondholders and preferred stockholders which is technically of great importance but which frequently is not taken care of in indentures or charter provisions. The point referred to is the maintenance of an adequate amount of junior capital. We havepreviously emphasized the principle that such junior capital is an indispensable condition for any sound fixed-value investment. No loan could prudently be made to a business at 3 or 4% interest unless the business were worth a considerable amount over and above the amount borrowed. This is elementary and well understood. But it is not generally realized that the corporation laws permit the withdrawal of substantially all the capital and surplus after the loan has been made. This can be done by the legal process of reducing the capital to a nominal sum and distributing the amount of the reduction to the stockholders. Such a maneuver the creditors are powerless to prevent unless they have specifically guarded against it in their loan contract.

*削减法定资本的危险。* 让我们通过一个假设的例子来理解这一点。一家公司从事分期贷款业务，拥有210万美元的资本和盈余。表面上是为了扩展业务，它通过发行20年5%的债券借款200万美元。利润和股票权益似乎为债券提供了充分保障。后来业务下滑，公司拥有大量未使用的现金。股东投票决定将资本减至100万美元（理论上可减至1美元），并收回200万美元现金作为资本返还。

<!--en-->
*Danger in the Right to Reduce Stated Capital.* Let us attempt to bring this point home by a hypothetical example. A company is engaged in the business of lending money on installment accounts. It has $2,100,000 of capital and surplus. Ostensibly for the purpose of expanding its operations, it borrows $2,000,000 by sale of a 20-year 5% debenture bond issue. The earnings and stock equity appear to provide sufficient protection for the bonds. Business subsequently falls off, and the company has a substantial amount of unused cash. The stockholders vote to reduce the capital to $100,000 (in theory it might be reduced to $1), and they receive back $2,000,000 in cash, as a return of capital.

实际上，股东通过债券持有人提供的现金恢复了资本，但他们仍保留对企业的所有权和控制权，以及获得超过5%利润的权利。债券持有人处于荒谬的境地：他们提供了所有资本并承担了全部风险，却无法分享超过正常利息的利润。这种发展显然不公平，但除非债券协议明确规定不得向股东分配会使资本和盈余低于一定数值的分红，否则似乎可以合法实施。

<!--en-->
In effect the stockholders have recovered their capital with the cash supplied by the bondholders, but they retain ownership and control of the business together with the right to receive all profits above 5%. The bondholders find themselves in the absurd position of having provided all the capital and having thereby assumed all the risk of loss, without any share in the profits above ordinary interest. Such a development would be most unfair, but apparently it can be carried out legally unless the indenture of the bond issue specifically prevented it by stipulating that no distributions could be made to the stockholders that would reduce the capital and surplus below a certain figure.

通过直接以现金提取债券持有人“缓冲资金”——如我们的假设例子所示——是一种罕见甚至前所未有的情况。但在实践中，确实会出现类似的情况：先出现重大经营亏损，随后通过减少资本来消除由此产生的资产负债表赤字。

<!--en-->
The removal of the bondholders' "cushion" by its direct withdrawal in cash—as in our hypothetical example—is arare, perhaps unexampled, occurrence. But a corresponding situation does actually arise in practice through a combination of large operating losses followed by a reduction in capital to wipe out the consequent balance sheet deficit.

*示例：* 在第38章中，我们提到了一个此类非常典型的例子，即Interborough-Metropolitan案例。在这里，股东通过行动将法定资本减少，以消除巨大的损益赤字。在此之后，具有临时性质的利润被作为股息分配，而不是用于保护债券持有人，后者后来遭受巨大损失。根据当时法律，通过与空壳公司的“合并”来实现资本减少。自那以后，这种手段多次被用于重组计划，例如1926年的Central Leather Company和1932年的Kelly-Springfield Tire Company。

<!--en-->
*Examples:* In Chap. 38 we refer to an extraordinary example of this kind, *viz.*, the Interborough-Metropolitan case. Here the stated capital was reduced by stockholders' action to eliminate a huge profit-and-loss deficit. Following this action, earnings of a distinctly temporary character were disbursed in dividends, instead of being conserved for the benefit of the bondholders, who later suffered a tremendous loss. To effect the capital reduction under the laws then existing, a “merger” with a dummy corporation was resorted to. The same artifice has been used several times since in connection with recapitalization schemes, *e.g.*, Central Leather Company in 1926 and Kelly-Springfield Tire Company in 1932.

由于20世纪30年代经济萧条期间遭受损失，许多股东投票决定减少资本。这些行动是在未咨询债券持有人的情况下进行的。大多数减少是通过从无面值股份变为低面值股份来实现的。通常伴随着无形资产注销或固定资产减值。资产负债表一方资产价值下降、另一方资本减少，从债券持有人的角度来看并无特殊意义，可能只是导致折旧费用过低，从而允许过于慷慨的分红。但在大多数情况下，大量资金实际上也从资本转移到盈余中，从而可用于吸收未来的经营亏损，并在弥补过去损失之前恢复分红。

<!--en-->
As the result of losses sustained during the depression of the 1930s numerous reductions of capitalization have been voted by the stockholders. These actions have been taken without consulting the bondholders. Most of such reductions have been effected by changes from no-par shares to shares of a low par value. Frequently this has been accompanied by write-offs of intangible assets or mark-downs of fixed assets. Such write-downs of asset values on one side of the balance sheet and capital on the other are of no special significance from the bondholders' standpoint, except possibly in the fact that they may permit unduly low depreciation charges and therefore unduly liberal dividend payments. But in most of these cases a substantial sum also has effectively been transferred from capital to surplus and thus made available to absorb future operating losses and to facilitate the resumption of dividends before past losses have been made up.

例如，Remington Rand, Inc.将其普通股的面值从无面值改为1美元面值，并同时注销公司自身持有的股票，使得普通股的账面价值从17,133,000美元降至1,291,000美元。其中7,800,000美元用于冲减无形资产，2,300,000美元用于冲减工厂账户，400,000美元用于杂项减值和储备金。最终约有5,350,000美元实际从资本转入盈余。同样，Lexington Utilities的6美元优先股在1935年其面值从每股100美元降至25美元，股息和其他重要权利保持不变，仅为了消除资本赤字并允许恢复优先股息。这一举措消灭了债券持有人原本有权保留的四分之三以上的资金缓冲空间，以便支付股息。在后续几年中，大量资金被用于优先股息，这些资金原本会被用于补充债券持有人的"缓冲资金"。

<!--en-->
For example, Remington Rand, Inc., changed its common stock from no par to $1 par and thereby, together with cancellation of shares held by the company itself, reduced the stated value of the common from $17,133,000 to $1,291,000. It applied $7,800,000 of this reduction to write down its intangible assets, $2,300,000 additional to mark down its plant account, and $400,000 for miscellaneous write-downs andreserves. This left about $5,350,000 actually transferred from capital to surplus. In the same manner the par value of Lexington Utilities $6 Preferred Stock was reduced in 1935 from $100 to $25 per share, with no change in dividend or other significant rights and for the sole purpose of eliminating a capital deficit and permitting the resumption of preferred dividends. This action destroyed about three-quarters of the margin above funded debt which bondholders were formerly entitled to have maintained before dividends could be paid. In subsequent years large sums were disbursed in preferred dividends that otherwise would have been held or invested to make good the bondholders' "cushion."

纽约造船公司、Servel公司、华纳兄弟影业公司、H. F. Wilcox石油天然气公司、Thermoid公司也进行了类似的减值处理。国家Acme公司将其股本面值两次降低：1924年从50美元降至10美元，1933年从10美元降至1美元。结果，其法定资本从25,000,000美元缩至500,000美元。对于资本管理公司而言，不仅普通股的法定价值被降低，累计优先股的价值也被设定为虚假的低面值10美元。

<!--en-->
Similar reductions were made by New York Shipbuilding Corporation; Servel, Inc.; Warner Brothers Pictures, Inc.; H. F. Wilcox Oil and Gas Company; Thermoid Company. National Acme Company reduced the par value of its capital stock twice, from $50 to $10 in 1924 and from $10 to $1 in 1933. The result was a telescoping of its stated capital from $25,000,000 into $500,000. In the case of Capital Administration Company not only was the stated value of the common stock reduced, but the $3 cumulative preferred stock was also given a fictitiously low par value of $10.

*一些风险已得到防范。* 对于某些案例中的债券持有人来说幸运的是，债券条款中包含规定：除非债务水平下方有充足的资金储备，否则不得向股东发放股息或其他分配款。在Remington Rand Debenture $5\frac{1}{2}$s案例中，信托债券条款提供了三重保护，即：

<!--en-->
*Some Issues Protected Against This Danger.* Fortunately for the bondholders in some of these cases, the indentures contain provisions prohibiting dividends or other distributions to the stockholders unless there is an adequate margin of resources above the indebtedness. In the case of Remington Rand Debenture $5\frac{1}{2}$s, a threefold protection was supplied by the terms of the trust indenture, *viz.*:

1. 现金股息只能从已赚取的盈余中支付。
2. 现金股息仅可在扣除相关股息后的有形资产净值至少达到债务总额的175%时支付。
3. 任何库存金额不得超过3,500,000美元，但可以通过额外实收资本或收益盈余来突破这一限制。最后一条规定旨在防止通过购买优先股或普通股来减少次级资本。如果规定禁止公司自身股票的*收购*（而非*退出*），会更为理想。这类保护条款出现在许多债券合同中，但并非所有合同都有。例如，Lexington Utilities、New York Shipbuilding和Servel的债券就没有这些条款，这些公司是通过股东投票减少了声明资本。从以上讨论可以看出，这些契约对于正确保护债券发行至关重要。严谨的发行机构和明智的投资者应要求在所有债券合同中包含这些条款。⁸ *优先股在此方面的特殊地位*。优先股的地位在这方面有些特殊。其持有者与债券持有人一样，有权确保有足够量的次级资本。但导致资产负债表亏损的损失，将依法阻止不仅支付普通股息，还阻止支付优先股息。因此，优先股持有者很希望降低普通股的声明价值，从而消除损益亏损，允许恢复其自己股份的股息支付。在这种情况下，他们维护足够次级资本的权益会被他们更强烈的希望获得股息的欲望所抵消。（例如，在1921年底，Montgomery Ward的亏损导致了7,700,000美元的损益亏损，迫使暂停优先股息支付。因此，本次发行的持有者欢迎普通股的声明价值从28,300,000美元降至11,400,000美元，这消除了资产负债表亏损，从而允许恢复优先股息和释放积累收益。）这种情况甚至被普通股持有者利用，以迫使优先股持有者在损益亏损情况下做出重大让步。一个著名的例子是Central Leather的重组计划，最终成立了继任公司United States Leather。由于普通股持有者要求他们同意减少声明资本，他们迫使优先股持有者放弃后股息，并减少未来股息的累积权利。⁹ *优先股需要具体的保护条款和投票权来保护*。这些考虑进一步证实了我们之前对优先股作为投资工具的批评。保护这些问题免受次级资本的撤回并不特别困难；这通常已经做过，也应该一直做。¹⁰ 但从优先股持有者的角度来看，处理导致损益亏损的情况是很困难的。首先，需要由代表优先股的董事完全控制公司的政策。这强调了在股息未支付时，优先股持有者拥有足够投票权的重要性。[^4181]：¹ 然而，需要注意的是，近年来有一种趋势，即要求优先股持有者批准发行任何“自发行之日起一年以后到期的债券、票据、债券或其他债务证明”，以保护他们免受债券债券的创建。例如：Kendall Company $6 Participating Preferred、A. M. Byers Company 7% Preferred。在较老的问题中，Loose-Wiles Biscuit Company 7% First Preferred也有这种保护。

<!--en-->
1. Cash dividends may be paid only out of earned surplus.
2. Cash dividends may be paid only if net tangible assets after deducting the dividend in question shall equal at least 175% of the funded debt.
3. No stock may be retired, in excess of $3,500,000, except out of additional paid-in capital or earned surplus.
The last provision is directed against the reduction of junior capital by buying in preferred or common stock. Itwould be more satisfactory if it prohibited the *acquisition* (rather than the *retirement*) of the company's own stock.
Protective provisions of these various kinds appear in many but by no means all indentures. (They are absent, for example, in the case of Lexington Utilities, New York Shipbuilding, and Servel bonds, to name three of the companies that reduced their stated capital by stockholders' vote.) From the foregoing discussion, it should be clear that these covenants are essential to the proper safeguarding of a bond issue. Conscientious issuing houses and intelligent investors should insist on their inclusion in all indentures.⁸
*Anomalous Position of Preferred Stocks in This Connection.* The position of preferred stocks in this matter is a somewhat peculiar one. Their holders have the same interest as have bondholders in the maintenance of an adequate amount of junior capital. But losses that result in a balancesheet deficit will legally prevent the payment not only of common dividends but of preferred dividends as well. Hence the preferred stockholders are likely to be very anxious for a reduction in the stated value of the common stock, which will eliminate the profit-and-loss deficit and permit the resumption of dividends on their own shares. In such cases their interest in maintaining an adequate amount of junior capital is offset by their greater desire to make dividends possible. (At the close of 1921, for example, losses taken by Montgomery Ward had created a profit-and-loss deficit of $7,700,000, which had compelled suspension of the preferred dividend. Accordingly holders of this issue welcomed a reduction in the stated value of the common stock from $28,300,000 to $11,400,000, which eliminated the balance-sheet deficit and thus permitted the resumption of the preferred dividends and discharge of the accumulations.)
This situation has even been exploited by the common stockholders to compel large concessions from the preferred holders in connection with a profit-and-loss deficit. A notorious example is the Central Leather reorganization plan, resulting in the formation of a successor company, United States Leather. As the price of their vote in favor of reducing the stated capital, the common stockholders forced thepreferred holders to waive their back dividends and to reduce their cumulative right to future-dividends.⁹
*Preferred Stocks Need Both Specific Protective Provisions and Voting Power for Their Protection.* These considerations confirm our previously expressed criticisms of the preferred stock form as an investment medium. It is not particularly difficult to safeguard these issues against the withdrawal of junior capital; this is frequently done and should always be done.¹⁰ But to deal satisfactorily from the preferred stockholders’ standpoint with conditions resulting in a profit-and-loss deficit is a difficult matter. It requires, above all, complete control of the corporation’s policies by directors representing the preferred issue. This serves to emphasize the importance of adequate voting power for preferred stockholders in the event of nonpayment of dividends.
[^4181]: ¹ It should be noted, however, that there is a growing tendency in recent years to protect preferred stockholders against the creation of debenture bonds by requiring their approval of the issuance of any “bonds, notes, debentures, or other evidence of indebtedness maturing later than one year from the date of their issue.” See for example: the Kendall Company $6 Participating Preferred, A. M. Byers Company 7% Preferred. Among the older issues Loose- Wiles Biscuit Company 7% First Preferred had this type of protection.

² 一些州最近的法律允许公司通过三分之二赞成票，迫使所有优先股持有者接受重组计划。例如：1937年International Paper和Power的重组（根据马萨诸塞州法律），将原来的6%优先股和后续7%优先股（连同累计股息）替换为新的5%可转换优先股，加上普通股的奖励。然而，各种法院判决的结果认为，对于在这些法律颁布之前成立的公司，累计股息的权利是一种不可被股东投票剥夺的既得权利。

<!--en-->
² More recent laws of some states have permitted companies to compel all preferred stockholders to accept a recapitalization plan upon a two-thirds affirmative vote. Example: The recapitalization of International Paper and Power in 1937 (under the laws of Massachusetts) replaced the original 6% preferred and the successor 7% preferred (together with their accumulated dividends) by a new convertible 5% preferred, plus a bonus of common stock. The effect of various court decisions has been to hold, however, that, in the case of corporations formed prior to the enactment of these statutes, the claim for accumulated dividends is a vested right which cannot be taken away by stockholders’ vote.

VIII, “Management Plans without Aid of Committees,” pp. 187 *et seq.*, United States Government Printing Office, 1938.

³ 1939年，7%优先股被收入债券、新的优先股和普通股所取代。

<!--en-->
³ In 1939 the 7% First Preferred was replaced by income bonds, new preferred, and common.

⁴ 这种概念的独特变体出现在杜邦“无投票权债券股票”（优先发行股票）中，该股票于1939年停止发行。如果任何日历年的收益低于债券发行时的9%，持有者将享有与普通股票相同的投票权。如果股息支付连续六个月出现违约，他们还将获得专属投票权。

<!--en-->
⁴ An unusual variation of this idea was found in the case of Du Pont “Non-voting Debenture Stock” (a preferred issue), retired in 1939. The holders were given the right to vote equally with the common stock in the event that the earnings for any calendar year fell below 9% on the debenture stock issue. They received exclusive voting power if dividends were in default for six months.

据我们目前所知，此类发行事件相对罕见。不过，可以参考North American Company Preferred以及Ogden Corporation的新优先股（Ogden Corporation是Utilities Power and Light Corporation的继任者）。似乎在S.E.C.的推动下，还会出现更多此类发行事件。关于优先股股东投票权的一般问题，可参考W. H. S. Stevens所著的《资本股票股东的投票权》，载于《芝加哥大学商业杂志》第XI卷，第311-348页，1938年10月。

<!--en-->
5 So far as we have been able to determine, such issues are comparatively rare. See, however, North American Company Preferred and the new preferred stock of Ogden Corporation (successor to Utilities Power and Light Corporation). It seems probable that more such issues will be forthcoming under S.E.C. auspices. On the general subject of preferred stockholders' voting rights see W. H. S. Stevens, "Voting Rights of Capital Stock Shareholders," XI *The Journal of Business of the University of Chicago*, 311-348, October, 1938.

根据1938年《破产法》第十章第216-12(a)条，显然规定：根据该法发行的优先股，在股息支付出现违约时，享有选举董事的权利。

8 由于此内容写于1934年，现在在新债券合同中加入此类保障措施已成为常见做法。不仅禁止减少约定的资本额，还倾向于在发行债券时将盈余“冻结”，尽管通常有一些弹性。例如：Youngstown Sheet and Tube First 4%和Debenture 3 1/2%债券合同规定，自1935年12月31日起，现金分配仅限于利润，加上5,000,000美元。对于Koppers Company First和Collateral 4s债券（到期时间为1951年），分配限制自1936年1月1日起仅限于利润，加上额外股票出售所得款项。

<!--en-->
8 Since this was written in 1934, it has come to be common practice to include such safeguards in new bond indentures. Not only is there a prohibition against the reduction of stated capital, but there is a tendency also to "freeze" the surplus as of the time of the bond issue, though often with some leeway. Examples: The Youngstown Sheet and Tube First 4% and Debenture 3 1/2% indentures limit cash distributions to shareholders to earnings since Dec. 31, 1935, plus $5,000,000. In the case of Koppers Company First and Collateral 4s, due 1951, distributions are limited to profits since Jan. 1, 1936, plus proceeds of sale of additional stock.

9 本章注释2中提到的1937年International Paper and Power公司的资本重组，也涉及优先股股东做出了类似的牺牲。该重组得到了美国证券交易委员会（S.E.C.）的批准，但委员会对此持强烈反对态度。弗兰克委员在1939年1月30日发布的、批准发行北美公司6%优先股的命令中，将这一案例称为令人遗憾的例子，并发表了长篇异议。

<!--en-->
9 The International Paper and Power Company recapitalization of 1937, referred to in Note 2 of this chapter, involved a similar sacrifice by preferred stockholders. It was approved by the S.E.C. with considerable qualms and was cited by Commissioner Frank as a deplorable example in his vigorous and lengthy dissent from the Commission's order of Jan. 30, 1939, approving issuance of North American Company 6% Preferred Stock.

在这份意见中，他提出一个有趣的建议：如果普通股的价值被降低至较低水平，并由此产生大量特殊资本盈余，优先股股东就可以摆脱我们讨论过的困境。这样，损失就可以被计入该盈余中，否则会导致资本减值。此外，他还建议：当这种特殊资本盈余大幅减少时，投票控制权应转移给优先股股东。

<!--en-->
In this dissent he makes the interesting suggestion that preferred stockholders can escape the dilemma we have discussed if the stated value of the common is reduced to a low figure and a large special capital surplus thereby created, against which losses could be charged which otherwise would result in an impairment of capital. Coupled with this device is the suggestion that, when a substantial reduction in this special capital surplus has taken place, voting control should pass to the preferred stock.
