### 注释20

<!--en-->
*NOTE 20*

纽约市72d街与西端大道上的“哈德逊塔楼”就是这种令人痛心的例子。这座27层建筑最初作为酒店、医院和诊所建造，服务患者及其家属。因此属于特殊类型的建筑。土地实际成本为395,000美元，工程师估计建筑建设成本约为1,300,000美元。为了促进1,650,000美元首次抵押债券的出售，土地和建筑合计被“评估”为2,600,000美元，从而使这些债券根据纽约法律成为“信托基金合法债券”。这发生在1923年。随后，在完工前，该建筑经过多次买卖，并于1927年向公众出售了1,150,000美元的次级抵押债券。

<!--en-->
A harrowing example of this kind is furnished by the “Hudson Towers” at 72d Street and West End Avenue in New York City. This 27-story building was erected as a hotel, sanitarium, and hospital, catering to patients and their families. It was thus a specialized type of structure. The land actually cost $395,000, and engineers estimated that the building would cost $1,300,000 to construct. In order to facilitate the sale of $1,650,000 of first-mortgage bonds, the land and building combined were “appraised” at $2,600,000, thus making the bonds “legal for trust funds” under the New York law. This occurred in 1923. Subsequently the building passed through various hands by sale and resale, prior to its completion, and in 1927 second-mortgage bonds amounting to $1,150,000 were sold to the public.

该项目从未完成；1932年8月，该物业因首次抵押止赎而以200,000美元价格出售。对于不同意的首次抵押债券持有人来说，结果由欧文信托公司在1933年6月的公告所表明，该公司准备按每1,000美元未存入的首次抵押债券本金支付8.14美元。因此，清算时仅获得不到1美分。*存款*债券持有人在扣除保护委员会费用等后，每1,000美元债券仅获得3.84美元。

<!--en-->
The project was never completed; and in August 1932 the property was sold for $200,000 on foreclosure of the first mortgage. The outcome from the standpoint of the nonassenting first-mortgage bondholder is indicated by the announcement of the Irving Trust Co. in June 1933 that it was prepared to pay $8.14 on account of each $1,000 principal amount of undeposited first-mortgage bonds. Thus, less than 1 cent on the dollar was realized on liquidation. *Depositing* bondholders received only $3.84 per $1,000 bond, after deduction of protective committee expenses, etc.

## 注释21

<!--en-->
*NOTE 21*

请注意美国投资银行家协会工业证券委员会在1928年报告中提出的以下评论（《美国投资银行家协会会议记录》，1928年，第91页）。

<!--en-->
Note the following comment by the Industrial Securities Committee of the Investment Bankers Association of America in its 1928 report (*Proceedings of the Investment Bankers Association of America*, 1928, p. 91).

“我们审查了几份宣传册，其中基于租赁物业上的建筑经营而发行优先股。关于租赁租金是先前负担的说明，用非常小的字体和最不显眼的方式呈现。投资者只要看一眼宣传册，很容易认为优先股的股息是收益中的第一负担。不幸的是，投资者通常不会仔细阅读宣传册，普通投资者几乎不会注意到关于租赁负担的提及。我们认为，这些数字应该以与债券利息负担相同的方式呈现。”

<!--en-->
"Several circulars were examined in which an offering of preferred stock was made based upon a business housed in a building on leasehold property. The reference to the fact of a leasehold rental being a prior charge was made in very small type and in a most inconspicuous way. The investor glancing at the circular could easily derive the impression that the dividend on the preferred stock was a first charge on the earnings. Unfortunately, investors, as a rule, do not read circulars carefully, and the average investor would scarcely have noticed the mention made of the leasehold charge. In our opinion these figures should be set forth in just the same manner in which an interest charge on bonds would be placed."

当然，如果债券发行之前有租赁租金负担，这一论点同样成立。

<!--en-->
The argument is equally valid, of course, in the case of a bond issue which is preceded by leasehold rental charges.

沃德福-阿斯托里亚公司（纽约）的“1954年到期的首次抵押租赁7s”就是一个因土地租金问题遇到困难的典型租赁债券案例。

<!--en-->
A leading example of a leasehold issue which encountered difficulty on account of the ground rental is presented by the Waldorf-Astoria Corp. (New York) First Mortgage Leasehold 7s, due in 1954.

在Waldorf债券中，11,000,000美元于1929年10月向公众出售。土地租金最初为每年300,000美元，但两年后涨至600,000美元，此后逐步上升，最高达到每年800,000美元。此外，某些建筑及沉降基金租金需作为*运营费用*处理，尽管其金额是固定的且可确定的。因此，发行说明书中称第一租赁地7号债券的固定费用已覆盖4.5倍（根据估算收入表），这一说法具有误导性，因为租金费用很快会超过债券利息，并与运营费用合并计算，从而掩盖了它们的真实性质和影响。如果购买第一租赁地7号债券的人按6%的利率提前支付之前的费用，他会发现11,000,000美元的债券金额低于约23,000,000美元的先前索赔金额。

<!--en-->
Of the Waldorf issue $11,000,000 were sold to the public in October 1929. The ground rental began at $300,000 a year, but jumped to $600,000 at the end of two years and wasgraduated upward thereafter to a maximum of $800,000 per year. In addition there were certain building and sinking-fund rentals required to be treated as *operating expenses*, although they were fixed and determinable in amount. The statement in the offering circular that the fixed charges on the First Leasehold 7s were covered over 4.5 times (according to an estimated income account) was therefore misleading, as the rental charges were soon to exceed the interest on the bonds and were lumped in with the operating expenses in such a way as to conceal their true character and effect. If the buyer of the First Leasehold 7s had capitalized the prior charges at 6%, he would have discovered that the $11,000,000 issue was junior to about $23,000,000 of prior claims.

1932年初，有必要与房东（纽约中央铁路公司子公司）就违约的土地租金问题进行协商。1937年完成了一项调整计划，房东在未来土地租金的支付顺序和金额上做出了某些让步，作为回报，债券持有人同意修改契约，将其持有的债券转换为带有不确定费用的普通股票和收益债券。在这种情况下，债券在1932年的价格降至3 1/4美元。

<!--en-->
Early in 1932 it became necessary to negotiate with the landlord (a subsidiary of the New York Central R.R.) with respect to the ground-rental payments which were in default. A plan of readjustment was completed in 1937 whereby the landlord made certain concessions with respect to the order and amounts in which ground rentals are to be payable in the future, and in return the bondholders assented to a modification of the indenture whereby their holdings were transformed into common stock and income bonds carrying contingent charges. The bonds in this case declined to a low price of 3 1/4 in 1932.

Hotel Pierre债券也出现了类似情况。1932年和1933年，原始债券以每美元1美分的价格出售。1932年的重组使旧第一租赁地6 1/4号债券持有人获得了2 East 61st Street Corp.的新收益债券，本金大幅减少，并获得了少量股票。1939年4月，该企业再次面临租金义务困难，申请自愿破产。

<!--en-->
A very similar situation developed with respect to the Hotel Pierre issue. The original bonds sold in this case at a low price of 1 cent on the dollar in 1932 and 1933. A reorganization in 1932 gave the holders of the old First Leasehold 6 1/4s a drastically reduced principal amount of new Income Debentures of 2 East 61st Street Corp. and a small amount of stock. In April 1939 the enterprise again encountered difficulties with its rental obligations and filed a voluntary petition in bankruptcy.

Tower Building Company (Chicago)第一租赁地6 1/2号债券于1926年按面值向公众发行，金额为1,900,000美元。该租赁要求每年支付土地租金，起始为190,000美元（此后逐步增加）。

<!--en-->
Tower Building Company (Chicago) First Leasehold 6 1/2s were offered to the public in 1926 at par. The amount was $1,900,000. The leasehold called for annual payment of a ground rent starting at $190,000 (and increasing thereafter).

这些沉重的租赁费用随后出现违约；租赁在1931年被没收，债券失去所有价值。

<!--en-->
These heavy leasehold payments were subsequently defaulted; the lease was forfeited in 1931, and the bonds lost all value.

170 Broadway Corporation (纽约)第一租赁地6 1/2号债券持有人也遭遇了类似的灾难性命运，到期日为1949年。

<!--en-->
A similar disastrous fate befell the holders of 170 Broadway Corporation (New York) First Leasehold 6 1/2s, due 1949.

## 注释22

<!--en-->
*NOTE 22*

学生可能会觉得，将我们建议的债券选择最低量化标准与1939年由Standard Statistics Company和纽约州银行家协会债券投资组合委员会共同制定的*债券质量指标*进行比较很有趣。他们对各种类别（市政债券除外）提出的比率总结在附上的表I和表II中，摘自E. Sherman Adams于1939年12月4日出版的《Barron's》杂志文章《如何测试你的债券》。*表I—债券质量比率*旨在作为有用的指南，并非僵化的标准或唯一的测试方式

<!--en-->
The student will find it interesting to compare our suggested minimum quantitative standards for bond selection with the *Bond Quality Yardsticks* prepared in 1939 jointly by Standard Statistics Company and the Bond Portfolio Committee of the New York State Bankers Association. Their proposed ratios for various groupings (except municipals) are summarized in the appended Tables I and II, reproduced by permission from an article entitled “How to Test Your Bonds,” by E. Sherman Adams, which appeared in the Dec. 4, 1939, issue of *Barron's*.

<!--en-->
* Supplemental ratios for these groups are given in Table II.
1 Based on actual fixed charges reported in previous years, not upon present charges.
2 After taxes.
3 Most of these guide ratios are based on the recorded experience of the better situated companies within the various industries.
4 Ratio of operating expenses, excluding depreciation, depletion and federal income taxes, to gross revenues.
5 Fixed debt to net property plus inventories.
6 Times fixed charges earned before depreciation, less equipment trust maturities.
7 For systems where at least 75% of revenues is derived from electricity.
8 With last year's result at least as good as six-year average.
9 Net income to operating revenues.
10 Net property to operating revenues.
11 With minimum for any one year no less than two times.
Source: Tables I and II are reproduced from the December 4, 1939 issue of *Barron's, The National Financial Weekly*.
(A) The following additional guide ratios relating to asset protection are recommended for all industrial groups (C); Cash and equivalent to current liabilities—100% or more. Fixed debt to market value of total capitalization (taking bonds at par, preferred stock at the lower of par or market, and common stock at market; year-end prices)—not over 25% Guide ratios (C) should be applied especially to a company's latest reported figures but some consideration should also be given to figures for earlier years and to their trend. (B) All guide ratios relating to earnings protection should be applied to a company's average figures for the last six years. This also applies to the ratio of net property to gross revenues.
*TABLE II.—OTHER RATIOS FOR PARTICULAR GROUPS²*

### 汽车轮胎、肉类包装、有色金属制造商

<!--en-->
*Auto Tires, Meat Packing, Non-Ferrous Metal Fabricators*

不包括库存的营运资金与固定债务的比例——100%或更多。

<!--en-->
Net working capital excluding inventories to fixed debt—100% or more.

## 百货商店

<!--en-->
*Department Stores*

库存周转率——每年八次或更多。

<!--en-->
Inventory turnover—eight times a year or more.

### 食品连锁企业

<!--en-->
*Grocery Chains*

库存周转率——每年12次或更多。流动资产（不包括库存）与流动负债的比例——100%或更高。（该比率适用于食品连锁企业，而非其他工业集团使用的现金及等价物与流动负债的比率。）

<!--en-->
Inventory turnover—12 times a year or more. Current assets excluding inventories to current liabilities—100% or more. (This ratio is suggested for grocery chains instead of the ratio of cash and equivalent to current liabilities used for all other industrial groups.)

## 印刷与出版业

<!--en-->
*Printing and Publishing*

固定债务与净资产加好意——50%或以下(a)。发行指数——趋势（1929年=100)应与全国平均水平相当(b)。(a)在将“好意”、报纸会员数、发行量、特许经营权、广告支持等作为债券资产保护因素时，必须确定所报数据的合理性。作为粗略参考，代表性报纸公司将其“好意”按每1000份发行量约30,000美元进行评估。(b)全国平均水平指数：1929年—100；1930年—100.4；1931年—98.2；1932年—92.3；1933年—89.1；1934年—93.0；1935年—96.8；1936年—102.0；1937年—104.8；1938年—100.3.]

<!--en-->
Fixed debt to net property plus good-will—50% or less(a). Index of circulation—trend (1929 = 100) should be as favorable as that of the national average(b).
[(a) In using the item of good-will, press membership, circulation, franchises, advertising patronage, etc., as a factor of asset protection for bonds, it is essential to determine the reasonableness of the stated figures. As a rough guide, a representative group of newspaper companies evaluate their “good-will” on a basis of around $30,000 per 1,000 circulation. (b) Index of national average: 1929—100; 1930—100.4; 1931—98.2; 1932—92.3; 1933—89.1; 1934—93.0; 1935—96.8; 1936—102.0; 1937—104.8; and 1938—100.3.]

## 公共事业部门

<!--en-->
*Public Utilities*

折旧与维护占营业收入比例——蒸汽电力运营公司15%，水电运营公司13%，水务公司12%，电话公司25%。净营业收入与净资产比例——所有行业约为7%。净资产与营业收入比例，以及营业收入与运营费用比例——对于水电运营公司而言，重要的是将这些比率一起考虑，但由于每种情况需根据其自身地域问题评估，因此无法设定标准。每个电话站营业收入——50美元或更多。

<!--en-->
Depreciation and maintenance to operating revenues—15% for steam-electric operating companies, 13% for hydro-electric operating companies, 12% for water companies, 25% for telephone companies. Net operating income to net property—around 7% for all groups. Net property to operating revenues, and operating expenses to operating revenues—in the case of hydro-electric operating companies it is important that these ratios should be considered together but no standards can be set because each situation must be appraised in the light of its own territorial problems. Operating revenues per telephone station—$50 or more.

### 铁路行业

<!--en-->
*Railroads*

铁路运营固定费用占平均比例，过去六年平均值——两倍或更多。净营运资金（包括流动资产中的政府债务和流动负债中的应缴税款）与固定费用比例——200%或更多。线路与设施维护及设备维护（包括折旧）占总收入比例——过去几年中25%或更多。运输费用占总收入比例——呈稳定或下降趋势。每列货运列车小时的总吨英里数——呈稳定上升趋势。固定债务与总资本价值市场价值比例（以面值债券、较低的面值或市场价优先股、市场价普通股为基准；年末价格）——不超过50%（参见文本）。

<!--en-->
Coverage of fixed charges from railway operations, average for last six years—two times or more. Net working capital (including government obligations with current assets and accrued taxes with current liabilities) to fixed charges—200% or more. Maintenance of way and structure plus maintenance of equipment (including depreciation) to gross revenues—25% or more during past several years. Transportation expense to gross revenues—steady or declining trend. Gross ton miles per freight train hour—steadily upward trend. Fixed debt to market value of total capitalization (taking bonds at par, preferred stock at the lower of par or market, and common stock at market; year-end prices)—not over 50% (See text.)

对这些比率进行充分分析需要太多篇幅。显然，我们认为几乎所有这些比率要么不必要，要么过于严格，否则我们应该相应调整自己的建议。需要指出的是，这些表格中提供的指标“并非作为银行永远不能低于的标准”，而更像是“额外的分析工具”与完善建议之间的某种平衡。我们认为，所提出的多种标准大大降低了这些指标的实用价值。如果必须满足所有标准，合格债券投资领域将变得极其狭窄。如果某些标准可以放宽，投资者将难以判断哪些最重要，以及可以安全允许自己多大的自由度。

<!--en-->
An adequate critique of these ratios would require too much space. It is obvious that we consider nearly all of them either unnecessary or excessively severe, since otherwise we should have revised our own suggestions accordingly. It should be pointed out that the yardsticks presented in these tables “are not offered as a standard below which banks nevershould go” but seem rather to represent something between “an additional working tool” and a counsel of perfection. In our view the multiplicity of the standards proposed detracts greatly from the practical utility of these yardsticks. If *all* these tests must be met, the field of eligible bond investment is narrowed almost intolerably. If some may be waived, the investor is left pretty much at sea as to which are most important and how much latitude he may safely allow himself.

将这些指标实际应用于储蓄银行或保险公司的典型债券组合，将构成安全的分析练习，并有助于了解所建议测试的实际意义。*Standard Corporation Records*目前正在对领先公司编制这些比率。

<!--en-->
The actual application of these yardsticks to typical bond portfolios of savings banks or insurance companies would constitute a useful exercise in security analysis and would also shed some light on the practical implications of the tests suggested. *Standard Corporation Records* now compiles these ratios on leading companies.

<!--en-->
This comparison shows, first, that dividend-paying roads tend to be more liberal with maintenance than nondividend payers struggling to remain solvent and, second, that roads falling into trusteeship tend to increase their maintenance ratios even while the others are cutting down.

## 注释 25

<!--en-->
*NOTE 25*

关于那些完全或部分具有工业性质，但以“公共事业”名义运营的企业示例，请参阅：United Public Service Co.，成立于1927年，从事电灯与电力、天然气及人工煤气、冰厂与冷藏业务；Southern Ice & Utilities Co.，成立于1916年，从事冰、冰淇淋、乳品及冷藏仓库业务；The Utilities Service Co.，成立于1928年，负责收购并运营小城镇的20家电话公司以及大城镇或城市的4家冰业公司；Central Atlantic States Service Corp.，成立于1928年，从事冰、煤炭与冷藏业务；Westchester Service Corp.，成立于1928年，从事煤炭、冰、燃料油及建筑材料业务；National Service Cos.，成立于1928年，作为Westchester Service Corp.类企业的控股公司，从事冰、燃料及相关行业。分析表明，尽管这些企业的运营主要或完全属于工业性质，但其资本结构仍属于公共事业类型。

<!--en-->
For examples of enterprises wholly or partially industrial in character but masquerading under the “public utility” title see: United Public Service Co., organized in 1927 and engaged in the electric light and power, natural and artificial gas, ice plant and cold storage businesses; Southern Ice & Utilities Co., organized in 1916 and engaged in the ice, ice cream, creamery, and cold storage warehouse businesses; The Utilities Service Co., organized in 1928 to acquire and operate 20 telephone companies in small towns and four ice companies in large towns or cities; Central Atlantic States Service Corp., organized in 1928 and engaged in the ice, coal, and cold storage businesses; Westchester Service Corp., organized in 1928 and engaged in the coal, ice, fuel oil, and building-supply businesses; National Service Cos., organized in 1928 as a holding company for enterprises of the Westchester Service Corp. type, engaged in the ice, fuel, and allied industries. Examination will reveal that these companies had capital structures of the public-utility type despite the fact that their operations were largely or wholly industrial in character.

其中一些企业至今仍以基本原始形式存在，但大多数已面临财务困难并进行了重组。United Public Service Co.于1934年重组为United Public Service Corp.。Southern Ice & Utilities Co.于1938年将名称改为Southern Ice Co.。Utilities Service Co.于1930年进入接管程序，并于1933年根据计划进行重组，将电话业务与工业部门分离。Central Atlantic States Service Corp.于1934年重组，其资产被Cassco Corp.收购。Westchester Service Corp.于1936年根据破产法第77B条进行重组。National Service Cos.保留了其原有身份。

<!--en-->
Some of these companies are still in existence in substantially their original form, but most of them have encountered financial difficulty and been reorganized. United Public Service Co. was reorganized in 1934 as United Public Service Corp. Southern Ice & Utilities Co. changed its name in 1938 to Southern Ice Co. Utilities Service Co. entered receivership in 1930 and was reorganized in 1933 under a plan whereby the telephone business was segregated from the industrial divisions. Central Atlantic States Service Corp. was reorganized in 1934, and its properties taken over by Cassco Corp. Westchester Service Corp. was reorganized in 1936 under Section 77B of the Bankruptcy Act. National Service Cos. has preserved its original identity.

美国投资银行家协会通过其多个委员会多次评论过债券通函的不当之处：要么完全忽略折旧说明，要么通过将折旧费用包含在经济账目的某个笼统项目中来隐藏实际折旧金额。以下引文可说明这一点：

At various times the Investment Bankers Association of America has commented through its several committees upon the impropriety of bond circulars which either omit reference to depreciation entirely, or else conceal the actual amount of the depreciation charge through including it in some blanket item in the income account. The following quotations will serve to illustrate:

“关于折旧及正确的处理政策，存在许多合理的意见分歧，但无论采用何种政策，投资者都有权了解实际情况。一家公司发布的通函若未提及折旧，则遗漏了投资者需考虑的重要因素”（《债券通函编制与使用特别委员会报告》，发表于《美国投资银行家协会会议记录》，1925年，第274页）。

<!--en-->
"There are many honest differences of opinion about depreciation and about the proper policy to provide for it, but whatever policy is adopted, the investor is entitled to know what it is. A circular of a corporation issue which does not mention depreciation leaves out an important factor in the affairs of the company in which the investor is asked to place his funds" ("Report of Special Committee on the Preparation and Use of Bond Circulars," printed in the *Proceedings of the Investment Bankers Association of America*, 1925, p. 274).

“我们会员特别关注折旧问题的处理方式。有些通函完全不提及资产负债表，但在大多数情况下，这种情况出现在并非至关重要的通函中。然而，常见的做法是先展示扣除折旧和税后的收益，然后对折旧金额只字不提。由于我们的努力是向投资者提供普通通函中尽可能完整的信息，因此除非给出扣除折旧前的收益、折旧金额以及用于债券利息和税金的金额，并将余额留在盈余中，否则投资者无法获得全部信息。如果投资者理解资产负债表，并且对制造业有一定了解，那么折旧的处理方式及其金额就能充分反映相关企业的管理状况。有些通函显示扣除折旧和税后的收益，但未显示扣除前的情况。工业证券与商业行为委员会主席认为，如果通函分别列出扣除折旧前的收益、折旧金额及扣除后的收益，就能向投资者呈现最理想的画面”（《美国投资银行家协会商业行为委员会中期报告公报》，1927年3月，第3页）。

<!--en-->
"The attention of our membership is particularly directed to the treating of the subject of depreciation. Some few circulars omit the balance sheet entirely, but in most instances this occurs in circulars where it is not particularly vital. However, the practice is quite common to show earnings before depreciation and taxes and then say nothing about the amount of depreciation taken. Inasmuch as it is our endeavor to present to the investor as complete a picture as is possible in an ordinary circular, it would seem that unless the earnings before depreciation are given, the amount of depreciation taken, and amount remaining for bond interest and taxes, leaving the balance to go to surplus, the investor has not all of the facts in the case. If the investor understands a balance sheet and is at all familiar with manufacturing, the manner in which depreciation is taken and its amount will tell him quite a story as to the management of the concern in question. Some circulars show earnings after depreciation and taxes but no earnings before such deductions. It is the opinion of both the Industrial Securities and Business Conduct Committee Chairman that the ideal picture to the investor would be presented if the circular showed earnings before depreciation, the amount of depreciation and the earnings after depreciation, as separate items" (*Interim Report of the Business Conduct**Committee* of the Investment Bankers Association of America *Bulletin*, March 1927, p. 3).

## 注释 27

<!--en-->
*NOTE 27*

## 公共事业控股公司债券中少数权益处理的示例

<!--en-->
*EXAMPLE OF TREATMENT OF MINORITY INTEREST IN COMPUTING INTEREST COVERAGE FOR PUBLIC-UTILITY HOLDING-COMPANY BONDS*

联合灯光与铁路公司（德尔塔州）1938年的报告包含了美国灯光与牵引公司的数据，该公司持有该公司的54.69%普通股。45%的少数权益对应的收益约为1,851,000美元。这种少数权益可以通过三种方式处理：

<!--en-->
The report of the United Light & Railways Co. (Del.) for 1938 included the results of American Light & Traction Co. of which it owned 54.69% of the common stock. The earnings applicable to the 45% minority were about $1,851,000. This minority interest may be treated in three ways, *viz.*:

*方法A*（这是常规方法）。在扣除母公司的权益费用后，再扣除少数股权。采用这种方法，少数股权不会以任何方式影响债券利息覆盖率。

<!--en-->
*Method A* (which is the customary method). The minority interest is deducted after the parent company's interest charges. Under this method the minority item does not affect the bond-interest coverage in any way.

*方法B*（虽然准确，但稍显复杂）。子公司收益和费用仅按母公司持股比例计算。也就是说，收益和固定费用都会按照少数普通股持股比例的百分比进行调整。

<!--en-->
*Method B* (which is accurate, but a little complicated). Subsidiary earnings and charges are included only to the extent of the parent company's ownership. In other words, both the earnings and the fixed charges are reduced by the percentage applicable to the minority holdings of common stock.

*方法C*（推荐方法）。在计算利息覆盖率之前，从净收益中扣除少数股权（就像扣除一项费用一样）。这样得到的利息覆盖率会比方法B低，但低估程度适中。

<!--en-->
*Method C* (which is recommended). The minority interest is deducted from net earnings (in the same way as an expense item) *before* figuring the interest coverage. This will result in a smaller interest coverage than under Method B, but the understatement will be moderate.

应用于联合轻轨公司1938年度报告的三种方法结果如下：

<!--en-->
The three methods applied to United Light & Railways Co. report for 1938 will give the following results:

* 不包括 American Light & Traction 中少数股权（45.31%）的情况。请注意，应用方法 *B* 所需的唯一额外计算就是确定适用于少数股权的子公司固定费用金额。将调整后的固定费用除以母公司股份余额，得到的覆盖比例会减去 1。另外需要注意的是，虽然方法 *C* 的结果总是比其他两种方法小，但方法 *B* 的覆盖比例会比方法 *A* 更高或更低，这取决于子公司是凭借比合并系统更小的利润空间来赚取费用，还是更大的利润空间。

<!--en-->
* Excluding minority interest (45.31%) in American Light & Traction figures.
Note that the only additional calculation needed to apply Method *B* is to find the amount of subsidiary fixed charges applicable to the minority interest. The adjusted fixed charges divided into the balance for parent-company shares will give the coverage less 1. Note also that although Method *C* always gives a smaller result than the other two, Method *B* will give a higher or lower coverage than Method *A* depending on whether the subsidiary earned its charges with a smaller or larger margin than the combined system.

## 注意 28

<!--en-->
*NOTE 28*

关于保护优先股息的安全边际计算，大多数投资教材作者对此关注较少。在某些情况下，这是因为将优先股排除在投资类别之外（例如劳伦斯·张伯伦的著作），但大多数情况下无法给出这样的解释。近几十年来流通中的优先股数量极其庞大，这表明人们在选择此类股票时一定形成了某种独特的观点和方法，令人惊讶的是，那些撰写证券选择“科学”相关书籍的人并未给予该问题足够的重视。

<!--en-->
Calculation of the margin of safety protecting preferred dividends has received relatively scant attention at the hands of most writers of textbooks on investment. In some cases this is due to the exclusion of preferred stocks from the category of investment (e.g., the writings of Lawrence Chamberlain), but in most instances no such explanation can be offered. The exceedingly large volume of preferred stock outstanding in recent decades suggests that some discriminating point of view and technique must have been developed for choosing between issues of this type, and it is surprising that more attention has not been given to the matter by those who write books on the “science” of security selection.

在大多数情况下，当主题受到关注时，先决推理计算方法要么被明确推荐，要么在讨论中隐含其中。例如，Carl Kraft和Louis P. Starkweather在《工业证券分析》（纽约，1930年）中，在对Jones Bros. Tea Co.的较为详尽的示例分析中使用了这种具有误导性的计算方法，并未对结果比率进行严格审查。参见第127页，比率20-(b)，以及第130–132、162页，尤其是1926年和1927年的数据。

<!--en-->
In most instances in which the subject receives attention the prior-deductions method of calculation is either explicitly recommended or implicit in the discussion. For example, Carl Kraft and Louis P. Starkweather in their *Analysis of Industrial**Securities*, New York, 1930, use this misleading method of calculation in their rather extensive illustrative analysis of Jones Bros. Tea Co. without examining the resultant ratios critically. See p. 127, ratio 20-(b), and pp. 130–132, 162, especially the 1926 and 1927 exhibits.

J. E. Kirshman在修订版《投资原则》中（纽约，1933年），提到对联邦水务公司收益的描述称其“在过去几年中多次获得”。这一说法仅在采用先前扣除法进行计算时才正确。在1928年至1932年期间（包括此期间），固定费用与优先股息合计的收益倍数从未超过1.37倍（见第155-156页、437页）。同样，D. F. Jordan也多次指出优先股的理想安全边际，即仅优先股息本身的收益倍数。参见他的《投资》第三版修订本，第157、160、162、167、185、192页，纽约，1936年。有趣的是，他指出了这种方法在公用事业控股公司优先股中的错误，并推荐采用总体扣除法进行计算（见第169页）。

<!--en-->
J. E. Kirshman in his revised *Principles of Investment*, New York, 1933, refers to the coverage on Federal Water Service Corp. Preferred as having been earned “several times over within the past few years,” which is a correct statement only in case the prior-deductions method of calculation is used. The combined fixed charges and preferred dividends were never covered more than 1.37 times during the years 1928–1932, inclusive (see pp. 155–156, 437). Likewise, D. F. Jordan repeatedly states the desired margin of safety for preferred stocks in terms of the number of times the preferred dividends alone are earned. See his *Investments*, 3d rev. ed., pp. 157, 160, 162, 167, 185, 192, New York, 1936. Curiously enough, he sees the fallacy of this method in the case of preferred stocks of public-utility holding companies and recommends the total deductions (over-all) method of calculation (see p. 169).

Floyd F. Burtchett在《投资与投资政策》一书中（1938年，纽约出版），也接受了先决条件概念（参见第263、287和325页）。

<!--en-->
Floyd F. Burtchett in his *Investments and Investment Policy*, New York, 1938, also embraces the prior-deductions idea (see p. 263, 287, and 325).

Badger和Guthmann，以及Herschel和Prime则强烈指出，用于计算优先股息覆盖率的"先推断法"存在错误，建议将"总扣除法"作为标准计算方法。参见R. E. Badger和H. C. Guthmann所著的《投资原则与实践》，第348-350页、465-467页，纽约，1936年；A. H. Herschel所著的《优质投资的选择与维护》，第217-222页，纽约，1925年；John H. Prime所著的《工业证券分析》，第292页，纽约，1935年。

<!--en-->
Badger and Guthmann, Herschel and Prime, on the other hand, forcefully call attention to the fallacy of the prior-deductions method of calculating coverage for preferred dividends and recommend the total-deductions calculation as standard procedure. See R. E. Badger and H. C. Guthmann, *Investment Principles and Practices*, pp. 348–350, 465–467, New York, 1936; A. H. Herschel, *The Selection and Care of Sound Investments*, pp. 217–222, New York, 1925; John H. Prime, *Analysis of Industrial Securities*, p. 292, New York, 1935.

文中的数据可以通过详细审查价格记录来验证，以下为示例：1929年10月31日，将于1960年到期堪萨斯城码头4号债券以86又1/4美元出售，收益率为4.9%；同一天，芝加哥、罗克岛及太平洋铁路公司将于1988年到期的一般4号债券以90美元出售，收益率为4.5%。四年后，即1933年11月22日，堪萨斯城码头债券以86又1/4美元出售，而罗克岛一般4号债券价格跌至42美元，收益率约为10%。1927年12月8日，码头债券以93又7/8美元出售，芝加哥、密尔沃基及圣保罗铁路公司将于1989年到期的一般4号债券以93美元出售，收益率略低于前者。1933年2月24日，码头债券以90美元出售，收益率约为4.65%；而圣保罗一般4号债券价格跌至38美元，收益率约为11%。从1927年11月7日至1932年6月15日，码头4号债券价格从93美元降至82又3/4美元（收益率分别为4.4%和5.18%），而密苏里-堪萨斯-德克萨斯铁路公司优先留置权4号债券于1962年到期，价格从93美元降至31又1/8美元（收益率分别为4.39%和超过15%）。

<!--en-->
The statements in the text may be verified by a detailed examination of the price records from which the following have been drawn as illustrations. On Oct. 31, 1929, the Kansas City Terminal 4s, due 1960, sold at $86\frac{1}{4}$ to yield 4.9%, whereas, on the same day the General 4s of the Chicago, Rock Island & Pacific Ry., due in 1988, sold at 90 to yield 4.5%. Four years later, on Nov. 22, 1933, the Kansas City Terminal bonds sold at $86\frac{1}{4}$, although the Rock Island General 4s had declined to 42, a price yielding about 10%. On Dec. 8, 1927, the Terminal bonds sold at $93\frac{7}{8}$ and the Chicago, Milwaukee & St. Paul Ry. General 4s, due 1989, sold at 93 to yield somewhat less than the former. On Feb. 24, 1933, the Terminal bonds were selling at 90, to yield about 4.65%, whereas the St. Paul General 4s had declined to a price of 38 and a yield of around 11%. Between Nov. 7, 1927 and June 15, 1932 the Terminal 4s declined from 93 to $82\frac{3}{4}$ (yields of 4.4% and 5.18%, respectively) while Missouri-Kansas-Texas R.R. Prior Lien 4s, due 1962, declined from 93 to $31\frac{1}{8}$ (yields of 4.39% and over 15%, respectively).

## 注意 31

<!--en-->
*NOTE 31*

纽约与哈莱姆铁路公司的情况展现了租赁和担保方面的一些有趣特点。

<!--en-->
The New York & Harlem R.R. situation presents some interesting aspects of leases and guarantees.

1. 该资产的大部分已出租给纽约中央公司，租期为401年。租金相当于债券利息以及优先股和普通股所分配的5美元股息。债券利息和本金都由纽约中央公司专门担保，但股息没有具体担保。不过，自1873年以来，根据租赁协议，股息一直定期支付。
2. 街道铁路资产分别租给N.Y. Rys. Co.，租金相当于每股股票额外2美元。当N.Y. Rys. Co.破产时，租赁关系终止，牵引线路被收回并由N.Y. & Harlem公司运营。1932年，与N.Y. Rys. Corp.（前租户的继任者）就这些资产999年的新租赁协议进行了谈判。唯一的对价为45万美元的一次性付款，因此这笔交易实际上与以上述金额出售街道铁路线路的情况几乎相同。
3. 一些纽约和哈莱姆地区的股东试图从纽约中央铁路公司获得大量额外报酬，理由是宝贵的"空中权"（即可在哈莱姆路上方建设的权利）并未包含在租约中，必须单独支付。这一诉讼的投机性吸引力使股票在1928年价格飙升至505，股息回报率不足1%。该诉讼于1932年被驳回，此时股价已降至82 1/4美元。（1939年底的股价为110美元。）莫比尔与俄亥俄铁路公司的案例也有一些类似的有趣特点，即：
1. 1901年，南方铁路公司发行了“莫比尔与俄亥俄股票信托证书”，以换取几乎全部莫比尔与俄亥俄股票。该公司同意永久按4%的利率收取这些证书的利息。
2. Mobile & Ohio变得繁荣昌盛，从1908年到1930年，它向Southern Ry支付140%的股息。州际商业委员会和阿拉巴马州努力迫使Southern放弃对Mobile的控制，理由是该公司违反了反垄断法。与此同时，股票信托凭证持有者开始采取行动，要么要求退还存入的股票，要么要求获得更高的凭证股息。由于预期会有法律行动，这些股票的价格在1928年跌至$159\frac{1}{2}$。
3. 1929年之后的盈利崩溃使得Mobile & Ohio在1932年陷入破产管理状态。其债券在9月1日应支付的利息未能按时支付，但*股票信托证书*的持有者仍然定期收到由Southern Ry担保的4%股息。1932年，这些证书的价格低至$3\frac{1}{2}$，但这反映出对Southern财务能力的不信任，而非对支付4%股息义务合法性的质疑。1940年，Mobile & Ohio与Gulf, Mobile, Northern R.R.合并，但这一合并并未影响那些有担保的股票信托证书的状态。

<!--en-->
1. The major part of the property is leased to the N.Y. Central for 401 years at a rental equivalent to bond interestand $5 dividends on the preferred and common stock. The bond interest and principal are both specifically guaranteed by the N. Y. Central, but there is no specific guaranty of dividends. However, dividends have been paid regularly under the lease since 1873.
2. The street railway properties were leased separately to N.Y. Rys. Co. for a rental equivalent to an additional $2 per share on both classes of stock. When N.Y. Rys. Co. became bankrupt, the lease was terminated and the traction lines taken back and operated by the N.Y. & Harlem. In 1932 a new lease of these properties for 999 years was negotiated with N.Y. Rys. Corp. (successor to the former lessee). The only consideration was a lump payment of $450,000, so that this transaction appears virtually identical with a sale of the street railway lines for the sum mentioned.
3. Some N.Y. & Harlem stockholders endeavored to obtain large additional payments from the N.Y. Central on the ground that the valuable "air rights" (or rights to build over the Harlem's right-of-way) were not covered by the lease and had to be paid for separately. The speculative glamor of this suit raised the price of the shares to as high as 505 in 1928, representing less than a 1% dividend return. The suit was dismissed in 1932, by which time the price had fallen to $82 1/4. (Price at the end of 1939 was 110.)
The Mobile & Ohio situation has some similar features of interest, *viz.*:
1. In 1901, Southern Ry. Co. issued "Mobile & Ohio Stock Trust Certificates" in exchange for nearly all the Mobile & Ohio capital stock. It agreed to pay 4% on these certificates in perpetuity.
2. Mobile & Ohio became prosperous and from 1908 to 1930 paid the Southern Ry. 140% in dividends. The Interstate Commerce Commission and the State of Alabama endeavored to compel the Southern to give up control of the Mobile on the ground that it violated antitrust laws. At the same time holders of Stock Trust Certificates started action looking either to the return of the deposited stock or to obtaining larger dividendson their certificates. The price of these advanced to $159\frac{1}{2}$ in 1928, in anticipation of the legal moves.
3. The collapse of earnings after 1929 forced Mobile & Ohio into receivership in 1932. Interest due Sept. 1 on its bonds was defaulted, but holders of the *stock* trust certificates have nonetheless regularly received the 4% guaranteed by Southern Ry. In 1932 the price of the certificates had fallen as low as $3\frac{1}{2}$, but this reflected mistrust of Southern's financial capacity rather than any question regarding the legality of the obligation to pay the 4% dividend. Mobile & Ohio was merged with Gulf, Mobile, Northern R.R. in 1940, but this development did not affect the status of the guaranteed stock-trust certificates.

## 注意 32

<!--en-->
*NOTE 32*

### 工业办公大楼公司重组

<!--en-->
*INDUSTRIAL OFFICE BUILDING COMPANY REORGANIZATION*

这家企业的历史鲜明地展现了首次抵押贷款债券持有人的理论权益与实际体验之间的差距。1926年，该公司在新泽西州纽瓦克建造了一座办公楼。土地和建筑成本约为380万美元，但通过常见的"评估"流程，土地价值从30万美元提升到了200万美元。建筑成本则通过出售以下证券来支付：

<!--en-->
The history of this enterprise illustrates in striking fashion the difference between the theoretical rights and the actual experience of a first-mortgage bondholder. In 1926 the company erected an office building in Newark, N.J. The cost of land and building was apparently about $3,800,000, but the land value was marked up from $300,000 to $2,000,000 through the familiar process of “appraisal.” The cost of the building was defrayed through sale of the following securities:

<table><tr><td>6%首套房贷债券</td><td>$3,150,000</td></tr><tr><td>7%无担保票据</td><td>450,000</td></tr><tr><td>优先股</td><td>450,000</td></tr><tr><td>普通股</td><td>100,000</td></tr></table>

<!--en-->
<table><tr><td>6% first-mortgage bonds</td><td>$3,150,000</td></tr><tr><td>7% unsecured notes</td><td>450,000</td></tr><tr><td>Preferred stock</td><td>450,000</td></tr><tr><td>Common stock</td><td>100,000</td></tr></table>

（房地产的加价使普通股“账面价值”约为180万美元。）

<!--en-->
(The mark-up of the real estate gave the common stock a “book value” of about $1,800,000.)

在盈利状况不佳一段时间后，1932年6月1日利息未按时支付，于是指定了接管人。不久之后，制定了重组计划，内容如下：

<!--en-->
Following a period of poor earnings, interest was defaulted on June 1, 1932, and a receiver was appointed. Shortly thereafter a reorganization plan was drawn up, providing as follows:

1. 1947年到期的6%优先债券将换成1947年到期的5%*收入型*债券。
2. 1937年到期的7%无担保票据将换成1948年到期的7%无担保*收入型*票据。
3. 8%优先股将换成新的8%优先股。
4. 普通股将换成新的普通股。
5. 所有这些交换都将按面值或股份对股份进行。重组委员会通过以100,000美元在止赎拍卖中购买房产来实施该计划。未接受新证券的优先债券持有人，每1,000美元债券仅获得56.43美元的现金补偿。在这次调整中，债券持有人放弃了固定的利息权利，没有获得任何补偿，而股东则什么都没有失去。（股息将推迟到三分之二的债券被注销之后才发放，但这样的注销对股东有利，这一规定实际上并不代表他们的牺牲。）这是一次极其偏颇的安排或“妥协”——尤其是因为债券持有人显然有权直接占有房产。重组委员会向股东解释，保留最大股东作为物业管理人的服务（以工资形式）是明智的。实际上，建筑物的真正所有者为资本发行了优先股（即收入债券），并将所有次级股权让给管理层。对于办公楼的监管来说，这似乎是一个惊人的代价。有人可能会反对说，我们的批评有些牵强，因为无论如何，大楼不太可能带来超过收入债券利息的收益，因此股东保留的全部股权几乎不值得争论。但用前所未有的经济萧条中的结果来衡量*潜在*收益是非常错误的。从长期未来来看，有几种不同的可能性使股票股权变得有价值。其中包括：
1. 经济恢复甚至新的房地产繁荣。
2. 货币大幅升值，从而减轻债务负担。
3. 一些对周边地区或建筑有特殊有利影响的特殊发展情况。事实上，在重组计划完成后不久，纽约证券交易所便安排将业务转移到纽瓦克，而这座办公楼就被视为Curb Exchange的所在地。如果真如此发生，这笔巨额利润将完全由这家曾经破产企业的老股东获得。这些利润本应属于债券持有人，因为他们承担了未来损失的所有风险（如1933年2月发行券的市场价格下跌至4美元所示）。需要指出的是，这处价值550万美元的财产以10万美元的价格被拍卖，使得未提取资金的债券持有人仅获得约5美分。（该债券于1927年以100美元价格发行。）其价格严重不足这一点从以下事实可以看出：1932年上半年*税后净收益*仅为67,000美元。作者认为，按照这种重组方案以极低价格转让财产，比普通破产程序中的“冻结股东或其他所有者”更为不公平。债权人对资产征税的权利往往带来巨大困难，但鉴于贷款协议的具体条款以及股东利用借入资金原本可能获得的利润，这几乎不能称为不公平。但在工业办公大楼案例中，司法程序被用来剥夺个人债券持有人本应得到的救济——即要么由法院接管财产，要么分配他在*善意*出售中获得的财产现金价值。美国最高法院后来关于重组计划的*公平性*的判决明确反对这种调整债权人和股东利益的方式。参见*Case*诉*Los Angeles Lumber Products Company, Ltd.*, 308 U.S. 106（1939年11月6日判决）。法院裁定，当涉及公司处于破产状态且可用财产的全部价值未先用于偿还债券持有人债务、再允许股东参与时，第77B条规定的重组计划并不“公平合理”。

<!--en-->
1. The first-mortgage 6% bonds due 1947 were to be exchanged for first-mortgage 5% *income* bonds, also due 1947.
2. The 7% unsecured notes due 1937 were to be exchanged for 7% unsecured *income* notes, due 1948.
3. The 8% preferred stock was to be exchanged for new 8% preferred.
4. The common stock was to be exchanged for new common.
5. All these exchanges were to be made par for par or share for share.
The plan was carried out by the purchase of the property at foreclosure sale for $100,000 by the Reorganization Committee. First-mortgage bondholders who did not accept the new securities received in cash only $56.43 per $1,000 bond.
In this readjustment the bondholders gave up their fixed claim to interest, receiving no compensation of any kind therefore, while the stockholders gave up nothing at all. (Dividends are to be postponed until after two-thirds of the bonds have been retired, but such retirements inure to the benefit of the stockholders and this provision does not really represent a sacrifice on their part.) This was an extraordinarily one-sided composition or “compromise”—the more so since the bondholders were clearly entitled to take direct possession of the property. The Reorganization Committee defended their generosity to the stockholders on the ground that it was desirable to retain the services (at a salary) of the largest stockholder as manager of the property. In effect the real owners of the building took a preferred-stock issue (*i.e.*, income bonds) for their capital and gave up all the junior equity to the management. This seems a staggering price to pay for the supervision of an office building.
It may be objected that our criticism is somewhat far-fetched, since the building was unlikely to return more than the interest on the income bonds in any case, so that the equity retained in full by the stockholders was scarcely worth arguingabout. But it is highly fallacious to measure the *potential* earnings by the results shown in an unparalleled depression. Viewing the proposition over the long-term future, there were several different kinds of possibilities which might make the stock equity valuable. Among them were the following:
1. The return of prosperity and even of a new real estate boom.
2. Substantial inflation of the currency, which would reduce the burden of the bonded debt.
3. Some special favorable development affecting the neighborhood or the building. It happened that immediately after the Reorganization Plan was consummated, the New York Stock Exchange made every arrangement to transfer its business to Newark, and this very office building was spoken of as the home of the Curb Exchange. Had this actually come about, a large profit would have been realized entirely by the old stockholders of this formerly bankrupt enterprise. This profit should properly have belonged to the bondholders, because they took all the risk of future loss (as shown by the decline of the market price of the issue to 4 in February 1933).
Attention should be called to the fact that this property, valued at $5,500,000, was sold at foreclosure for $100,000, netting the undepositing bondholders about 5 cents on the dollar. (The issue had been floated at 100 in 1927.) That this was a grossly inadequate price is clear from the fact that *net earnings after taxes* for the first half of 1932 had been $67,000. In the writers' view, the transfer of property at a negligible price in pursuance of a reorganization scheme of this sort is more inequitable than the "freezing out" of stockholders or other owners in the ordinary bankruptcy proceeding. The right of the creditors to levy on the assets often works great hardship, but it can scarcely be called unfair in the light of the specific terms of the loan agreement and the original possibilities of profit to the stockholder from the use of the borrowed funds. But in the Industrial Office Building example, the judicial process was availed of to deprive the individual bondholder of the remedy which he had been assured he would have in the event of default—*viz.*, either thetaking over of the property on his behalf, or the distribution to him of his share of the cash value of the property realized in a *bona fide* sale.
A later pronouncement of the United States Supreme Court concerning the *fairness* of reorganization plans is definitely opposed to this type of adjustment of creditors' and stockholders' interests. See *Case* vs. *Los Angeles Lumber Products Company, Ltd.*, 308 U.S. 106 (decided Nov. 6, 1939). The court ruled that a plan of reorganization under Section 77B was not "fair and equitable" where, with the corporation involved insolvent, the full value of the property available was not first applied to claims of bondholders before stockholders were allowed to participate.

## 注意33

<!--en-->
*NOTE 33*

### *1932年和1940年到期金融投资公司5s*

<!--en-->
*FINANCIAL INVESTING COMPANY 5s DUE 1932 AND 1940*

从投资信托领域的一个例子可以看出，受托人主动避免采取积极行动的趋势，会剥夺债券持有人在做出承诺时显然有理由依赖的保护措施。

<!--en-->
An example taken from the investment-trust field will show how the inclination of the trustee to avoid positive action on its own initiative operates to deprive the bondholder of the safeguards which he is apparently justified in counting on when he makes his commitment.

纽约金融投资公司出售了两款5%担保信托债券，分别于1932年和1940年到期。这些债券由根据严格要求分散的上市证券存入受托人账户作为担保。该公司承诺保持此类担保的价值至少相当于未偿还债券的120%。受托人有权：（1）在所需保证金受损时通知公司；（2）若30天内未弥补差额，则宣布本金到期；以及（3）在这种情况下出售担保物，并将所得款项用于偿还本金和利息。

<!--en-->
Financial Investing Co. of New York sold two 5% collateral-trust issues, due respectively in 1932 and 1940. These bonds were secured by deposit with the trustee of listed securities, diversified in accordance with stringent requirements. The company covenanted to maintain such collateral at a value of at least 120% of the outstanding bonds. The trustee was empowered: (1) to give notice to the corporation in the event the required margin was impaired; (2) to declare the principal due if the deficiency was not remedied within 30 days; and (3) to sell the collateral in such event and apply the proceeds to payment of principal and interest.

这些契约似乎为债券持有人提供了与银行对可交易证券进行担保贷款时相同的保护。如果规定的保证金受损且未得到弥补，就可以出售担保物以偿还贷款。唯一重要的区别似乎是债券契约中允许30天时间将保证金恢复到规定比例。

<!--en-->
These covenants appeared to give the bondholders practically the same protection as is enjoyed by a bank making a collateral loan on marketable securities. If the stipulated margin became impaired and was not made good, thecollateral could be sold out to satisfy the loan. The only important difference appeared to be the allowance in the bond indenture of a 30-day period to restore the margin to the required percentage.

但金融投资债券的实际历史与同期银行进行的典型担保贷款明显不同。1931年10月，保证金降至20%以下，受托人告知公司这一“违约事件”。保证金未在30天内得到弥补，但担保物并未被出售。1932年8月，债券投标价格低至20美元。1932年10月，一款债券的本金到期但未支付。这一事件迫使采取行动：担保两款债券的担保物被全部出售；1933年1月，即“保证金呼叫”发生15个月后，债券持有人最终获得了约65美分。

<!--en-->
But the actual history of the Financial Investing issues was strikingly at variance with that of the typical collateral loan made by banks during the same period. In October 1931 the margin fell below 20% and the trustee advised the corporation of this “event of default.” The margin was not made good within the thirty days, but the collateral was not sold. In August 1932 the bid price for the bonds fell as low as 20. In October 1932 the principal of one issue matured and was not paid. This event compelled action; the collateral securing both issues was sold out; and in January 1933, 15 *months* after the “margin call,” the bondholders finally received about 65 cents on the dollar.

我们看到，债券持有人在债券契约中获得的看似有效的保护措施，与他们实际经历的极不令人满意的情况之间存在巨大差距——即：重大损失、漫长的等待，以及中期市场价值出现特别严重的下降。原因是什么？是受托人方面的惰性还是疏忽？表面上看，似乎确实如此；但实际上，受托人确实花了很多时间和心思处理这一情况。然而，他的努力受到债券受托人制度既定原则的限制和干扰，即：“除非债券持有人以契约中规定的方式提出要求，否则绝不要做任何可能受到批评的事情。”在Financial Investing 5s案例中，受托人可能被30%债券持有人的书面请求所迫使采取行动，并附带通常的赔偿条款。受托人犹豫是否主动迅速出售担保物，因为如果市场后来恢复，可能会被股东指责无理由地摧毁他们的利益。看起来，出于类似的原因，一些债券持有人也反对在担保物价值低于发行面值后将其出售。

<!--en-->
We see here a wide discrepancy between the apparently effectual safeguards accorded the bondholders in their indenture and the highly unsatisfactory results that they actually experienced—*viz.*, a substantial loss, a long delay and a particularly harrowing shrinkage in market value during the interim. What is the explanation? Was it inertia or carelessness on the part of the trustee? Superficially it might well seem so; yet in fact the trustee gave much time and thought to this situation. But its efforts were controlled—and vitiated—by the established principle of bond trusteeship, *viz.*, “Never do anything that anyone might possibly criticize, unless requested to do so by bondholders in the manner specified in the indenture.” In the case of Financial Investing 5s, the trustee could be compelled to act upon request in writing from the holders of 30% of the bonds, accompanied by the usual indemnities. The trustee hesitated to sell the collateral promptly on its own initiative, because if the market recovered later, it might be accused by the stockholders of having unwarrantably wiped them out. It appears also that for a similar reason some of the bondholders were opposed to the sale of the collateral after its value had fallen below the par amount of the issue.

证明这些对执行债券保护条款的反对意见基本站不住脚并不困难。事实上，如果这些反对意见有道理，那就没有理由在债券中包含这些条款了。如果我们整体分析这一事件，会发现不令人满意的结果源于以下因素的结合：

<!--en-->
It is not difficult to show that these objections to carrying out the protective provisions of the indenture were basically unsound. In fact, if they were tenable, there would be no excuse for having these provisions in the indenture. If we analyze this incident as a whole, we see that the unsatisfactory results flowed from a combination of:

1. 缺乏明确制定的程序规则来执行债券条款。
2. 典型的债券持有人群体，缺乏财务知识且主动性较低。
3. 一种托管模式：在这种模式下，托管人寻求那些被动、无理性债券持有人提供指导，而不是自己去引导他们。

<!--en-->
1. The lack of clearly established rules of procedure to enforce the terms of an indenture.
2. A typical body of bondholders with little financial acumen and less initiative.
3. A basis of trusteeship under which the trustees look to these inert and unreasoning bondholders for guidance, instead of guiding them.

### 注意 34

<!--en-->
*NOTE 34*

我们认为，接下来的两个例子应作为警示，提醒分析师在选择工业债券时，不要过度依赖：(1)债券契约中的保护条款，以及(2)统计数据。

<!--en-->
We believe that the two examples following should be preserved as a warning to the analyst against excessive reliance upon (1) the protective covenants in the indenture, and (2) the statistical exhibit, when selecting industrial bonds.

I. Willys Overland公司十年期第一张票，面值6又1/2美元，到期日期为1933年9月。原始发行数量：10,000,000张。

<!--en-->
I. Willys Overland Co. Ten-year First $6\frac{1}{2}$s, due September 1933. Amount of original issue, $10,000,000.

#### A. 保护条款：

<!--en-->
*A. Protective provisions:*

1. 对目前拥有的或将来获得的所有固定资产进行直接首笔抵押贷款（新购买款项留置权除外），并以主要子公司所持有的所有股票作为担保。这些子公司被禁止创建抵押贷款或融资债务，除非将资产抵押以担保此项贷款。
2. 每年需设立10%的偿债基金（每年100万美元），用于在债券到期前偿还90%的本金。
3. 净流动资产必须始终等于未偿还债券金额的至少 150%。
4. 现金股息仅从1923年9月1日之后的收益中支付，且前提是扣除该股息后的流动资产不少于流动负债的200%，同时净流动资产不少于面值为标的的未偿还债券总额的200%。

<!--en-->
1. A direct first mortgage upon all the fixed assets now owned or hereafter acquired (except for new purchase-money liens), and secured also by pledge of all stocks owned in the principal subsidiary companies. The subsidiaries were prohibited from creating mortgages or funded debt unless same were pledged to secure this issue.
2. A sinking fund of 10% of the issue each year ($1,000,000 per annum) was to retire 90% of the issue prior to maturity.
3. Net current assets must at all times equal at least 150% of the outstanding bonds.
4. Cash dividends were to be paid only out of earnings subsequent to Sept. 1, 1923, and only if the current assets after deducting such dividend are no less than 200% of current liabilities, and net current assets are not less than 200% of the outstanding bonds at par.

#### B. 统计展览，1928年12月31日：

<!--en-->
*B. Statistical exhibit, Dec. 31, 1928:*

1. 在1928年，利息已赚取了12次；1923–1928年间，平均超过11次；过去六年中，每次至少赚取了$3\frac{1}{2}$次。
2. 1928年12月31日，优先股和普通股的市场价值为110,000,000美元，是5,000,000美元债券发行额的22倍。
3. 1928年12月31日，合并后的流动资产净额为28,700,000美元，是未偿还债券的五倍多。
4. 适用于这些债券的合并有形资产净值超过发行金额的14倍。C. 1928年之后的历史：在1929年至1932年的四年中，合并盈余从39,600,000美元降至400,000美元。其中6,000,000美元为支付的股息，剩余部分源于运营及其他损失。巧合的是，28,700,000美元的流动资产净值转化为2,400,000美元的流动负债净余额，总减少额超过30,000,000美元。偿债基金的操作导致1931年底债券发行量降至仅2,000,000美元，但1932年7月应支付的偿债基金分期款未支付。1933年2月任命了接管人。1933年3月到期的债券利息未支付，1933年9月本金也未偿还。这些债券在1931年曾以101½美元的高价出售，1932年价格为92美元，到1933年底降至24美元。需要注意的是，在1932年7月偿债基金出现违约时，托管人或债券持有人并未采取任何行动；同样，在营运资金首次低于规定最低水平时也没有采取行动。及时的防御措施本可迫使支付相对较小的债券发行额。接管后成立了债券持有人保护委员会。认为重组计划不可行，委员会倾向于清算；但随后发现取消其留置权存在法律困难。该公司最终于1936年进行重组，债券持有人获得了房地产变现公司的股份，或在重组后的公司中获得一批可转换优先股或更多普通股。对前债券持有人来说幸运的是，这些股份很快价值超过面值，并支付了旧债券的欠息。II. Berkey和Gay Furniture Co. 最初6期债券，按顺序到期时间为1927-1941年。原始发行金额1,500,000美元。

<!--en-->
1. Interest had been earned 12 times in 1928; an average of over 11 times in 1923–1928; and at least $3\frac{1}{2}$ times in each of the past six years.
2. The market value of the preferred and common stock on Dec. 31, 1928 was $110,000,000 or 22 times the bond issue of $5,000,000.
3. The consolidated net current assets on Dec. 31, 1928, were $28,700,000, or more than five times the outstanding bonds.
4. The consolidated net tangible assets applicable to the bonds were over 14 times the amount of the issue.
C. History subsequent to 1928: In the four years 1929–1932 the consolidated surplus decreased from $39,600,000 to $400,000. Of this shrinkage, $6,000,000 represented dividends paid and the balance was due to operating and other losses. Coincidentally, the net current assets of $28,700,000 were converted into a net excess of current liabilities amounting to $2,400,000, a total shrinkage of over $30,000,000.
The operations of the sinking fund reduced the bond issue to only $2,000,000 at the end of 1931, but the sinking-fund installment due July 1932 was not met. In February 1933 receivers were appointed. Interest on the bonds due March 1933 was defaulted, and the principal was also defaulted in September 1933.
The bonds, which had sold as high as $101\frac{1}{2}$ in 1931 and at 92 in 1932, declined to 24 at the end of 1933.
It is to be noted that no action was taken by the trustees or by the bondholders at the time of default in the sinking fund in July 1932, nor at the time the working capital first declined below the stipulated minimum. Prompt defensive measuresthen might have compelled payment of the relatively small bond issue. A bondholders' protective committee was formed after the receivership. Finding reorganization plans impracticable, it favored liquidation; but it then found legal difficulties in the way of foreclosing on its lien.
The company was finally reorganized in 1936, the bondholders receiving shares in a real estate realization corporation and either a block of convertible preferred or a larger block of common stock in the reorganized company. Fortunately for the former bondholders these shares shortly became worth more than par and defaulted interest on the old bonds.
II. Berkey and Gay Furniture Co. First 6s, due serially 1927–1941. Amount of original issue $1,500,000.

#### A. 保护条款：

<!--en-->
*A. Protective provisions:*

1. 通过一项对价值约440万美元的固定财产的第一顺位抵押担保，其价值超过原始金额的290%。还可以发行最高达100万美元的额外债券，以其他财产作为质押，但利率不得超过相关财产成本的50%。
2. 净流动资产应保持在2,000,000美元，且流动资产量需等于流动负债量的两倍。
3. 到期时的价值与每年平均70,000美元的偿债基金相当，在到期前将偿还该债券三分之二的价值。

<!--en-->
1. Secured by a first lien on fixed property valued at some $4,400,000, or over 290% of the original issue. Additional bonds could be issued up to $1,000,000 against pledge of additional property, but at a rate not exceeding 50% of the cost thereof.
2. The net current assets were to be maintained at $2,000,000, and current assets were required to equal twice current liabilities.
3. The serial maturity was equivalent to a sinking fund averaging $70,000 annually, which would retire two-thirds of the issue prior to maturity.

#### B. 统计展览，1927年12月31日。

<!--en-->
*B. Statistical exhibit, Dec. 31, 1927.*

1. 在1927年，利息收益是三年的三倍；在1922年至1927年间，平均约为4.5倍；在六年的任何一年中，收益都不少于三倍。
2. 当前净资产为3,698,000美元，是未偿还债券金额1,460,000美元的$2\frac{1}{2}$倍。
3. 适用于该债券的总有形资产为8,500,000美元，即每张债券约6,000美元。C. 1927年之后的历史：从1929年1月1日到1931年7月31日，该公司报告了总计近3,000,000美元的亏损。仅1930年，营运资金就从2,900,000美元减少至650,000美元。到1931年7月，出现了流动负债过多的情况。1931年11月，债券利息未能按时支付。1932年2月，指定了接管人。1932年5月到期的债券也未能按时偿还。1933年4月，发布了关于抵押财产没收的法令。这些债券在1928年以面值出售，在1931年3月价格高达65美元，但到1933年底，其价值仅为1美分。在债券利息违约后，为处理该债券发行问题成立了保护委员会。很难说如果债券持有人提前采取行动是否能在这种灾难性情况下有所帮助。但显然，他们本应在1930年底债券契约被违反时立即行动，而不是等到近一年后利息支付违约才坐视不理。这些财产在1935年通过没收方式出售，1936年，每1000美元债券向持有人分配522.50美元，大部分资金来自对另一家公司的损害赔偿诉讼所得。

<!--en-->
1. Interest had been earned over three times in 1927; an average of about $41/2$ times in 1922–1927; and not less than three times in any year of the six-year period.
2. Net current assets were $3,698,000, or $2\frac{1}{2}$ times the $1,460,000 of bonds outstanding.
3. Total tangible assets applicable to the issue were $8,500,000 or about $6,000 per bond.
C. History subsequent to 1927: Between Jan. 1, 1929 and July 31, 1931, the company reported losses aggregating nearly $3,000,000. In 1930 alone the working capital shrank from $2,900,000 to $650,000. By July 1931 an excess of current liabilities was shown. Interest on the bonds was defaulted in November 1931. Receivers were appointed in February 1932. The installment of the bonds due May 1932 was defaulted. A decree directing foreclosure under the mortgage was issued in April 1933. The bonds, which had sold at par in 1928 and as high as 65 in March 1931, were worth only one cent on the dollar at the end of 1933.
A protective committee was formed for the bond issue following the default in bond interest. It is difficult to say whether or not prompter action on behalf of the bondholders would have availed anything in this disastrous situation. But certainly they should have bestirred themselves at the end of 1930, when the working capital covenant had been violated, and not stood idly by until the default in interest payments nearly a year later.
The properties were sold at foreclosure in 1935, and in 1936 $522.50 per $1,000 bond was distributed to the holders, largely from the proceeds of a damage suit against another company.

随后，Chesapeake & Ohio发行了以下新股份：(a) 296,222股，每股100美元，发给1929年4月30日登记股东。(b) 1930年发行46,066.5股，以Hocking Valley Ry. Co.普通股交换。根据公司报告推算，Hocking Valley股票评估值为7,076,710.18美元，即每股C & O股票交换的153.62美元价格。(c) 382,211股，每股100美元，发给1930年6月12日登记股东。

<!--en-->
Subsequently Chesapeake & Ohio issued new shares as follows:
(a) 296,222 shares at $100 per share to holders of record on Apr. 30, 1929.
(b) 46,066.5 shares issued in 1930 in exchange for Hocking Valley Ry. Co. common stock. Working back from the company's reports it appears that the Hocking Valley stock was appraised at $7,076,710.18, or at the rate of $153.62 for the C & O stock issued in exchange.
(c) 382,211 shares at $100 per share to holders of record on June 12, 1930.

最后，在1930年7月31日，Chesapeake & Ohio普通股的面值从每股100美元降至每股25美元，并发行了四股新股份，以交换之前未发行的每一股旧股。

<!--en-->
Finally, on July 31, 1930, the par value of Chesapeake & Ohio common was reduced from $100 per share to $25 per share, and four new shares were issued in exchange for each old share theretofore outstanding.

基于这些事实，1933年初的转换价格计算如下：

<!--en-->
On the basis of these facts the computation of the conversion price in the early part of 1933 was as follows:

$$ \begin{array}{l} \text{Base figure} \qquad \text{Offer of 4 / 30 / 29} \qquad \text{Hocking Valley} \qquad \text{Offer of 6 / 12 / 30} \\ \hline (1,190,049 \times \$220) + (296,222 \times \$100) + (46,066.5 \times 153.62) + (382,211 \times \$100) \\ C' = \frac{1,190,049 + 296,222 + 46,066.5 + 382,211}{4 \text{ (due to 4 for 1 split on 7 / 31 / 30)}} = \$43.97 \end{array} $$

## 注释37

<!--en-->
*NOTE 37*

Consolidated Textile Corp. 三年期7%可转换债券，到期日为1923年，具有此类转换特权。债券规定：“任何此类转换中，公司普通股的转换价格按22股普通股兑换1,000美元计算；500美元兑换11股普通股；如果公司在任何时候发行额外普通股，单价低于46美元，转换价格将降至该普通股发行时的货币或财产公允价值……如果之后进一步发行低价股票，转换率将继续降低，依此类推，并伴随利息和应计股息的现金调整。”

<!--en-->
Consolidated Textile Corp. Three-year 7% Convertible Debentures, due 1923, had a conversion privilege of this type. The indenture provided that “The rate at which common stock of the company shall be delivered on any such conversion shall be upon the basis of 22 shares of such common stock for each $1,000 Note, and eleven shares of such common stock for each $500 Note, or, if any additional common stock of the company is at any time issued by it for less than $46 per share, the rate of conversion shall be reduced to the price in money or in fair value of property at or for which such common stock is issued ... and if any further stock is subsequently issued at a lower price the conversion rate shall be still further reduced, and so on from time to time, with a cash adjustment of interest and dividend accrued.”

这些债券于1920年4月发行。同年11月，公司向股东提供额外股份，每股21美元，因此转换价格从约46美元降至21美元。该特权从未获得实际价值，因为1920年11月之前股票售价从未超过46.5美元，11月转换价格降低后也未能超过21.75美元。1921年10月，该债券以102.5美元的价格赎回。

<!--en-->
These Debenture Notes were issued in April 1920. In November of that year additional stock was offered to stockholders at $21 per share and the conversion price was accordingly reduced to $21 per share from about $46 per share. The privilege never attained a substantial value, the stock not having sold above $46 1/2 prior to November 1920 and failing to exceed $21 7/8 subsequent to the lowering of the conversion price in November. The issue was called at $102 1/2 in October 1921.

## 注释38

<!--en-->
*NOTE 38*

American Telephone & Telegraph Co. 1933年到期、面值为67,000,000美元的4\frac{1}{2}$s可转换债券，于1913年向股东发行，就是这种相对罕见的案例。从1915年3月1日至1925年3月1日，这些债券可转换为普通股，价格为每股120美元。债券规定转换获得的股票应为“电话公司授权股本的一部分，该授权股本将在转换时确定”，且不包含常规的反稀释条款。有趣的是，American Telephone & Telegraph Co. 之前的及之后的可转换债券都包含反稀释条款。例如，1906年发行的可转换4s债券和1929年发行的可转换$4\frac{1}{2}$s债券就包含此类条款。

<!--en-->
The $67,000,000 of American Telephone & Telegraph Co. Convertible $4\frac{1}{2}$s, due 1933, which were offered to shareholders in 1913, are an example of this comparatively rare condition. The bonds were convertible into common stock at $120 per share from Mar. 1, 1915 to Mar. 1, 1925. The indenture provided that the stock obtainable on conversion was to be "part of the authorized capital stock of the Telephone Company as such authorized capital stock shall be constituted at the time of such conversion" and did not contain the usual antidilution clauses. It is interesting to note that both the preceding and subsequent convertible issues of American Telephone & Telegraph Co. did contain an antidilution clause. See, for example, the indentures securing the convertible 4s issued in 1906 and the convertible $4\frac{1}{2}$s issued in 1929.

1933年到期の4\frac{1}{2}$s债券中，超过一半在1915年转换，这是行使特权的第一年；此后剩余部分通过转换迅速减少。1925年特权到期时，仍有1,899,400股未转换，这些在1931年按面值赎回。同时，在1925年之前，公司向股东提供了几次特权认购，这可能解释了为何该债券因股东“权利”导致的稀释而快速转换，尽管8美元和9美元股息率下的更高收益无疑也是因素之一。

<!--en-->
Over half of the $4\frac{1}{2}$s, due 1933, were converted in 1915, the first year in which the privilege was exercisable, and the balance was rapidly reduced thereafter through conversion. In 1925, when the privilege expired, $1,899,400 remained unconverted, and these were called at par in 1931. Meanwhile, prior to 1925, several privileged subscriptions were offered to shareholders and this may account for the rapid conversion of this issue unprotected against dilution through shareholders' "rights," although the higher yield on the stock under an $8 and $9 dividend rate doubtless was a factor.

另一个不太清晰的例子是布鲁克林联合燃气公司可转换5\frac{1}{2}美元债券，到期日为1936年。这些债券于1925年12月发行，允许在1929年1月1日或之后将债券转换为20股普通股。债券契约的措辞有些模糊，规定：“如果公司在债券到期前股票性质发生变化，导致股东可获得的股份数量增加或减少，则这些债券持有人在转换时获得的股份数量也将相应增加或减少。”这使得人们不确定是否提供了针对所有稀释形式的保护，还是仅针对股票分红、股票分割和反向分割提供保护。或许正因如此，在1929年1月1日实际可以转换之前，债券与股票之间存在非常大的套利价差，尽管这里较高的股票分红收益可能部分解释了这种差异。相关数据见下文。

<!--en-->
Another example which is not quite so clearly in point is that of the Brooklyn Union Gas Co. Convertible $5\frac{1}{2}$s, due 1936. These were offered in December 1925 with the right to convert into 20 shares of common stock on or after Jan. 1, 1929. The indenture was somewhat ambiguously worded to the effect that "in the event of a change in the character of the stock of the Company prior to the maturity of the bonds, so as to increase or decrease the number of shares which the stockholders would be entitled to receive for their stock, then the number of shares which the holders of these bonds shall receive upon conversion shall be correspondingly increased or decreased." This left the matter in doubt as to whether protection against all forms of dilution was afforded or whether protection was given against stock dividends, stocksplits, and reverse split-ups only. It was perhaps for this reason that very large arbitrage spreads existed between the bonds and the stock prior to Jan. 1, 1929, when actual conversion could occur, although here again the higher yield from dividends on the equivalent amount of stock may have accounted in part for the discrepancies. Relevant data are appended below.

债券契约规定，在合并或整合过程中，购买者必须承担债券责任，并确保将其转换为与合并或整合中发行的相同种类和金额的股份，关于债券持有人在转换时有权获得的A类股票数量也需保持一致。

<!--en-->
The indenture provided that in case of merger or consolidation the purchaser must assume the bonds and provide for their conversion into the same kind and amount of shares as were issuable in the merger or consolidation with respect to the number of shares of Class *A* stock to which the holder of the bond was entitled from time to time upon conversion.

在1928年7月Dodge Brothers公司与Chrysler Corp.合并之前，第一批1500万美元债券已转换为Dodge Brothers A类股票；剩余的债券由Chrysler Corp.承担。在这次收购中，5股可转换为债券的A类股票被兑换为1股Chrysler普通股。因此，根据债券契约规定，第四笔500万美元债券随后可按每1000美元债券4股Chrysler普通股的价格转换（Chrysler的转换价格为每股250美元）。同样，第五和第六笔债券可分别按每股300美元和350美元转换为Chrysler普通股。1935年5月1日，这些债券的全部未偿还余额3015.0500万美元被要求赎回。

<!--en-->
The first $15,000,000 of the bonds were converted into Dodge Brothers Class *A* stock prior to the merger of that company with Chrysler Corp. in July 1928, and the assumption of the remaining bonds by the latter. In this acquisition five shares of the Class *A* stock into which the bonds were convertible were exchanged for one share of Chrysler Corp. common. Hence, in accordance with the indenture provisions, the fourth $5,000,000 of bonds were thereafter convertible at the rate of four shares of Chrysler common for each $1,000 bond (a conversion price of $250 per share for Chrysler). Likewise, the fifth and sixth units were convertible into Chrysler common at $300 and $350 per share, respectively. On May 1, 1935 the entire outstanding balance of $30,150,500 of these bonds was called for redemption.

从1918年10月到1919年12月，票据的低价为$99\frac{1}{2}$。这五笔交易可以如下分析：

<!--en-->
Low price for note, October 1918 to December 1919, was $99\frac{1}{2}$.
These five transactions may be analyzed as follows:

1. 购买票据并出售一半相关股票，价格接近平价。如果股票下跌，可获得覆盖利润；如果股票上涨，则通过出售另一半股票获得利润。
2. 股票的下跌使得能够获得覆盖利润。
3. 股票回升使得原状态得以恢复。
4. 股票的上涨使得能够以平价出售另一半股票，确保交易盈利。
5. 股票的再次下跌使得可以在出售票据时以利润回购股票。由于票据发行即将到期（加上公司相对良好的财务状况），可以合理预期其价格会保持稳定，因此无需在第二步中全部出售票据。可以保留票据，希望能再次出售股票。

<!--en-->
1. Purchase of note and sale of half of related stock against it, at price not far from parity. This permitted a covering profit if the stock declined and a profit through sale of the other half if the stock advanced.
2. A decline in the stock permitted the covering profit.
3. Recovery of the stock permitted the original position to be restored.
4. Advance of the stock permitted sale of second half at price to assure profit on the operation.
5. Renewed decline in the stock permitted repurchase at profit of shares sold while note was disposed of at par.
Because the near maturity of the note issue (coupled with the reasonably strong financial condition of the company) could be counted upon fairly well to keep its price up, it was not necessary to sell out the note at Step 2. It could be held in the hope that the sale of the stock could be repeated.

1939年以投机性价格出售的债券当前情况表现为：1939年底，纽约证券交易所上市的美国企业债券平均价格为74.60，这一水平表明许多债券以远低于面值的价格出售。1939年期间在纽约证券交易所实际交易的所有企业债券及相关存单的完整价格记录显示，在全年某段时间内，共1,100只债券中，有558只（即57%）的价格低于70。大量低价债券来自铁路公司。参见《商业与金融纪事》，第56–64页，1940年1月6日。

<!--en-->
The current situation with respect to bonds selling at speculative levels (in 1939) is indicated by the fact that the average price of all U. S. corporate bonds listed on the New York Stock Exchange at the end of 1939 was 74.60, a level suggesting that many issues were selling at very large discounts below par. The complete price record of all corporate bonds and certificates of deposit therefor that were actually traded on the New York stock Exchange during 1939 reveals that 558, or 57%, of a total of 1,100 issues sold at prices below 70 at some time during the year. A preponderant number of the low-priced issues were those of railroads. See *Commercial and Financial Chronicle*, pp. 56–64, Jan. 6, 1940.

1936年到期的American Seating 6s债券期限延长了十年，1939年价格最高达到104。

<!--en-->
American Seating 6s, due 1936, were extended for ten years and sold as high as 104 in 1939.

1937年年到期的Crucible Steel 5s债券价格跌至$104\frac{1}{2}$，1938年9月需支付价格为101。

<!--en-->
Crucible Steel 5s, due 1940, rose to a price of $104\frac{1}{2}$ in 1937 and were called for payment at 101 in September 1938.

1950年到期的McKesson & Robbins $5\frac{1}{2}$s债券以25的价格购买非常划算；但在1935–1938年以高于面值的价格出售后，由于管理层存在欺诈行为，1938年末和1939年初价格跌至50。1939年5月利息支付被推迟，但到1940年4月，债券价格已回升至101。

<!--en-->
McKesson & Robbins $5\frac{1}{2}$s, due 1950, proved to be a profitable purchase at 25; but after selling above par in 1935–1938 they slumped to a price of 50 in late 1938 and early 1939 on news of fraudulent conduct by the management. Interest payment was deferred in May 1939, but by April 1940 the bonds had recovered to a price of 101.

1947年到期的Marion Steam Shovel 6s债券表现最差。然而，这些债券在1936–1937年间逐渐回到面值水平，1939年价格最高达到87。

<!--en-->
Marion Steam Shovel 6s, due 1947, have exhibited the poorest record of the list. However, the bonds gradually gained to a price level of par in 1936–1937 and sold as high as 87 in 1939.

1936年将1942年到期的National Acme 6s债券期限延长至1946年的一些持有者，同意将票面利率降至$41\frac{1}{2}\%$。自1936年以来，这些债券一直以接近面值的价格出售。未延期的债券在1936年12月需支付$102\frac{1}{2}$的价格。

<!--en-->
Some holders of the National Acme 6s, due 1942, extended the maturity of their bonds in 1936 to 1946 and consented to a reduction of the coupon rate to $41\frac{1}{2}\%$. These bonds have consistently sold close to par since 1936. The unextended bonds were called at $102\frac{1}{2}$ in December 1936.

*讨论：* 这家企业是该国最大行业之一的主要因素。事实上，Swift & Co在某些年份的销售额甚至超过其他任何美国公司。在1898–1939年的42年间，除了1937年外，每年都支付股息；除了三年外，每年都实现净利润。其股东权益从1898年的15,000,000美元增长到1939年的250,000,000美元。然而，1939年该公司股票的交易价格（以及1930–1939年期间的平均价格）低于其有形投资的一半，甚至仅相当于其净资产的价值，完全忽略了制造工厂、运输设备、商标和商誉等其他资产。问题何在？

<!--en-->
*Discussion:* This enterprise is the leading factor in one of the largest industries in the country. In fact, Swift & Co. has in some years reported a larger dollar volume of sales than any other American corporation. During the 42 years 1898–1939 it has paid a dividend in every year except 1937 and earned a net profit in every year but three. Its stockholders’ equity has grown from $15,000,000 in 1898 to $250,000,000 in 1939. Yet this company’s shares sold in 1939 (and on the average through 1930–1939) for less than half their tangible investment, and for no more than their equity in net current assets alone, disregarding completely the manufacturing plants, the transportation equipment, the trade names and good-will and other assets. What is wrong?

如果我们问为什么华尔街不愿意为Swift & Co支付如此高的价格，答案很简单：过去十年中，这种投资资本的平均收益不到4%，过去二十年的利润趋势主要是下降的。但真正的问题是：为什么这些不利因素足以将Swift的价值减半——即市场价格与有形资产相比——尽管纽约证券交易所所有普通股票的总价值比账面价值高出50%（例如，1938年底的情况）。相关的关键问题是：为什么Swift & Co的价格必须低至平均收益率仅为6%，而1930–1939年普通股票的平均收益率仅为4%（参见涵盖200只领先股票的Moody’s指数）。

<!--en-->
If we ask why Wall Street is not willing to pay so much for Swift & Co. as is invested in the business, the answer is simple. Earnings on this invested capital over the past decade have averaged less than 4%, and the trend of profits in the past twenty years has been predominantly downward. But the real question is why these unfavorable factors are sufficient to cut the value of Swift in half—comparing market price with tangible assets—when all common stocks on the New York Stock Exchange have been selling in the aggregate at 50% *more* than book value (e.g., at the end of 1938). Collateral thereto is the question why the price of Swift & Co. must be so low as to return an average yield of 6%, as against only 4% returned in 1930–1939 by common stocks generally (cf. Moody’s Index covering 200 leading issues).

Swift & Co的低价——相对于平均收益、股息和账面价值的标准来看——清楚地说明了收益趋势对股市估值的主导影响。显然，市场在这里的表现不仅仅是缺乏对该公司前景的热情。实际上，市场明确表示怀疑该公司未来能否像1930–1939年代那样获得高收益，怀疑1.20美元的股息率能否持续，并认为巨大的有形投资作为未来收益保证的价值并不特别大。

<!--en-->
The low price of Swift & Co.—in relation to the criteria of average earnings, dividends and book value—is a spectacular illustration of the dominating influence of earnings-trend upon stock-market valuations. Clearly the market is going farther here than merely registering a lack of enthusiasm for the company’s prospects. Actually, it has been stating in explicit terms that it doubts the ability of the company to earn as much in the future as even the reduced rate of the 1930–1939 decade, that it doubts the continuance of the $1.20 dividend rate, and that it does not believe that the huge tangible investment is of any particular value as an assurance of future earning power.

但反过来，我们必须质疑市场对Swift的评估是否真的代表了认真权衡未来可能性或详细比较利弊的努力。肉类需求不足确实是一个缺点。但是否可以被以下因素抵消：(1)包装行业的稳定性和持久性；(2)Swift组织的巨大声望和财务实力；(3)肉类行业已受到政府监管，低利润率和小投资可能使其免受更盈利行业面临的政治风险？

<!--en-->
But we, in turn, must express doubt whether the market's appraisal of Swift actually represents any careful endeavor to weigh future probabilities or to balance the pros and cons in detail. The lack of an expanding demand for meat is a drawback, certainly. But may it not be offset by such factors as (1) the underlying stability and permanence of the packing industry; (2) the tremendous prestige and financial strength of the Swift organization; (3) the consideration that the meat industry has "taken its bath" of Government regulation and that its low profit margin and small earnings on true investment may protect it from political dangers threatening more lucrative industries?

从这个角度来看，Swift的例子可以视为对当前投资观念有效性的一个清晰测试。我们的批评并非针对华尔街的判决——未来可能会支持或推翻它——而是针对其分析过于简短的问题。假设Swift在1932年和1933年以7美元的价格出售，华尔街的立场仍会将其视为“衰退行业”的投资。但不可能真的所有价值一旦停止扩张就会消失。因此，在某个价格上，像Swift这样的“糟糕”公司仍可能是好投资，就像某个价格上Parke, Davis这样的“好”公司可能是坏投资一样。（对比1939年12月的两家公司值得学生关注。）此外，作为估值和咨询机构，华尔街的真正职责应该是仔细确定增长因素在整个图景中的相对权重，而不是简单地根据“永生幸福”或“永世受罚”的标准快速分类每家公司。

<!--en-->
From this viewpoint the Swift example may be said to present a clean-cut test of the validity of current investment attitudes. Our criticism is directed not so much against Wall Street's verdict—which the future may uphold or upset—as against the foreshortening of its analysis. Suppose that Swift were selling at 7, as it did in 1932 and 1933, the philosophy of Wall Street would still condemn its purchase as a commitment in a "declining industry." But it cannot possibly be true that *all* values disappear from a concern once it has ceased to expand. Hence at *some* price a "bad" company like Swift must be a good investment just as at some price a "good" company like Parke, Davis must be a bad investment. (A comparison of the two as of December 1939 should interest the student.) Hence, further, the real business of Wall Street, as an appraiser and advisor on values, should be to determine with care the *relative weight* of the growth factor in the total picture—instead of seeking merely a quick and easy classification of every company on the Judgment-day basis of either eternally blessed or eternally damned.

另一方面，应该指出，Swift & Co的十年市场记录对其管理层是一个挑战。这提出了需要董事和股东共同讨论的问题。当然，像Swift这样有能力的管理层不应满足于仅通过有形投资获得与市值相当的收益。如果平均情况下条件不允许，那么必须客观研究导致这一失望结果的根本原因，全面探讨可能的解决方案，并充分向59000名股东报告此事。

<!--en-->
On the other hand it should be pointed out that the ten-year market record of Swift & Co. is a challenge to its management. It poses problems to be discussed among the directors and with the stockholders. Certainly a management as capable as that of Swift should not be satisfied unless it earns enough on the *tangible* investment alone to support a market value equal thereto. If conditions will not permit this, on the average, then the underlying factors responsible for thisdisappointing result must be studied objectively, the possible remedies canvassed with thoroughness and the matter fully reported upon to the 59,000 owners of the business.

## 注释 46

<!--en-->
*NOTE 46*

大多数大陆国家的公司法都规定了某些强制性储备金，其中一项功能就是便于维持定期分红。这些储备金来自年度利润，但通常不会达到很大比例。宣布分红的权力通常属于在年度“股东大会”上召开的股东们，尽管也有规定可以宣布临时分红。

<!--en-->
The corporation statutes of most continental countries prescribe certain compulsory reserves, one of the functions of which is to facilitate maintenance of regular dividends. These reserves are accumulated from annual profits but ordinarily do not reach large proportions. The power to declare dividends usually resides in the stockholders assembled at the “general meeting” which is an annual affair, although provision for interim dividends is also made.

在英国，《公司法》并未将宣布分红的权限限制在股东的年度“股东大会”上；但建议的公司章程格式（法律中的表A）规定了这种宣布方式，而且在制定公司章程时，通常会有规定“公司通过股东大会”或“经股东大会批准의董事”可以宣布年度分红。参见《1929年公司法》第一附表表A，19 & 20 Geo. V.，第23章。关于英国分红法律和政策的讨论，可参考《帕尔默公司法》第13版，第222–223页、628页，伦敦，1929年。

<!--en-->
In England the Companies Act does not limit the dividend-declaring function to the annual “general meeting” of the shareholders; but the recommended form of by-laws (Table A of the statute) provides for this mode of declaration and it is the general custom in framing articles of association to stipulate that “the company in general meeting” or “the directors with the sanction of a general meeting,” may declare annual dividends. See *First Schedule, Table A of the Companies Act*, 1929, 19 & 20 Geo. V., Chap. 23. A discussion of British dividend law and policies is available in *Palmer’s Company Law*, 13th ed., pp. 222–223, 628, London, 1929.

## 注释47

<!--en-->
*NOTE 47*

读者可参考第70号国会文件，第76届会议第1次会议（华盛顿，1939年），《投资信托与投资公司统计调查》，特别是第463–493页、833–937页，以获取关于SEC工作人员对1927–1937年期间大型管理投资公司表现进行的详细审查结果的更完整说明。SEC工作人员采用的分析方法通常是将投资公司的净资产波动（未扣除债务）⁴与90只普通股的标准统计指数波动进行比较，并构建了一种综合证券相对指标，以便与投资信托进行更清晰的比较，因为后者并不完全局限于普通股。

<!--en-->
The reader is referred to House Doc. No. 70, 76th Congress, 1st Session (Washington, 1939), *The Statistical Survey of Investment Trusts and Investment Companies*, especially to pp. 463–493, 833–937, for a more complete statement concerning the results of the detailed examination by the S.E.C. staff of the performance of large management investment companies over the period 1927–1937. The method of analysis employed by the S.E.C. staff was, in general, to compare fluctuations in net assets (without deduction of funded debt)⁴ of investment companies with fluctuations in the Standard Statistics index of 90 common stocks, and with a combined security relative constructed to afford greater comparability with investmenttrusts due to the fact that the latter do not confine their commitments to common stocks entirely.

上述研究结果的以下概括引自上述国会文件的第904–906页：

<!--en-->
The following generalizations of the results of this study are quoted from pp. 904–906 of the House Document cited above:

“本附录中的分析表明，真正的大型管理投资公司……通常的表现类似于普通股指数，只有少数公司表现优于该指数。唯一重要的偏离指数趋势似乎来自非普通股的投资，以及股价下跌年份中此类投资比例的增加和市场上涨期间这些投资的减少。没有证据表明许多公司能够年复一年持续表现优于指数。分析表明，所有表现因素相互作用的最终结果仅仅是领先普通股的表现，表现为一个指数。本次分析无法回答投资公司的表现是否仅仅是由随机选择的上市普通股所表现。投资公司的典型表现可能优于通过严格随机选择获得的股票表现，尽管这样的结果意味着指数中代表的股票也表现优于随机选择的股票。...

<!--en-->
“The analysis in this appendix indicates that large management investment companies proper ... typically performed like an index of common stocks with but few companies bettering this performance. The only important tendency to departure from the index would seem to have resulted from the investments other than common stocks, and from the increase in the proportion of this type of investment during years of declining stock prices and the decrease in these investments during rising markets. There is no evidence that many companies were able consistently to perform better than the index year after year. The analysis indicates that the net result of the interplay of all performance determinants was simply the performance of leading common stocks, as represented by an index. Whether the performance of investment companies is simply the performance of listed common stocks selected at random cannot be answered by this analysis. The typical performance of investment companies might well be better than the performance of stocks obtained through strictly random selection, although such a result would imply that the stocks represented in the index also do better than stocks selected at random. ...

“因此，可以相当确定地得出结论：整个管理投资公司群体（与此处研究的样本相反）的表现未能优于领先普通股指数，在1927–1935年期间可能表现略差于指数。...

<!--en-->
“It can, then, be concluded with considerable assurance that the entire group of management investment companies proper (as opposed to the sample here studied) failed to perform better than an index of leading common stocks and probably performed somewhat worse than the index over the 1927–1935 period. ...

“关于固定和半固定投资信托……1930–1935年期间的典型表现低于指数表现，但差距较小。几乎所有固定和半固定信托都将资产投资于普通股，因此它们在股价下跌年份的表现比真正的管理投资公司差，在价格上涨年份则更好。...综合考虑所有因素，固定信托在1930–1935年期间表现可能并不比平均管理投资公司差。”

<!--en-->
“With respect to fixed and semifixed investment trusts ... the typical performance over the 1930–1935 period was below the performance of the index, although by a fairly small margin. Virtually all fixed and semifixed trusts invested their assets in common stocks, and consequently their performance was worse in years of declining stock prices and better inyears of rising prices than investment companies proper. ... All factors considered, it is doubtful that fixed trusts performed much worse over the period 1930–1935 than the average management investment company proper.”

## 注释 48

<!--en-->
*NOTE 48*

标准方法与“先进先出”方法在计算销售成本方面的差异，可以通过以下简化假设性例子说明：

<!--en-->
The difference between the standard and the “last-in, first-out” methods of computing cost of goods sold can be illustrated by the following simplified and hypothetical example:

一家公司初始拥有10,000,000磅铜，每年购买10,000,000磅，持续三年；每年销售10,000,000磅商品，价格比市场价高2美分。初始成本和市场价格均为10美分；第一年的平均成本和收盘价均为15美分，第二年为5美分，第三年为10美分。

<!--en-->
A company starts with 10,000,000 pounds of copper, buys 10,000,000 pounds each year for three years and sells 10,000,000 pounds a year at a 2 cent advance above the market. The initial cost and market price is 10 cents; the average cost and closing price is 15 cents the first year, 5 cents the second year and 10 cents the third year.

显然，公司最终库存状况与开始时相同，并持续每磅获得2美分的利润。常识认为，公司每年（毛）利润为200,000美元。但标准会计方法会显示：第一年利润为700,000美元，第二年亏损800,000美元，第三年利润700,000美元。在1939年之前，由于不允许亏损结转，公司需对1,400,000美元的收入缴纳所得税。根据1939年法律，使用标准方法，该期间的应税收入为700,000美元——即第一年的“利润”——之后不再有应税收入。

<!--en-->
Obviously the company ends up where it started in inventory and has made a continuous profit of 2 cents per pound. Common sense would insist that the company has made (gross) $200,000 each year. But the standard accounting method would show a profit of $700,000 the first year, a loss of $800,000 the second year and a profit of $700,000 the third year. In the years prior to 1939, when no carryover of losses was permitted, the company would be subject to income tax on $1,400,000. Under the 1939 law, and using the standard method, taxable income for the period would be $700,000—the first year’s “profit”—and none thereafter.

### 标准方法

<!--en-->
*STANDARD METHOD*

### 正常库存法存货说明
